        As Ninhursag mumbled, the energy residing within surged, lighting up the enchanting hana on her tanned skin. When the other Eldus followed, the whole room was filled with dazzling shine, blinding Kingu.

        When the shine faded, all the clay dolls were turned into five-year-old children. Despite their different genders and faces, they were all browsing around curiously at the same time, inquisitive about the dawn of this world.

        At this moment, a graceful figure entered the room and asked Ninhursag, “Are the earthlings ready?”

        “Yes. Phase one has been completed. In the upcoming days, I’ll be speeding up their growth and inculcating knowledge into their minds with spells for every seven days. They’ll be fully mature in about thirty days,” Ninhursag reported, but her facial expression implied that she didn’t want this job. 

        Shamash never noticed the unwillingness written on Ninhursag, nor did she care.

        “Remember to program fear into their souls. As long as they worship us, they won’t defy us,” Shamash ordered.

        “...Understood.”

        “Mmm, that’s not enough… Inhibiting seals must also be added to all earthlings except for the combat earthlings.” 

        Squinting at Ninhursag, the tone of Shamash became mean, “The production of labour earthlings is too slow. You must speed it up by all means!”

        Yet not every production was smooth. Some earthlings might explode due to overpressure from the spells. Ninhursag, who treated the earthlings as her own children, collapsed after several failures. Since then, she had given up on producing earthlings.

        The displeased Shamash went over to reproach Ninhursag immediately, “Ninhursag, are you defying me by suspending the earthling production?”

        “Yes. I can’t do this anymore. They’re all lives, yet they’re born to be sacrificed! It’s against the creed of our clan!”

        “I get it. It’s alright if you don’t want to do it.”

        Shamash looked over to Kingu, who was standing with other Eldus, and said, “You, do it.”

        “Yes ma’am,” said Kingu, bowing at Shamash with a bright grin. His exaggerated moves somehow matched his vibe. Then he directed the other Eldus to produce earthlings. Not only did he perform the ritual accurately, but he completed it two times faster than Ninhursag did.

        “This is...impossible...Not even Enlil could completely comprehend the ritual, but...Why? Who are you exactly?” Ninhursag was utterly surprised.

        “Who am I?”

        Kingu laughed as if he found Ninhursag’s question amusing.

        “Consider me as a keen fun seeker.”

        Before Ninhursag could ask further, she got kicked out by the other Eldus at Shamash’s order. Since then, Kingu had officially taken over the earthling production. 

        The duty was interesting at first, but Kingu was gradually bored by the monotonous routine.

        “Overwhelming control is boring…” Kingu mumbled. All of a sudden, a playful grin appeared on his face as if he had a fun idea.

        “Ugh, how boring this is...Can someone change this overpowering situation?” Kingu was lamenting next to the window. Next second, a playful grin appeared on his face as he glimpsed a man outside.

        “Aw, looks like something fun is about to happen.”
STORY_2391:
Creeds of Earthlings - Ch.11

        In ancient times, ample vegetation stood on this land of life.  The radiant sun cast shadows over the woods, creating the tranquility of the day, except for one tree, which seemingly was breaking this harmony.  A dark shadow was lurking somewhere, pulsating like a life form.

        All of a sudden, a violent earthquake appeared for a while.  The disturbance had woken something up from a slumber; it wriggled fast, with a protrusion on the surface.

        Crack——The shadow split open, revealing a pale, white worm with ruby-red eyes.  Rivers of blood were bled from its sockets.

        “Ahhh, finally out of that oblivious nothingness…” Rlim, the white worm, wriggled while opening its great gaping maw, engulfing the ample elements nearby.

        All of a sudden, a few strands of lights had scratched across the gloomy sky like meteors into the realm.

        “My brothers and sisters.  So they’ve broken loose to seek the blessing of the essence?” Rlim gazed at the lights while biting itself out of control.

        “Hehehe, interesting.  Let’s see who’ll be the first to arrive at the beginning of the origin.”

        Afterwards, Rlim had been gathering power on this land.  However, slow progress made it take the plunge.

        “Power...I can feel the power of my essence on the base of those Eldus, but also that “being”...If I could stay hidden..”

        Rlim, therefore hiding in the bushes, waited patiently.  Soon, five creatures came.

        “They’re earthlings...tools created by the Eldus...How fascinating.  Their physique is inferior to that of dragons, elves, and beasts, but their intelligence brings them superior power beyond the flesh by using tools.”

        Rlim, sizing up the earthlings, triggered the power to twist its shape and mimic their bodies, transforming itself into a white-haired youth.  Walking with his thin legs, Rlim jumped into the shadow of a male earthling in the rear.

        “Be my captive.” 

        Hidden in the shadow, Rlim cracked a smile and moved his fingers; then the male earthling followed his action like a puppet

        Rlim continued to conceal itself in the shadow to manipulate the earthling, which created no suspicion among the others.  As a result, he successfully infiltrated the base of Eldus.

        “Here it is.” The earthling, controlled by Rlim, arrived at the source of the power.  However, there was nothing except thick, grey walls.  As he touched the surface, acute pain was sent through his fingertips.

        “Of course, a magic barrier.” Rlim raised his chin.  “That being would be too naive to think this barrier can stop me.” 

        Rlim circulated power as he bled tears of blood.  Two crimson arms stretched out of its shadow, ripped off the barrier.

        Deafening noises and blinding lights crossed; eventually, a crack was pulled off on the wall.

        “Let’s go in.” Rlim waved; the frightened male earthling, despite himself, made a step.

        Although Rlim took over his body, his consciousness still remained.  The earthling couldn't help but watch himself act under control.

        “WOAHHH—” The earthling let out a painful scream, followed by the broken sounds of his elbows and ankles.  Blood came out of the five sense organs, but he never stopped advancing.

        “The curse for those who break into the barrier… Umm, I’m gonna be fine by staying in the shadow.” Unshaken, Rlim continued to control him.

        Soon, they reached the end, a plain-white place without boundary, which made a wisp of darkness exceptionally conspicuous in the center.

        “Urg!” The earthling died as his skeleton shattered.  Rlim then walked out of the shadow; its attention and even soul were all occupied by that darkness.

        Rlim, shivering with horror, felt the fear spontaneously in the face of this supernatural existence.

        “This is the clone of the essence… Finally, we meet each other…” While Rlim was shedding its blood-like tears, it wore a smile of ambition and desire.

        “I will own you and take control of the supreme power.”

        Rlim reached out towards the darkness, but a sense of heaviness immobilized its lower body—numerous bugs were jumping on it.

        “The despair of my brother is exceptionally delicious.” A bewitching woman put on a mysterious smile.  “Long time, my dear brother Rlim.  What are you trying to do to the clone?”

        “Xada, you’re still loyal to the essence,  even though it has gone insane… Emm!” Rlim’s shoulder was pierced to bleed by her sword.

        “Don’t you dare insult it!” Exuding with Bloodlust, Xada kept swinging her sword to many cuts on its body.

        “Hold the sword, Xada.” A voice stopped her move, followed by the appearance of the pink-haired Enlil.  She spoke gently as she put her hands on Xada’s, “You’re killing it.”

        Rlim was a bit surprised to see Enlil, and soon it realized what was going on here.

        “Oh, it has been a long time.” Rlim forced a smile to greet her before turning its face to Xada.  “Killing me doesn’t help.  And you can’t set the essence free alone.  Let’s work together.” Rlim captured the chance to lobby.

        “Rlim is right, Xada.  This is for our own good.” Enlil was helping.

        Xada pondered for a while and decided to let go of Rlim.

        “...Brother, don’t ever do anything that defies the essence again.”

        “Of course.” Rlim looked at Enlil and Xada with a smile. “Let’s achieve the goal together.”

        That was how the three, who had different clandestine purposes, established an alliance to bring unpredictable changes into the realm.
STORY_2401:
A petite figure was dashing along a dusky street. Although she was wanted by multiple white spot lights, they caught nothing but merely spooky white walls. Taking a turn into an alley, the figure opened a sewage lid and leapt into the hole.

        Under the lid, there was no noxious sewage but a spacious basement. Inside which, a group of nervous people were packing their belongings. Chloe, the petite figure who was chasen earlier, was adjusting her breathing pace after the exhausting run. Meanwhile, a man came over to talk to Chloe.

        “Chloe, were you hunted by the guards again?

        “Yes, but don’t worry. They didn’t know that I am here,” said Chloe while refilling her spray paints.

        “Stop messing around. Leave the town with us tomorrow,” the man said seriously, and he continued, “you’ll eventually get caught like your parents did if you live on like this…”

        “That’s why I do it. I do it for them!” Going from calm to angitated, Chloe spoke out her mature thoughts with her childish voice, “everything has changed ever since the beginning of the dictatorship. I just want this town to go back to what it was.”

        Chloe’s words had put the man into silence.

        Chloe lived in a town renowned for street arts, where the people recorded their livelihoods with wall paintings. When the people were satisfied, the paintings would be warm and lively; when they were sad, the paintings would be cold and gloomy.

        However, the walls of this town were all painted white now, erasing the colourful footprints of the people. This happened because a dictator had taken over this town.

        When the people expressed their disappointment towards the dictator on the walls, the paintings would be covered up with white paints by the guards. Worst still, the painters would be arrested for subversion. 

        As time went by, only the paintings that flattered the dictator were kept on the walls. The people had lost their freedom of speech and creation.

        “What can you do on your own? Plus you’re too young…” The man sighed.

        “I ain’t alone! There are so many people here waiting for a chance to overthrow the dictatorship like us!” The agitated Chloe continued with a spray paint in her hand, “there are so many anti-dictatorship marks left in the west art district!”

        “Then do you know that the guards have arrested a bunch of people at the west side? We’ve found a train that leaves the town tomorrow. Everyone has decided to leave. Just think it through,” said the man, shaking his head. He went back to pack his stuff after the conversation.

        “Why is everybody giving up...Damn it!” Pissed off by their attitude, Chloe gritted her teeth and left the hideout alone.

        It made her even angrier when she saw the censored walls on the street.

        “Ssssss——!”

        Chloe was spraying anti-government slogans on the wall; then she added some childish doodles on the paintings that flattered the dictator.

        “Haha. Your doodles are cute!” A voice of a boy spoke next to Chloe.

        “Who?”

        Startled, Chloe saw a boy smile at the paintings, who held a spray paint in his hand just like Chloe.

        “But I think it’ll take more to express our feelings,” said the boy, and he sprayed a poop logo on the dictator’s head, making the portrait funnier.

        “Haha. Does it look good on him?”

        Chloe nodded with a smile.

        “Who’s there!”

        All of a sudden, a few strands of white light appeared at the street corner, followed by few muscular men.

        “The guards! Run!”

        Exchanging a gaze, Chloe and the boy turned around to flee immediately. Before they could run to the opposite side, they spotted other strands of white lights at the end of the street.

        “This way!”

        Chloe dragged the boy into an alley while the shouts behind became closer and closer. The two had been running across the alleys, but all exits were blocked by the guards. Very soon ,Chloe realized that they had been surrounded.

        “That’s a dead end!”

        Chloe failed to notice a dead end ahead as she was focusing on the pursuing guards behind them. By the time the boy warned her, it was too late to stop their feet, bumping right into the wall.

        “Are we gonna get caught...Huh?” Chloe opened her eyes slowly as she couldn’t feel the anticipated pain. Meanwhile, the guards with white flash lights appeared at the intersection. 

        “This is a dead end. Where the hell are they? Just ignore the paintings. Find those two people first!”

        “They can’t see us…” Chloe realized that all the guards couldn’t sense their presence. She didn’t move her body until they had gone. When she moved, she accidentally tripped herself together with the boy, stumbling in front of a wall.

        “That was strange…” The boy was shocked.

        “We were hiding in the painting,” said Chloe. When she reached the painting, her hand became a part of it.

        “Haha. Then we don’t need to worry about getting caught from now on,” said the boy, but nothing had happened when he did the same thing.

        “Strange though. Seems like this is your ability…” The boy could only enter the painting if he held Chloe’s hand.

        “Let’s put it aside. Where are we…” 

        Chloe found that they were at the other side of the dead end, where they saw a magnificent train.

        “I heard that a train would leave the town tomorrow. This should be the train,” said the boy indifferently.

        Unlike the boy, Chloe’s eyes glittered when she heard his words. She picked up the spray paint and said, “let’s show everyone the art of this town!”

        Surprised at first, the boy eventually got what Chloe meant as he saw her approach the train. With a loud laughter, he then joined Chloe’s great creative project.

        Next day, a train went out of the town slowly, accompanied by the raging yell of the dictator and the hopeful exclamation of the people. Doodles about revolutions were painted all over the train, while there was an eye-catching slogan on the car.

        “Tyrannical dictatorship eventually ends; people’s voice is everywhere to be heard.”

        At this moment, Chloe and the boy were watching the train leave on a rooftop. Meanwhile, the boy spoke to Chloe, “let’s go. Few people arrived by following the marks on the paintings. They said they would like to join us.”

        With a nod, Chloe left with the boy while having a thought in her head, “people’s voice will be heard someday as long as it doesn’t stop.”

        Chloe gathered a group of people who shared the same faith in the town. Their paintings were everywhere to be found in the town, spreading the message to the others. Gradually, a rebel force was formed. All they needed was a chance to overthrow the tyranny...
STORY_2402:
“Oh god! I just locked myself out of the store. This is bad..” York the store owner grumbled.

        Everything was witnessed by Iggy, a teen craftsman, who volunteered to help.

        “Let me get it open for you. I’m Iggy the Door Buster. Even the impenetrable city gate was cracked by me!”

        After a deafening blast, Iggy said proudly, “look! The door is opened.”

        “Nonsense! You've blown up my whole store and I don’t even have a door now! This is my store, not the enemy’s gate! You crazy bomber!” York was furious.

        The displeased Iggy then went to the suburb for a private moment.

        “Crazy bomber, really? I’m an explosive expert! Explosive is the most wonderful thing in this world. It brings smoky sky, soul-shaking noises and pleasant fume smell. Why can’t people understand the beauty of explosives?”

        “I understand.”

        The words came from a smiling traveller who was standing behind Iggy.

        “My name is Sonata. I'm very impressed by your knowledge in explosives when I saw you blow up the door back then. If I may, I’d like to seek help from you.”

        Sonata then filled Iggy in with his background. He had been travelling around the world to find the music score of “Whisper of Monesis”, the lost treasure of his clan. He suspected that a mysterious document inside the vault of the local landlord was the music he had been looking for. 

        Yet when he sneaked into the mansion last night, he was unable to open the thick steel gate. That was why Sonata needed Iggy to blow the gate up for him.

        Iggy laughed.

        “You’re lying, aren’t you?”

        “Huh?”

        “You’d like to be as quiet as possible if you want to steal something. Plus aren’t you afraid that I might break your treasure? You just want me to create a diversion, so that you can search for the music.”

        Sonata lowered his head shamefully.

        “I’m sorry. I lied because the music isn’t in the vault. It’s actually in the landlord’s secret treasure chamber, but I don’t know where that is. That’s why I was trying to use you as a decoy. I’m really sorry, and I guess you don’t wanna take this job. Then I’ll ask another…”

        “Hell no! I take everything as long as it’s explosive-related. Let’s go!” Iggy made the decision quickly.

        At night, Iggy and Sonata successfully sneaked into the landlord’s mansion. Arriving at the vault, Sonata hid behind a cover while Iggy threw his custom bomb at the door. The vault gate was blasted open in just a blink of an eye.

        “Hahaha! I’m a genius...Wait, whoa!”

        Not only had the explosion cracked the vault, but it also broke the building structure, causing the collapse at where Iggy stood.

        “Iggy!” Sonata grabbed Iggy’s hand in time.

        “What are you doing here? Go search for the score!” Iggy yelled.

        “How can I...Whoa!”

        Both Sonata and Iggy dropped into a deep hole as another collapse happened.

        “Where are we…”

        When they got back on their feet, they realized that they weren't in a hole, but a luxurious basement. The landlord’s secret treasure chamber was actually located underground.

        As for the mysterious document, it was sealed inside a hardened glass box.

        “Ugh. It doesn’t crack no matter how hard I smash it!” Sonata was stuck in the current problem.

        “Mind if I blow it up?” Iggy suggested.

        “Wait, no way!” Sonata rejected him immediately.

        “Relax. It was unfortunate to blow up the mansion, but at least I found the perfect explosive ratio.”

        Iggy then stuck certain pieces of explosive-blended clay on the glass box. When the explosives were ready, he ignited the fuse to detonate the clays. Boom! The glass box was shattered while the document remained intact.

        “Amazing!” Sonata rushed over to read the document, and he was disappointed. “Oh...It’s not the music I want.”

        “Aw. What a shame,” Iggy was disappointed too.

        Yet Sonata smiled. 

        “Not really. I’m so delighted to meet a real genius during my journey in searching “Whisper of Monesis”. I guess this is the gift that the great Zana gave me. Guards are coming. Let’s leave!”

        The two then escaped out of the town. It was the time for Sonata to bid Iggy farewell and return to his journey.

        When Sonata was on his way, an explosion caught his attention. Looking up, he saw a colourful firework in the sky, which included the regards from Iggy.

        The firework said, “safe journey.”
STORY_2403:
This story took place in a vast forest. On a grassfield, a bunch of tiny creatures were moving.

        These creatures had a cute round shape with a translucent body──They were slimes.

        “Boohoo...Boohoo…”

        The slimes were crying while running as fast as they could.

        “HAHAHAHAHA! Suckers! Run!”

        A high-pitched girly shout sounded in the forest. Right after her words, a whoosh moved across the air. Next second, two running slimes popped like water balloons.

        “Woo──!” Other slimes moaned as they saw what had happened to their fellows.

        “Hehe! Don’t go away!”

        The girl named Perrie stopped to shoot another marble with her slingshot.

        As a spiked marble was shot, another slime popped. The half-solid body tissue was glittering under sunlight.

        “HAHAHA! This is fun!”

        “Ew...They regrow,” said Perrie in disgust.

        However, thanks to the regenerating ability of the slimes, this forest would never be out of slimes. In fact, there would be more and more of them, which gave Perrie a lot of fun.

        “Play with me!”

        Chasing the slimes, Perrie went to the deeper part of the forest. When she passed through an enormous oak tree, she found a slime wall in front of her.

        “Woo──Roar!”

        The tiny slimes stacked up and made a hostile sound, trying to scare Perrie away.

        “Wait...D-Don’t come over!”

        Perrie stepped back in fear as she saw the slimes gathering together.

        “Woo! Woo woo!”

        Next second, the slimes fought back and pounced on the out-numbered Perrie!

        “Ahhh——!”

        The panicked Perrie ran backward, but just for a very short distance. As she stopped, she smiled wickedly and said, “got you!”

        Just when the slimes were pouncing on Perrie, a net hidden on the ground bounced up, capturing all of them inside.

        “Boohoo…” Trapped inside the net, the slimes were hung on a tree, while the strings were strapping them like a ham hanging inside a store room.

        “Hahahaha! This is my great invention!” Perrie said proudly as she looked at her work, “you aren’t going anywhere. Hehehe…”

        “Buluuuu!”

        To Perrie’s surprise, the captured slimes slipped out of the net through the holes.

        “What?”

        Perrie finally realized that the squishy slimes could change their shapes to squeeze through narrow spaces.

        The freed slimes pounced on Perrie immediately.

        “Damn it!”

        As an accident happened, Perrie turned around to escape the forest right away.

        However, hundreds of slimes were gathering outside the forest as well.

        “Ah, those are the regenerated slimes...I didn’t expect that many when I was too busy with pulling pranks…”

        The regenerated slimes blocked Perrie’s escape route while the original slimes were chasing her from behind!

        “Woopoo──!”

        Bumped by the slimes, Perrie rolled for a short distance, scratching her knees and elbows.

        “Ouch! Damn it!”

        It took Perrie a hard time to fling the slimes away and fled the forest, returning to her village.

        “Whoa! Perrie, that’s so messy of you,” the other kids mocked at her.

        “Shut up…”

        “Hahahaha! Perrie is a freak! You stink! Snug!”

        As the kids threw rocks at Perrie, she moaned and ran back to her house.

        “Humph...Someday I’ll make you regret bullying me…”

        Back home, Perrie locked herself inside her room to treat the wounds.

        “Damn it. Got my butt kicked by those pathetic slimes...How can I mess those bullies up if I can’t even win those slimes…”

        With her mouth pouted, Perrie went to her work station and started designing a new trap.

        “If the slimes can regenerate, I’ll just dig a hole to trap every single one of them.”

        “Hmm...What a genius idea.”

        “Test it with the slimes first. Then y’all will be the next…”

        “Hehehehe…”

        A twisted grin appeared on Perrie’s face when she came up with this plan.

        “I will definitely bring hell to you!”
STORY_2404:
Lingering with pleasant music all year round, this school specialized in training students to use magic by performing music instruments.

        On the annual performance, the headmaster was enjoying the students’ performances enthusiastically.

        Some of the students sang beautiful slow songs, making the plants in the garden blossom; some played violin, turning the pond into an uplifting fountain.

        “Yvonne? Yvonne! It’s your showtime!”

        The class instructor had to shake Yvonne hard in order to wake this drooling girl up from her nap.

        As the sleepy Yvonne stepped on to the stage, her baby pink pigtails moved up and down with the rhythm of her pace. She had a chubby face with a cute facial profile. 

        “I’m Yvonne, and I’m here to perform a song composed by myself, ‘The Hunger Anthem’.”

        Yvonne’s sweet voice made the headmaster anticipate her performance.

        The instrument Yvonne used was made of five broken cooking pots and a rusted spatula. As her performance began, she bashed the pots with the spatula hard.

        “CLANK CLANK CLANK CRASH CRASH CRASH!”

        The cacophonous noise was like an attack to the hearing of all students and teachers. Meanwhile, the blossom withered and the water in the pond dried up. When the ground started cracking, everyone fled the hall with their ears covered.

        “STOP! What in the realm are you doing? That is a disaster!” The headmaster yelled.

        “I was merely expressing my mood when I was hungry and the teacher refused to let me go,” said Yvonne.

        The class instructor dragged her off the stage as fast as he could. 

        “Are you crazy to bring pots onto the stage? They are no music instruments at all!” The class instructor was furious.

        “I thought you said even the nicest instrument would only produce disharmonious noise in my hand? That’s why I created my disastrous instrument!” Yvonne answered assuredly.

        “Shut up! You better behave yourself, or you’ll never get to graduate!”

        At night, Yvonne was tossing and turning on her bed.

        “Why? It has been the same since I was small. Everyone runs away whenever I sing. I’ve invested much effort in playing music instruments, but everyone says my music is disastrous. After all, I’ve put all my emotions into it! Am I really not born for it? Ugh. This is annoying! I should go take a walk and get some inspiration for my graduation project.”

        And then Yvonne got out of her bed and left the room with a lamp.
※
        Striding along the hallway, Sonata reminded himself not to make any sound in order to avoid getting caught.


        The safe room for valuable music scores located at the next corner. Approaching his destination, Sonata got his skeleton key ready, preparing to break in at his fastest.

        “Whoa!”

        Sonata bumped into a pink-haired girl in pajamas around the corner.

        Just when Sonata was going to cover Yvonne’s mouth, she did the same thing one step faster. 

        “Please don’t shout! If I get caught sneaking out of bed, I’ll be expelled!”

        Yvonne was relieved when Sonata nodded at her.

        “Thank you, Mr. Thief, but thefting is wrong. You should go home,” said Yvonne.

        “I ain’t no thief! I’m just searching for the music of my family treasure,” Sonata clarified his purpose here.

        “My name is Sonata, and I’m travelling the realm to search for “Whisper of Monesis” composed by my ancestor Zana. I heard that your school kept an ancient mysterious sheet music, so I wanna see if that is our treasure.”

        Yvonne was impressed. “You’re persistent! Too bad that the music is locked inside the headmaster’s office. You won’t be able to get in. But I practiced it once, so how about letting me play it for you?”

        “That would be great! Thank you.”

        Yvonne then took Sonata to the practice room, where the walls were enchanted to sound-proof.

        With a flute in her hands, Yvonne performed the most unsettling and cacophonous tune that Sonata had ever heard, but she couldn’t be more indulging in her performance.

        When the song ended, Sonata applauded.

        “Thank you. Now I know that it’s not “Whisper of Monesis” I’m looking for,” said Sonata.

        Yvonne blushed for embarrassment.

        “I get it. My disastrous music has confused you. You should go to the headmaster’s office and search for it!”

        “It’s not like that. With the effort I’ve spent in studying “Whisper of Monesis”, I can easily tell if that’s the right song. Besides, I don’t think your performance is disastrous, for I can feel your passion in the tune. It’s more authentic than those pleasant but soulless tunes,” Sonata expressed his genuine thought.

        At this moment, Sonata stood up and said to Yvonne, “farewell, Yvonne. May your passion towards music never fade.”
※
        On the graduation performance, Yvonne performed a song named “Adventurous Anthem” with an iron pot, a glass bottle and an empty bamboo stick. The deafening music volume was a soul-shocking blast to every audience. Some of the students even screamed, but not because her music was too awful. When their screams fused with the disharmonic rhythm, they felt an unprecedented pleasure. At the end of the performance, everything was destroyed. The bamboo stick burst; the glass bottle shattered; the pot cracked; the ceiling of the hall crumbled.
        The headmaster announced while rubbing his almost-deaf ears.

        “Congratulations Yvonne, you’ve passed. Now leave the academy and spread your wings!”

        With the blessing of the headmaster, Yvonne left the school confidently.
STORY_2405:
A series of yells sounded in a bustling market.

        “Wallet! I lost my wallet!”

        “Some of my fruits are missing!”

        “Where the heck is my butcher knife?”

        A janitor yelled too, “who took my broomstick?”

        There was only one person who would do such a thing——Rupert the most notorious thief of the town.

        Rupert had an uncatchable stealing speed. Nothing was safe as long as he had his eyes on the prize, no matter the governor’s precious gem and the broomstick of the janior. So far, he hadn’t been caught for once yet.

        All his victims gathered around to grumble together.

        “That’s enough! He literally steals everything!”

        “That boy is a bugger!”

        “He only steals things from mortals. I bet he doesn’t have the gut to steal from Alice in her Wonderland!”

        Alice the owner of the Wonderland had the ability to manipulate elements. With her powerful magic and dark personality, no one would dare to mess with her.

        Everyone in the conversation agreed.

        “Exactly. All Rupert does is picking on commoners like us. He would never challenge Alice!”

        None of them knew that Rupert was eavesdropping at the street corner. The conversation was an utter cut to his ego.

        “Damn it. How dare you underestimate me! I’ll prove myself by doing the exact same thing you said I didn’t have the gut to do!”

        Rupert found the entrance of the Wonderland by tailing Mad Hatter, Alice’s right-hand. Soon, he arrived at the perimeter of Alice’s manor.

        Numerous pawns were patrolling, making the place impenetrable. 

        This wasn’t a problem to Rupert at all. He stole the sword of the pawn closest to him, and threw it at another pawn. A fight then began between the two pawns.

        Rupert repeated the trick a few times to create a chance to sneak into the manor.

        Stepping into the building, Rupert entered a sealed chamber with six walls and a table at the center.

        There was a tiny door on one of the walls, which only fitted Rupert’s arm. Meanwhile, three identical bottles labelled “Drink me” were placed on the table.

        Rupert knew that there was only one real shrinking potion, and he would be dead immediately if he drank the wrong one.

        He laughed.

        “This trap is stupid. Only rookie thieves would fall for it. Why would the house owner use such a troublesome way to get in and out? There must be another door.

        A pocket watch was hung on another wall. Taking it down, Rupert winded the hands to twelve o’clock. Click! Another door opened.

        “This is too easy! Alice’s manor is just another piece of cake!”

        Right after Rupert celebrated his success, he found his feet trapped on the check-patterned floor by plant roots.

        The interior of the room shifted immediately, turning into a bedroom. There was no other furniture except the king bed at the center.

        “Who is a piece of cake to you?”

        A cold voice spoke behind Rupert, who was apparently Alice. The petite girl had a pale poker face, exuding with a creepy vibe.

        “I’ve been expecting you,” Alice sneered. “Everything in the house is enchanted. Strangers will get trapped once they touch my stuff. Who told you to touch my pocket watch?”

        “Alright! I lost! Just kill me! Even if you don’t, I’d rather be dead because I don’t wanna hear people saying “Rupert didn’t steal anything in the Wonderland”!” Rupert yelled with utter embarrassment.

        Alice squinted for Rupert’s determination in theft. At this moment, she decided to teach him a lesson of frustration. 

        “Actually you did steal something. You stole Mad Hatter’s heart.”

        In the meantime, someone in a hat was looking at Rupert shyly at a corner.

        “What?” Rupert was stunned.

        “He fell in love with you, Rupert. From now on, Mad Hatter will live with you and stick around you. Promise me to take good care of him,” said Alice.

        Rupert finally surrendered himself and knelt before Alice for mercy.

        “Sorry! I’m sorry! I...I shouldn’t have disturbed your peace, and your right-hand! Please let me go! I...I’ll never steal again!”

        “What? Surrender already? You’re pathetic. The spot for my right-hand is not for you! Forget it. Get out of my sight!” Alice was disappointed. The moment Alice unlifted the chant, Rupert fled the Wonderland as fast as he could.

        “He deserved it. Hope he’ll behave himself,” Alice thought.

        At this moment, Alice spotted something on her bed had gone missing. 

        “Damn!”

***

        “HAHAHA!”

        Rupert was bouncing joyfully on his way home. He was holding a retractable claw with his trophy hanging on it——Alice’s panties.

        “I didn’t touch it, Lady Alice.” Rupert continued in laughter, “I’m the greatest thief of all time!”
STORY_2406: A talented mechanic from Littner Village same as Yoko. Later, he joined Simon and Kamina to offer help with repair of Gunmen. He is calm and objective. Not only the “brain” of Team Gurren, Leeron is also good at explanation.
STORY_2407:
A teenager born in Giha Village, a subterranean civilization on Earth.

Despite his introversion and timidity, Simon shows calm judgment and outstanding digging skills.

To search for novelties in daily life, he has been working hard on digging, which is not understood by the peers in the village.  Therefore, he is also known as "Simon the Digger".

Since the loss of his parents, Simon has been looked after by Kamina in the village. He has always looked up to Kamina, calling him "brother" due to their close bonding.

One day, Simon found an important drill-like key named “Core Drill” during the digging and activated Gunmen "Lagann". Encouraged by Kamina, he became the pilot of “Lagann” and stepped on an adventure with his brother.

Although "Lagann" is small in size, its combat power is affected by Simon's mental state and Power of Spiral. The drill of "Lagann" at the lower body can also be combined with other Gunmen.
STORY_2408:
Growing up with Simon in Giha Village, Kamina is more mature in age. His red sunglasses and blue tattoos on his upper body are the signature of his appearance.

Boisterous, fearless and determined, Kamina puts his absolute trust in Simon all along. They are sworn brothers after having been through many tough battles.

As the first leader of Team Dai-Gurren, Kamina is full of charisma; he is also the pilot of Gunmen "Gurren".

"Gurren" was captured from the enemy by Kamina, and modified for his own use.  The Gunmen has massive sunglasses that resemble Kamina's. It can be combined with "Lagann" to acquire stronger power.
STORY_2409:
Encountered during the journey, Rossiu is a young boy born in Adai, another underground village. Speaking maturely like a grown man, Rossiu was nicknamed "Forehead Boy" by Kamina. He shows much curiosity about the unknown world above the underground.

After knowing the truth of the village, Rossiu decided to join Team Gurren to embark on a journey of the world.
STORY_2410:
A girl in the pod found by Simon at the bottom of the canyon. Nia is revealed to be Spiral King Lordgenome's eldest daughter and a princess.

Kind, soft and innocent, Nia knows nothing about races other than Beastmen. Therefore, she is very curious about the world outside.

Nia shows absolute trust to Simon who is always helpful to herself, and has been supportive to him whenever Simon is distressed.
STORY_2411:
A pretty teen sniper living in neighbouring Littner Village on the ground. The gigantic sniper rifle equal to her height has become her trademark.  Yoko's first encounter with Simon and Kamina happened during the chase of Gunmen. After the threat was resolved, she joined Simon and Kamina to adventure together.

Yoko has the same age as Simon. Despite her kindness in nature, Yoko also displays a strong and tough personality as she has survived the cruel ground. She is very fond of Kamina.
STORY_2412:
A mysterious Beastman who aims to eradicate humans on the ground.

Viral is the pilot of Gunmen "Enki".

Being exceptionally skillful in piloting, Viral once put Kamina and Simon into a tough battle.
STORY_2413:
The leader of “Black Siblings” the Beastmen hunters, also the eldest male member.

Kittan perhaps is even more hotheaded and irritable than Kamina? Therefore he is always competing with Kamina. Simple, impulsive yet indomitable, he is the pilot of “King Kittan”.

The giant horn on the head allows him to use the "King Kittan Stinger" ultimate ability.
STORY_2415:
One of the Four Generals of the Spiral King, also known as "Adiane the Elegant". Cruel and easy to get excited, she is a scorpion-type Beastman.
 
Adiane owns the flagship "Dai-Gunkai", and is also the pilot of Gunmen "Sayrune".
STORY_2416:
One of the Four Generals of the Spiral King, also known as "Thymilph the Crasher", who is granted the flagship "Dai-Gunzan". He is a straightforward Beastman.
 
Thymilph is also the pilot of Gunmen "Byakou".
STORY_2417:
One of the Four Generals of the Spiral King, also known as "Cytomander the Swift". He is a peacock-type beastman with a narcissistic trait.
 
Cytomander is good at aerial combat. He owns the flagship "Dai-Gunten", and is also the pilot of Gunmen "Shuzack".
STORY_2418:
One of the Four Generals of the Spiral King, also known as "Guame the Immovable". He is an armadillo-type Beastman, and seems to be acquainted with the Spiral King for a long time. Sometimes Guame is quite offensive, so even Cytomander will show respect to him.

 Guame owns the flagship "Dai-Gundo", and is also the pilot of Gunmen "Gember".
STORY_2419:
The creator of Beastmen, also known as the "Spiral King". He lived in Teppelin the royal capital.

Lordgenome is intelligent and possesses a well-built physique and outstanding Power of Spiral. To control the human population, he forced humans to live underground and eradicated those rebels on the surface. Later on, he battled Simon in the royal capital.

His personal Gunmen is "Lazengann". Equipped with sharp teeth on the chest armor and driven by the pilot’s Power of Spiral, "Lazengann" is agile and able to generate long, slender drills as whips. The drills can cover up the entire body to form a gigantic drill with destructive damage.
STORY_2420: Colossal flagships of Anti-Spiral. Its appearance resembles the heads and arms of humans. With overwhelming power and transformation abilities, the flagships were used against Team Dai-Gurren in space.
