        Driven by curiosity, the little girl bounced her way over. She was bold, for she wasn’t intimidated by its unorthodox appearance. Instead, she scanned it.

        “What interesting thing?”

        “Just something interesting.”

        It pressed its palm against the transparent barrier.

        “You’ll see it when you put your palm here too.”

        “Hmm...” After a while of thinking, the girl nodded. 

        “Alright. You’ll be punished if it’s not interesting!”

        Tipping her toes, the girl pressed her palm onto the transparent barrier. A palm-sized embryo was then drilled into her body from its palm. At that moment, the girl Enlil was dead. The one who lived inside this body was North—a demon born from the origin of destruction.

        However, to hide itself from the Eldus, North destroyed the linkage between its memories and its body, so that it could live as Enlil the Eldus. Still, its ultimate goal was never forgotten—to wipe the Eldus clan out by awakening the origin that had conceived it. 

        “I remember…”

        A relieving smile appeared on Enlil’s face, as if she was liberated from the everlasting nightmare.

        With her eyes closed, Enlil raised her arm to call the body and the sealed power of destruction at the other side of the galaxy. As the repelling force had been sealed by Pompeii, the machina, the darkness managed to break free from the container and travel all the way to Enlil.

        “This is...the clone of the essence,” Xada exclaimed. 

        “Yes. This is the power of the origin. It was attached when I was born, and now it has finally returned to me. With this, we’ll be able to break that damned barrier and awaken the origin of destruction.”

        Holding the darkness, Enlil whispered in indulgence, “Then kill all Eldus. Wipe their existence out. Only this can bring peace to Laplace...”
STORY_2478:
A magnificent cataract, surrounded by misty rain with its rumblings spreading over the valley, was located deep in the mountains. This wonder of nature had remained unexplored until one day a visitor came by.

        “Huff…Is it really here?” The masculine type machina, Schrödinger, climbed the slope strenuously.

        Schrödinger was ordered to go to the base of Eldus to have a cease-fire negotiation, but an accident happened in the Mech City. By the time he arrived, the whole place was already sealed.

        After extracting the memories stored in the metal part, Schrödinger followed Pompeii’s last instruction to come to the cataract.

        “The moisture is heavy here, a huge weakness for Machinas.” Schrödinger’s metal joints were making an ear-piercing noise, but he endured and eventually made it to the destination.

        Stretching his aching knees, he searched around the perimeter and eventually spotted a metal core “circuit” hidden behind a boulder.

        “The circuit and vessels are still functioning normally...Pompeii must have separated it from Monesis somehow...Alright, let me activate it.”

        Schrödinger leaned close to the circuit with his kinetic core on the chest. Light was shone from the circuit; vessels were connected and synchronized with the same frequency of pulsation. Soon, a quake happened to separate the cataract, and a cave was revealed.

        As he entered with caution, the lights turned on automatically, revealing a narrow path ahead.

        “The key to save Pompeii and the others lies inside…” Schrödinger remained vigilant to go to the end of the corridor—a square room.

        Suddenly, the lights were all off; the entire room was blacked out. At the same time, fierce attacks were made on Schrödinger.

        “Whoa!” He barely dodged the strikes, but waves of ambushes kept pushing, which made Schrödinger unable to take a breath.

        “I’ll get killed soon in this difficult situation. First, I have to be able to see...Oh, right!” Schrödinger glanced at the faint lights emitted from the vessels at the doorside.

        Then he ran to touch it at once. Connecting himself with the vessels, Schrödinger regained the vision of the room.

        “Ha, got you!” He concentrated elements on both hands to conjure blades and slashed the enemy.

        Bomb! Bang! Two huge noises happened before the room went back to silence. Soon the lights resumed too.

        Schrödinger came to the two broken metal spheres and could not help but shake his head. “Pompeii, you bastard, I almost got killed by your toys.”

        With a sigh, he continued to go forward to the end—a well-equipped research lab. His attention was fully drawn to a dazzling metal piece on the desk.

        Schrödinger picked up the metal and connected it with his kinetic core immediately.

        “Schrödinger, by the time you read this message, I will have already sealed the city to protect Monesis.”

        “...Pompeii’s voice!” Schrödinger was filled with emotions, but he managed to contain the surge inside and read the memories of Pompeii.

        “To save us, please use the lab to make a Soulstone. Then wait for our fellow to come. She will have the key to wake us up…” Pompeii’s voice gradually faded away. When it came to his good old fellows in the Mech City and the dooms that the world might face, Schrödinger was haunted by sorrow and tears. For a good while, he pulled himself together to get out of the never-ending grief.

        “It’s not over yet! Pompeii, wait for me. I’ll save you!”

        Then, Schrödinger buried himself in studying Soulstone. After several failures, he finally produced one.

        However, the fellow that Pompeii had mentioned did not show up. Wasting no more time, Schrödinger decided to find her. Soon, he found a feminine-type Delta lying near the entrance of the Mech City.

        “Her kinetic core was damaged, and she’s immobilized due to a power leak...Must be caused by the enemy’s attacks during the escape… Luckily, the injuries are not severe. Let me fix her first.”

        Schrödinger took a few days to repair Delta, who, unfortunately, remained static.

        “Of course, I need the song of Zana’s clan to activate her kinetic core...Alright, I’d better get going to find them.”

        But what Schrödinger found was nothing but burnt ruins, clearly no signs of any life form left in this place. Looking at the wreckage, restlessness and anxiety rose in Schrödinger’s heart.

        “What… had happened here… Who would do this cruel thing… Could it be those Eldus—”

        At the moment, continuous huge noises interrupted his thoughts.

        “From the base of the Eldus… That’s my chance to figure out what was going on on this land while I was in the lab.” 

        Schrödinger tried to catch up with speed. However, when he arrived, the battle between Earthlings and Eldus was already over. He found out the whole thing from a surviving Earthling. Then he reunited with Cang Bi, the Runedragon, and helped them defeat the enemies.

        Unfortunately, their strength was too strong. The humongous power hidden underground tried to break through Pompeii’s barrier, but this would become the doomsday of the universe.

        Looking to the sky at the entrance of the Mech City, Schrödinger was shocked to realize that the two blazes of scarlet light were bigger than the last time he saw.

        “The power of origin is still penetrating… Even though I have to lose this medium, I still need to re-seal it…”

        Touching the soulstone on his chest, Schrödinger was supposed to use it to save Pompeii and his fellows.

        “Forgive me, Pompeii… everyone… To protect this land, I have no choice.”

        Schrödinger closed his eyes to fuse the soulstone with himself. Next second, iridescence was emitted from his body, illuminating the entire realm...
STORY_2479:
Gods & Demons - Ch.6

        On the planet of Eldus, there was a building, the Hall of History, situated at the center of the desert. Two young men were running, echoing through a spacious corridor.

        “Faster! We’re late.” Young Eldus Lucifer urged impatiently.

        “If it wasn’t you being too occupied with the spell study, we could’ve been on time to the monthly assembly.” Another young Eldus Michael grumbled.

        “Hey, don’t blame me for this. You enjoyed it as much as I did.” Discontented, Lucifer glared at Michael while keeping the speed. Finally, they arrived at a splendid door, a place of solemnity.

        Taking a deep breath, both opened the door carefully. Then, a low, hoarse voice came into their ears.

        “...Alien species were found to absorb the vitality of the planets. During the first contact, we successfully defeated them to save the weak…”

        The silent hall was echoed with a burst of applause for a moment. Michael and Lucifer also followed as they felt great admiration for the honor. 

        “Great, we made it to the Saint’s speech.” Michael was relieved. The young yet awe-inspiring Eldus on the stage was Saint, the candidate for the next grandmaster.

        “But we must stay vigilant. As superior species, we take full responsibility to maintain the order of the universe, therefore—” Saint, who paused while looking at the young generation in the hall, continued with a resolute attitude, “The grandmasters and I are planning to set up a gatekeeping programme named the Keeper. We’ll pick young and skillful Eldus as Keepers of different planets to prevent alien invasion.

        A tempest of applause came again. Saint kept on the speech until it faded by accurate timing, so that the audience could focus on every word from him.

        “However, communication is always an option. Living together in harmony is our mission and goal, also the gospel of the universe—”

        The speech was interrupted by an Eldus suddenly. He came over and whispered. The news made Saint grave as he announced, “Unfortunate news. Aliens spotted on another planet. I’ll be leading my fellows to handle it.”

        Hence, the assembly ended earlier than scheduled. Michael and Lucifer walked out of the hall, but soon got caught—an elder in anger.

        “Lucifer! Michael! You two troublemakers again!”

        “Huh? We didn’t do anything! Don’t point the wrong finger at us!” Lucifer retorted to the injustice, but what the elder was going to say made him speechless.

        “Wrong finger? You two triggered the transformation spell in Woods of Sound, didn’t you?”

        “Yes, but Michael removed the spell when he left.”

        “Huh? Didn’t you remove it, Lucifer?” Michael questioned with shock. By that time they knew why the elder was mad.

        “So now you understand I point the right finger at you. The Woods of Sound is a mess.”

        “Sorry…”

        “Humph! Make yourself useful and make up for it in action!” The grandmaster put his hands on their shoulders with a scary smile.

        Then, Michael and Lucifer were brought to the Woods of Sound to fix the broken place. It took them one whole day to get it done. Exhausted, the two were lying on the lush meadow, and Michael had an idea suddenly.

        “Lucifer, I want to become a Keeper. Like Saint, I want to protect everything, and the equality of life.” 

        “Sounds great.” Lucifer sat up with a fighting spirit, exuding the fearlessness of youth. “I support the Keeper idea. Only the strong can control power. That’s how we show the honor of Eldus!”

        “I know nothing about power and authority, but it’s the right thing to protect the weak together.”

        “Humph! What together...All credit has gone into Saint’s hand!” Lucifer was bitter. “Look! I don’t just wanna be a Keeper, but the best among Keepers!”

        “Haha.” Witnessing his ambition, Michael had a crack. “You admire Saint as much as before. I bet you can’t wait to be his right-hand man, don’t you?”

        “NO!” Hit the spot, Lucifer blushed to deny and walked away to the west.

        “I-I’m heading west to see if there is any place that needs to be fixed. Don’t slack off and get off your butt to check! Otherwise, the grandmaster will be complaining again!” 

        “Ok, ok.” Michael smiled as he stood up, heading east after a stretch. After the checking was done, he went back to the meadow but found Lucifer missing.

        “Strange...Lucifer is never late…” Suddenly, thunder sounded from the sky, which was covered with clouds. A dazzling lightning struck through the air to break the tranquility.

        “...Let’s go find him.”

        “To the west, Michael saw something unexpected—the severely injured Lucifer was hanging on a tree.

        “Lucifer!”

        Michael tried to save him, but a shadow blocked the way—Laplace the demon with a child-like smile. Michael widened his eyes not only because he was an alien, but also because of his flawlessness beyond any creature in the world.

        “Oh, you came, just in time. I’m lost. Can you help me?” Laplace’s voice was light as a feather.

        “...Did you harm Lucifer?” Michael pulled himself together after getting rid of the blankness. Despite his lowered head, his fury could be told, judging from the tightened body motion and the sharp tone.

        However, Laplace was unaware, gazing up to Michael with a smile.

        “Right. It was his fault. I was asking for directions, but he attacked me for no reason. So I just lectured this bad boy.” Laplace stood straight and continued with hostility and offense, “Look. I’m being nice to him, you see? He’s not dead yet.” 

        “...You disgusting alien!” Michael drew his sword and triggered a spell. A large amount of mana was gathered on the long sword, slashing at Laplace.

        Laplace did not dodge nor strike back, but grabbed Michael’s sword barehanded. With astonishment, the mana on the sword was erased, and its weight became much slighter, as if he were holding a toy weapon.

        “Oh, that dude used all his power to buff the attack, but you split half the power to maintain the solidity of the sword instead. Well, this is not important because…” Laplace closed his eyes to analyze and opened them again, filled with bloodlust. “You’re as bad as that dude. Time to lecture!”

        Laplace pulled out an unknown weapon and conjured mana on its surface, just the same as Michael did!

        The attack targeted at Michael’s blind spot, right into the vital part. He was blasted away, flying toward a huge stone and smashing into a big hole.

        Michael bled hard, moaning with pain breathlessly.

        “Oops, that’s heavy. Seems he can’t answer me either. I’ll wake up that dude then.” Puzzled, Laplace stretched his head, came over to Lucifer, and pulled his collar brutally.

        Although that scene was all in Michael's eyes, he was too weak to speak up and stop it.

        “No...I’m Eldus, the keeper of all...I have to protect my fellow at all costs!”

        Every inch of movement was bone-cutting. He managed to put his right hand on top of the sword and drew a spell with blood as his last-ditch effort.

        Enchanted by mana, the sword flew towards the enemy fiercely—Laplace stopped the weapon by pinching it with two fingers.

        “This can’t hurt...Em?” Laplace felt sudden warmth on the cheek. Blood stained his finger as he touched the face——The sword has left a half-finger-long wound on his right cheek.

        Laplace remained silent for a while. When Michael thought his life was doomed today, Laplace spoke.

        “Amazing! You’re just amazing!” Laplace was excited to shout. “My analysis indicated that you couldn’t have unleashed that kind of attack, but your bonding with the fellow exceeds my calculation...Oh, what a beautiful possibility.” 

        “Alright, I decided, to spare your life.” Laplace nodded and released Lucifer. “Train. Grow stronger. Then let me see the possibility of transcending the limit.”

        He left after leaving this message.

        “He...is not much the same as I thought about the alien species...Maybe I’ve done wrong...I shouldn’t attack but to communicate in the beginning…” Looking at the child-like Laplace, Michael was confused about himself and his own kind.
STORY_2480:
“Death is actually peaceful.”

        Laplace pondered, squinting at the azure sky with his golden eyes. Immersed in the static tranquility, he seemed to forget his life was fading. At that moment, Laplace was pierced through the heart by a sharp limb. Despite the fall, strangely he could not even hear any sound of landing.

        Then, someone lifted him up. Yet his own eyes were clouded, like being deprived of sight deliberately. Laplace could not get a clear picture of that person’s face nor hear what he said. Instead, he only remembered one thing—— 

        Grief.

        Laplace was haunted by grief that was sharper and more desperate than the physical pain.

        “...Right, the grief of being betrayed.” 

        To escape from that soul-shattering sorrow, Laplace closed his eyes to let his consciousness sink into the quiet, solitary darkness. He knew death was knocking on the door already.

        However, this distant world of death soon started changing. Laplace was shrouded in the warmth of vitality, which began to heal his damaged heart and repair the pierced hole.

        Laplace was familiar with the source of this energy——Vorvadoss, one of the demons born from the origin like Laplace. The contradictory mindset Vorvadoss possessed was one of the few things that intrigued him.

        “Laplace, I’ll save you, at the expense of my life.” Vorvadoss whispered to his ears.

        “Don’t...I don’t need that.” Not yet free from death, Laplace was unable to speak, let alone stop Vorvadoss——He ripped his chest open to expose his beating heart and the embryo, which was the original form of their race. 

        “Sleep, the loved Laplace. Observe in dreams. When you wake up again, the world shall fall for you.”

        “Stop it, Vorvadoss! No!”

        Vorvadoss got closer to Laplace’s face, trying to kiss him. However, he held that desire back. Vorvadoss stroked Laplace’s soft cheek with his long eyelashes, as a kiss that delivered his contradictory emotions.

        “By then, bring me the barren universe as I wish.”

        Then Vorvadoss crushed his embryo to drip some slimy fluid onto Laplace’s embryo on the left chest. Splendid lights were gathered to cover Laplace with translucent feathered wings.

        “No...don’t...don’t leave me!”

        “Vorvadoss!” Waking up from the nightmare, Laplace sat up and found himself trapped in a crimson, waxy cocoon. With a light tap, the cocoon cracked open.

        After a long slumber, Laplace felt perplexed as he came out of the breach. It was a resplendent palace with portraits hanging all round. It seemed to be a memorial hall.

        “Where...am I? My head...hurts…” Laplace, touching his aching forehead, walked out of the palace aimlessly. Yet a group of patrolling demon soldiers spotted and pointed their weapons at Laplace instantly.

        “Damned intruders! How dare you trespass on the palace!”

        “Surrender yourself!”

        Their ear-piercing roars had made Laplace’s head even more painful, resulting in a burst of fury.

        “...SHUT UP!” He glared at the soldiers with an intimidating bloodlust.

        The soldiers were completely taken aback as Laplace raised his head, for they had never seen such a captivating iridescence in their entire life, which unfortunately was also the final thought of those soldiers at the very last moment——Following Laplace’s order, the elements were turned into razor-sharp blades to cut them into half with precision. The soldiers did not realize their death until the body parted.

        Blood was splashed on Laplace, staining his body to ruby red. Yet he showed no care, mumbling like a lost, helpless child. 

        “Vorvadoss...Where are you...come out...stop playing around…”

        Walking to the central hallway, Laplace had killed every single pursuing soldier under his chaotic mind.

        “No one’s here...but me...Why...why...I don’t want to...I——” As solitude was about to drive him mad, Laplace saw someone familiar at a chamber in the end of the corridor.

        Laplace’s desperate face was embellished by golden light, beautiful enough to take one’s breath. As he walked into the chamber, the demeanor and charm that he exuded had touched every present demon’s heart. They were all unable to react at the moment.

        Until a demon accidentally dropped a glass, making a sharp noise as it shattered. By that moment the demon soldiers began to shake off the drifted mind and surround the man standing ahead of the throne.

        “P-Protect the elder prince!”
        “Keep the intruder away from the prince!”

        However, soldiers’ resistance was meaningless in front of Laplace. Without wasting time on those useless pawns, he waved his right hand to kill them all while maintaining a direct gaze at the man ahead. 

        “Ah...so you’re here. ” Eliminating the obstacles, Laplace came over to the man ——  Baal the elder prince of Origin of Demons.

        Laplace put on a satisfied smile, so pure and innocent that stood a stark contrast to the bloodstains on him.

        Baal on the throne did not waver nor avoid, simply gazing at Laplace calmly.

        Laplace tipped his toes, hugging Baal’s robust body like a spoiled child, and whispered as he leant his head on Baal’s shoulder. 

        “Vorvadoss, please don’t leave...me...”

        After finishing the words, Laplace became limp as if losing all his strength. Baal, out of reflexes, caught him but felt shocked at his underweight. Glancing at his peaceful face, Baal knew that Laplace had just fallen asleep.

        “Your Highness, please leave this intruder to us.” A general hurried the way in. When he tried to take Laplace away, Baal held him in his arms and adjusted the posture for his better sleep.

        “Withdraw.” Baal commanded the general.

        “But he had killed our——”

        “I said withdraw.”

        “...Copy.”

        After the general’s withdrawal, Baal held Laplace back to the sleeping room, washed him clean and carried him to the bed. Even so, Laplace was still deeply asleep like a baby.

        Baal leant close to him, close enough to feel his breath, but such an intimacy had awakened Laplace. Twitching his long eyelashes, Laplace opened his eyes slowly and saw Baal was on top.

        “You’re...not Vorvadoss.” A moment later, he began to adapt himself to the situation after another long slumber. As his thoughts sort out, Laplace found that Baal was not the person who he longed for.

        “He’s the smell of Vorvadoss...that’s why I’d mix them up...” The utter disappointment sank his heart. In bad moods, Laplace questioned Baal with a frown, “who are you?”

        “It should be you to answer this question——” Before letting Baal finish his words, Laplace kicked into his stomach hard, broke a vase and slammed him to the wall.

        Before Baal got the time to stand up, Laplace was already on top of him.

        “I had a really bad day. Tell me honestly or —— Em?” Laplace put a pointy vase chip against Baal’s neck. 

        Suddenly, Laplace felt a sharp thing pressing against his chest —— Baal drew his blade to point at Laplace.

        “Killing me won’t get you anything.” Baal acted calmly.

        “Oh, interesting. So you still resist even if you know I’m able to kill you anytime I want?” When Laplace grabbed Baal’s blade, it melted miraculously. 

        “He...used the power of elements to decompose the blade...” Baal raised his eyebrows.

        “Alright, I’ll let you in my plan.”

        “It depends.”

        “You——” Annoyed, Laplace found that it was exactly what Baal hoped for, who’s wearing a pleased smile.

        Laplace turned his face away and hid the anger. “To conquer the universe.”

        “...Are you serious?” Baal was stunned. Sniggering, Laplace contained his emotion to respond in a low voice, “Of course.”

        After a moment of silence, Baal burst into laughter.

        “HAHAHAHA! I love your plan. Pretty straightforward.” The last time he laughed that hard was many years ago.

        Therefore, Laplace and Baal reached a cooperation agreement. Also because of Laplace’s participation, it became an opportunity for the demons to war on Continent Tarones in the future...
STORY_2481:
Finale of Yamato - Ch.4

        “Ugh. Are you two sisters fighting again?”

        Leaping down the rooftop, Susanoo blocked Kagutsuchi’s kill shot for Amaterasu. Then Susanoo pushed Kagutsuchi away and hit his abdomen, blasting him into the air. At this moment, Tsukuyomi puppeteered Kagutsuchi to make him land safely.

        Susanoo conjured a water barrier by sticking his sword into the ground and pouring spiritual energy into it, which kept Tsukuyomi and Kagutsuchi away for a moment. When the battle ceased, Susanoo went over to Amaterasu to heal her. Fortunately, Amaterasu regained her strength quickly as her injuries were nothing critical.

        “How did you find us?” Amaterasu asked.

        “All thanks to this little folk.” Susanoo conjured a little black centipede. 

        “When I was on my journey, I saved a man from a poisonous magic and tamed this centipede. It’s my shikigami now,” said Susanoo proudly to Amaterasu. 

        “To my surprise, this folk is very sensitive to black magic. He’s the one who led me here!”

        “Looks like he has earned a lot from his journey,” Amaterasu thought, who was happy to see the changes in her brother.

        Deafening noises interrupted their conversation. At this moment, the water barrier was evaporated by Kagutsuchi’s fierce fire. While Tsukuyomi and Kagutsuchi were approaching, Susanoo and Amaterasu held their weapons tight for the upcoming battle.

        After pouring more energy into the threads that controlled Kagutsuchi, Tsukuyomi unleashed her power to attack Susanoo and Amaterasu at the same time! Amaterasu swung her fan, launching an energy strike to clash with Tsukuyomi’s attack.

        Meanwhile, Kagutsuchi ambushed, whose action was caught by Susanoo. He stepped up and fended the sucker punch for his sister.

        “Leave Kagutsuchi to me! Amaterasu, bring Tsukuyomi back!”

        As Susanoo was done speaking, he went on a face-off with Kagutsuchi.

        Sparks were generated when the metal swords collided. Without self-consciousness, Kagutsuchi’s attacks became regular and predictable. It didn’t take Susanoo long to figure the pattern out and knocked him down!

        “Kagutsuchi, wake up! You said you’d protect Amaterasu! Don’t lose yourself so easily!” Susanoo pointed his sword at Kagutsuchi’s throat.

        “Amaterasu...Protect Amaterasu...I…”

        “Yes! Not only you’re not protecting her, but you’re doing the opposite!” Susanoo yelled.

        Susanoo’s words brought a bit of Kagutsuchi’s sanity back. However, Tsukuyomi poured more energy to keep Kagutsuchi under control as soon as she sensed the resistance through the threads...
STORY_2482:
Finale of Yamato - Ch.5

        Drowning in the darkness, Kagutsuchi experienced non-stop flashbacks——energy outburst in childhood, energy outburst in adulthood, estranging Izanagi...The past he loathed but he couldn’t get away with.

        “My existence achieves nothing but hurt others...Maybe this is my perfect ending...This is the way to keep me from hurting people...and keep me from harms…”

        The utterly hopeless Kagutsuchi locked himself up, but he didn’t know that he was battling Susanoo under Tsukuyomi’s control in the real world. At this moment, Kagutsuchi was holding his sword with his body on fire. Susanoo, too late to shield himself with the water element, let go of his sword because of the scorching pain. Seizing the chance, Kagutsuchi threw Susanoo’s sword away.

        All of a sudden, Amaterasu screamed! Looking over worriedly, Susanoo saw the wounded Amaterasu being restrained by Tsukuyomi with her threads.

        “Amaterasu!”

        Susanoo’s rescuing intention was predicted by Tsukuyomi, who flicked her finger. Next second, Kagutsuchi stepped up and subdued Susanoo!

        “Dang! Let me go, Kagutsuchi!”

        In the darkness, Kagutsuchi heard Susanoo’s call. Slightly opening his eyes, he saw Amaterasu in danger while he had Susanoo subdued.

        “Amaterasu!”

        “It’s useless. You cannot defy fate. You, who was born because of the black magic, should not exist at all. The world doesn’t need you,” a female voice whispered to him.

        Kagutsuchi's heart was defeated again. All he had ever wanted was to protect the others, but all he had done was hurting them…

        “Don’t give up!”

        Susanoo spoke loudly, “you’re just avoiding the problem! You can protect no one at all! YOU COWARD!”

        Susanoo surged his spiritual energy to blast Kagutsuchi away. Next second, he punched Kagutsuchi hard on his face. 

        “Wake the hell up! Kagutsuchi you idiot!”

        Susanoo then pulled Kagutsuchi close by dragging his collar. 

        “Amaterasu never gives up on you...She has been waiting for your return! Is this how bad you wanna protect her? Is that it!?”

        All of a sudden, Susanoo was immobilized, for Tsukuyomi restrained him with her energy threads while he was occupied by the battle. Exhausted, he couldn’t break free this time.

        In the meantime, Kagutsuchi opened his eyes again in the darkness, and the female shade appeared again.

        “Your return only causes sufferings, and you’ll suffer too. Just give up.”

        “Indeed, the people around me were hurt by my untamed spiritual energy, but…”

        Kagutsuchi regained his courage to defy his fate when he thought of the smile of his beloved one.

        “Someone’s waiting for my return!”

        A flame sword appeared in his hand, but the fire was warm this time. Then he wielded the weapon to banish the female shade, freeing Kagutsuchi’s  consciousness from the infinite darkness——
STORY_2483:
Finale of Yamato - Ch.8

        The lives of Izanagi and the others returned to ordinary as all the misunderstandings were cleared, but everyone was not living as the same before.

        After a period of recovery, Susanoo resumed his journey again, saying that he still had a promise to deliver. A bit worried, Amaterasu decided to put her faith in him and let him go.

        Izanagi quitted his Onmyōji career as he had lost his spiritual energy and eyesight. He became a teacher who taught children magic theories. By sharing his experience, he hoped that he could enlighten the children to become a righteous person.

        After the reconciliation, Izanami had been taking care of Izanagi closely. She took his place to pray and exorcise for the people in the town. The two never left each other alone, becoming the model couple in everyone’s eyes.

        Tsukuyomi had stopped dreaming of her dead parents, and her trauma was healing day by day. 

        Later Tsukuyomi worked harder on her magic, hoping to become an Onmyōji even greater than Izanagi in the future. One day when she was capable of living on her own, she’d repent her sins by travelling the world to help the people in need. Ever since her return, the relationship between her and Amaterasu had become even better than the old times. The sisters stuck together all the time, and Inari was not very comfortable with it.

        Ever since that battle, Kagutsuchi had never lost control of his spiritual energy again. He became a renowned taoist working hard on becoming an Onmyōji. Sometimes he would work on a quest on his own. If Amaterasu got a job request, he would come back and accompany her no matter what.

        As for Amaterasu, she spent more time at home than before. One day when Inari asked her why, she said, “I hope everyone remembers that someone’s waiting for their return whenever they’re on a quest or a trip. And someone will greet them with “welcome home” when they return. That’s it.”

        Looking at the delightful and contented look on Amaterasu, Inari responded happily, “then you’ll have my company so that you won’t be bored.”

        “Thank you, Inari,” said Amaterasu, smiling.

        This day, Amaterasu received letters from Susanoo and Kagutsuchi respectively.

        “Wait what!? Since when did Susanoo have a wife? And he’s bringing her home! Kagutsuchi said he had something important to tell me. What’s happening? Nonono, the important part is that they’re coming back. I gotta cook something they like...But it’s too late to shop now! W-What should I do?”

        Amaterasu’s panic was witnessed by Tsukuyomi and Inari.

        “If Amaterasu has no time to do the shopping, then let’s help her!” Tsukuyomi suggested.

        “Hmm...But do you know their appetite?” Inari doubted.

        “Humph, of course. I’m everyone’s favourite!” The confident Tsukuyomi then pulled Inari out of the house.

        Arriving at the market, Tsukuyomi was carried away by the various goods. Inari, observing aside, spoke to bring her stray mind back, “hey, we’re here to do grocery shopping for Amaterasu.”

        “Oh...right. I almost forgot about it. The market is such a dangerous place…”

        “You’re the dangerous one here...How can you forget your purpose that soon…”

        Although Tsukuyomi remembered the favorite dishes of Amaterasu and Susanoo, she became frustrated when she couldn’t recall those of Izanagi, Izanami and Kagutsuchi…

        “The three of them have similar preferences, something spicy. Hmm...what’s that spicy food…” Inari reminded Tsukuyomi by raising a question.

        “Curry!”

        Reminded by Inari, Tsukuyomi recalled their favorite food immediately.

        They were planning to go back as they had bought all the needed ingredients, but then they were attracted by all sorts of intriguing stuff in the market——street performers, snacks, mini games and etc…

        Unable to resist the temptations, the crowd-loving Tsukuyomi and Inari spent the whole afternoon in the market. By the time they got home, the sun was already setting and Amaterasu was waiting for them at the doorstep grumpily.

        “Gosh, where have you two been? Do you know that I’ll be worried when you’re gone for this long!”

        “Sorry Amaterasu...But we’ve bought the food that everybody likes!” 

        When Tsukuyomi opened her shopping bag in a thrill, she realized that everything in the bag was either broken or melted...Tsukuyomi and Inari began to cry as their effort went in vain.

        Their tears had softened Amaterasu, who went over to give them a hug.

        “Thanks for the effort anyway, and welcome back, Tsukuyomi, Inari.”

        “Right! We’re back!” They wiped the tears away and responded to Amaterasu with a smile.

        At this moment, Kagutsuchi came out of the house and asked, “Tsukuyomi, Inari, where have you been? Why the late return?”

        “Kagutsuchi!”

        Their frustration was cleared as Kagutsuchi went over and rubbed their heads.

        “Oh! Susanoo is back too,” said Amaterasu, pointing behind Tsukuyomi and Inari.

        Turning around, Tsukuyomi and Inari saw Susanoo coming over with Kushinada hand-in-hand. All of them went back into the house while Izanagi and Izanami were waiting at the dining table already. Then the family started the dinner prepared by Amaterasu.


        Inari smiled as it saw the joyful smile on everyone’s face. This was the “home” that brought her peace, and the people surrounding her were her “family”...
STORY_2484:
Finale of Yamato - Ch.7

        “We’re making good progress! One more prayer on the full moon night and the poisonous magic in your father’s body should be cleared,” said Kushinada, smiling at the girl and her father.

        “Thank you so much. If it wasn’t you, I’d probably be dead…” The man scratched his head and thanked Kushinada shyly.

        “Although I’ve been helping, the biggest reason for the success is the love between you and your daughter.”

        The girl and her father smiled at each other as they heard Kushinada’s words.

        “Plus I can’t take all the credits! That guy worked hard too,” Kushinada continued.

        “Hehe, are you thinking of Susanoo?” The girl asked with a playful giggle.

        “Stop making fun of me, you naughty girl,” said Kushinada, flipping at the girl’s forehead.

        It had been two weeks since Susanoo left her. The time period wasn’t long, but somehow she thought of him all the time…

        Kushinada slapped herself, which was her usual gesture whenever she thought of Susanoo.

        “By the way, there’s a carnival tomorrow night. Do you wanna go with me?” The girl asked excitedly, making Kushinada unable to say no.

        Turned out it was a romantic-themed carnival, which explained the lovebirds everywhere. With such a scene, Kushinada felt even lonelier.

        “Kushinada, do you want a bite? This caramel apple smells so good!” The girl scurried back from a stall with a caramel apple in her hand.

        That reminded Kushinada of the days she had been through with Susanoo—— “Wow! This caramel apple smells so good! Would you like to get one?”

        Kushinada’s heart raced for Susanoo’s words and expressions.

        With mixed feelings, Kushinada took a bite of the caramel apple. It wasn’t sweet as she expected, but there was a touch of bitterness. She was hoping that the carnival could cheer her up, yet it did the opposite.

        “I think I should go,” said Kushinada, leaving promptly.

        At this moment, she heard a clear sound of dripping, which was strange for such a bustling place. Heading towards the sound source, she spotted a golden youkai stopping at a busy stall.

        Rounded golden youkai; Wealth-attracting youkai; Water-manipulating youkai…

        “Ahhhh! Fortune youkai, stand right there!” Kushinada yelled as she recognized the fortune youkai she had been hunting after.

        The startled fortune youkai fled right away. As soon as he left, the crowd surrounding the stall dispersed immediately, blocking Kushinada’s pursuit.

        The fortune youkai ran while Kushinada was chasing behind, as if a cat was hunting a mouse. The chase soon led them to a main street near the carnival, where it was quieter than usual as most of the people had gone to the carnival.

        On the quiet street, Kushinada looked around vigilantly, but the fortune youkai was nowhere to be seen. 

        “Humph! You really believe that you could fool me with this little trick?” Putting on a confident grin, Kushinada threw a few fulus into the air.

        “Light!”

        Blinding light was emitted from the fulus to illuminate the street, revealing a shadow. While the fortune youkai was wiggling in pain, Kushinada came to him cockily.

        “You have nowhere to escape now! Get ready to be captured!”

        She took out her fulu and reached over to the fortune youkai——

        “Wait, how come?”

        Darkness was exuded from the fortune youkai, putting out the light conjured by Kushinada. The darkness then gradually devoured her…

        In the boundless darkness, Kushinada saw the past of the fortune youkai——

        One day, the fortune youkai met a poor couple. His kind nature drove him to help them. However, not only they weren’t grateful, but they tried to imprison him.

        Although the fortune youkai managed to escape, he became everyone’s target since then. All the people wanted was to capture him and make money…

        In the dark, Kushinada heard the dripping again, and she finally understood it was the teardrops of the fortune youkai.

        “Go to hell! You greedy humans!”

        Kushinada became powerless as soon as she heard the fortune youkai’s voice. When her consciousness was fading, her promise with Susanoo brought her back. At this moment, she threw some fulus out, which exploded right away!

        The tremendous pain made the fortune youkai throw Kushinada out of the darkness. Still, Kushinada could barely sit up, watching the angry youkai approach her——

        Just when she lost her hope, countless water blades appeared to shatter the darkness.

        A man stood in front of Kushinada, who got a lift to stand back up. 

        “Haven’t we agreed to find the fortune youkai together after I come back? Look at the mess you’ve gotten yourself into,” said the man with a smile.

        “You idiot! What took you so long? You said you’d be back soon!”

        Kushinada was pissed when she saw the cocky look on Susanoo, beating him up as soon as she saw him. Yet she was relieved whenever she was with him.

        “Ouch! Alright alright! My bad! But I came to you right away as soon as I finished my business!” Susanoo apologised immediately.

        “So...how should we deal with this guy?” Susanoo asked as he caught the fortune youkai.

        “...Let him go,” said Kushinada.

        “For real? I thought you wanted to capture him?”

        “Yes.” She paused then continued, “but we shouldn’t harm others for our own desire.”

        Susanoo then put the fortune youkai down.

        Shocked, the fortune youkai bowed gratefully at them and left quickly.

        “I thought you’d plan to make a fortune from the youkai,” said Susanoo.

        “I used to believe that wealth was my top priority, but…” Kushinada couldn’t help but glanced at Susanoo.

        It wasn’t long for their separation, but it was long enough for her. And she realized that she was happy as long as she had him.

        “But what?” Susanoo wanted the rest of her answer.

        “But I don’t need the youkai to make big money! After all, I'm a beautiful taoist with solid skills!”

        “Is that so? But it was me who——Ouch!”

        Kushinada punched Susanoo again. Only this time, there was a happy smile on her face.
STORY_2485:
Finale of Yamato - Ch.1

        Izanami brought Kagutsuchi and Tsukuyomi to the abandoned village. However, Kagutsuchi had an epiphany of Izanagi’s intention after remembering a childhood memory. Much as he wanted to return home and apologize to his father, Izanami and Tsukuyomi found out 
 his plan. At last, he was stopped by Tsukuyomi with her magic.

        Izanami, believing that Kagutsuchi was ill, surrendered to the lingering female voice and began to kidnap children, hoping their hearts could heal her son. Yet the kidnapped children were discovered by Izanagi and Amaterasu, who were led to the same village by their investigation. The paths of Izanami and Izanagi crossed again…

        Izanami hopefully walked towards Izanagi. At this moment, she realized that she had a lot to tell him; And this time, she hoped that he would understand her and everything she had done.

        “...Izanagi, I——”

        “Why did you kidnap so many children?”

        Izanagi took the initiative to question with blame written on his face.

        “I was...trying to save Kagutsuchi, our son! He can only be cured by ingesting children’s hearts!”

        “So...saving Kagutsuchi is your justification for killing innocent people?”

        “But if I don’t do so, Kagutsuchi will be eventually killed by his spiritual energy——”

        “Izanami, when will you wake up from your wicked fantasy?”

        Izanami’s heart sank as she was denied by Izanagi again. Strong spiritual energy surged when Izanami became devastated and resentful.

        “Everything I do, I do it for our family!” Izanami gritted her teeth while scowling at Izanagi.

        At this moment, Izanami lost control of her spiritual energy, and countless white arms were grown out of her back!

        “Talking is redundant if you’ll never understand me!”

        Heartbroken, Izanami charged at Izanagi. Meanwhile, the white arms launched an intense wave of attacks against Izanagi. The devastated Izanami finally integrated with the black magic, and the same old tragedy was about to repeat in this village again...
STORY_2486:
Finale of Yamato - Ch.6

        Tsukuyomi was fighting Amaterasu with ease in spite of controlling Kagutsuchi to battle Susanoo. She fully utilized the black magic in the battle.

        On the contrary, Amaterasu had been holding back, for every attack from Tsukuyomi reminded her of the tragedy of the book author and the memories between her and her little sister.

        Tsukuyomi consolidated her spiritual energy into daggers to dart at Amaterasu, who raised her fans to fend off. All of a sudden, the attacks stopped. Perplexed, Amaterasu looked around but Tsukuyomi was nowhere to be seen. At this moment, Tsukuyomi’s laughter sounded above her——

        “I got you, Amaterasu.”

        Purple threads were spread onto Amaterasu. Tsukuyomi pulled the threads upon landing, tying Amaterasu up tightly. Restrained, Amaterasu let go of her fan, and she had used up all her fulus.

        “Amaterasu!” Susanoo’s rescuing intention was predicted by Tsukuyomi, who controlled Kagutsuchi to subdue him immediately. At this moment, Amaterasu saw a female shade diffused into Tsukuyomi!

        Tsukuyomi suddenly stopped moving with her spiritual energy turning creepy. In the meantime, a dark aura wrapped her up, devouring her mind——

        “I need to save Tsukuyomi…”

        When Amaterasu was struggling, she was freed by someone, who then offered a hand to lift her up.

        “Yes. It’s not the time to give up now.”

        “Kagutsuchi? How come…”

        “I’ll entrust all my power to you. Bring your dearest sister back!” 

        When Kagutsuchi put his hands on Amaterasu’s shoulders, she felt a revitalizing spiritual energy flowing into her body, and Kagutsuchi collapsed onto the ground after handing the fan to her.

        The evil spirit possessed on Tsukuyomi attacked Amaterasu mercilessly! However, no hint of fear could be found on Amaterasu, who waved her fan calmly. The hot air current fanned from Amaterasu became a shield, protecting her from Tsukuyomi’s attacks. The closer Amaterasu got, the more hysteric Tsukuyomi became.

        “Go away! Stay away from me!”

        Standing in front of Tsukuyomi, Amaterasu threw her fan away and pulled Tsukuyomi into her arms. 

        “It’s alright. I got you. I miss dad and mum just as you do, but they will always live in our hearts. You must be heartbroken when I scolded you harshly. I’m terribly sorry. Let’s go home, shall we?”

        At this moment, Susanoo came over and hugged Tsukuyomi too.

        “There will be a home as long as we three stick together!”

        “Amaterasu...Susanoo…”

        It finally came into Tsukuyomi’s senses that she had never lost her home, and the death of her parents had never taken her home away from her. She was finally freed from the black magic’s bewitchment, and the evil spirit was casted out of her body.

        Regaining sanity, Tsukuyomi hugged Amaterasu and Susanoo back.

        “I’m sorry...So sorry…” she apologised with laughter and tears.

        “Welcome back, Tsukuyomi,” Amaterasu said softly.

        “What a troublesome sister!” Susanoo laughed.

        Collapsing onto the ground, the three siblings hadn’t been laughing so carefreely like this for a long while. And this time, Tsukuyomi knew that she was not alone and she wouldn’t have to reminisce about the old times, for home was where Amaterasu and Susanoo were...
STORY_2487:
Finale of Yamato - Ch.2

        After getting to know the origin of the book of black magic, Izanagi and Amaterasu set off to the abandoned village where everything had begun. However, they found a bunch of kidnapped children.

        At this moment, Izanami showed up together with Tsukuyomi. Izanami longed for Izanagi’s understanding, yet all she had was his hostile question. Devastated, she integrated with the evil spirit in the black magic.

        “Talking is redundant if you’ll never understand me!”

        As Izanami was done speaking, she surged her wicked spiritual energy and charged at Izanagi, attacking him with the pale arms grown from her back. While Izanagi was barely dodging the attacks, he noticed something——The fiercer her attack was, the more she got corrupted by the black magic!

        “I’ll get killed if I don’t do something...but...I couldn’t hurt my beloved wife…”

        It only took Izanagi a second of hesitation to get himself subdued by Izanami’s pale arms.

        “Die!” Izanami raised her arm to thrust at Izanagi’s chest.

        At that critical moment, the protective fulu that Izanagi had been carrying was triggered. As the blinding light dazzled, Izanami was blasted away.

        “I WON’T LET YOU SMITE ME!” Lying on the ground, Izanami screamed in hysteria.

        A black evil aura was exuded under her feet, rising all the way up. Even her white clothes were stained black. The aura eventually diffused into her eyes and turned into black tears, rolling down on her cheeks.

        Izanagi knew clearly that it was the body reaction when one was devoured by the black magic!

        The mentally collapsed Izanami created a strong encirclement that kept everyone away from her.

        Despite the foreseeable harm, Izanagi moved his steps towards Izanami as he was determined to save his wife from the black magic.

        “Hmm!”

        Izanagi moaned painfully, but he put up with the pain and continued to go further.

        The closer Izanagi got, the more wounds were cut open on his body. Very soon, his limbs and face were covered with bleeding scratches. By the time he made his way to Izanami, he was already bloodsoaked. If it was for an ordinary person, he would’ve passed out already.

        It was the will of saving his wife that supported Izanagi. Standing next to Izanami, he pulled her into his arms gently and spoke to her softly. 

        “Izanami, I’m sorry that I left you to face everything alone. Don’t worry. I’ll share your burden from now on. So come home.”

        Izanagi unleashed every bit of his spiritual energy to counteract Izanami’s evil aura. At that moment, the encirclement trembled and cracked; the darkness possessing her began to fade away. Meanwhile, he felt a stingy pain from his eyes.

        In Izanagi’s eyes, the image of Izanami became blurry. Soon, his eyesight was reduced to nothing but complete darkness. Not only the blindness, but his hair turned white due to the overconsumption of spiritual energy…

        When Izanagi was about to fall down, he was held by someone gently.

        Although he could not see, he knew it was Izanami, whose evil aura had been exorcised, with her eyes becoming limpid like the moon.

        “Izanagi...I’m sorry,” Izanami wept.

        “It’s okay as long as you're back.”

        The two hugged each other tightly, but they didn’t notice that the evil aura had crept away towards Tsukuyomi...
STORY_2488:
Finale of Yamato - Ch.3

        Izanami took Kagutsuchi and Tsukuyomi to the abandoned village, but they were found by Izanagi and Amaterasu, who got into a quarrel with Izanami again regarding the child abduction.

        Tsukuyomi kept Amaterasu busy in order to keep her away from Izanami. Amaterasu became desperate as Izanagi was in grave danger.

        “Amaterasu, I’m not done with you yet! Where are you going?”

        “Tsukuyomi! It’s not play time now!”

        “I’ve missed you sooooooo much, Amaterasu. You gotta play with me.”

        Tsukuyomi consolidated her spiritual energy into purple threads. With a hand gesture, Tsukuyomi wrapped Amaterasu up with the threads like a cocoon! Just when she thought that she had her sister captured, the threads began to combust——Boom! Amaterasu broke free by using explosive fulus.

        “Impressive! There’s no fun if you lose so soon! Try this!”

        Waving her arm, Tsukuyomi casted a blade made of spiritual energy at Amaterasu. While Amaterasu concentrated on dodging the attack, Tsukuyomi lowered her body to press her palms against the ground. When Amaterasu stepped on the trap, Tsukuyomi pulled hard immediately, catching Amaterasu with the threads again!

        As Amaterasu was already taken captive, Tsukuyomi came over with a doll in her hand.

        “I can finally free the real Amaterasu from you imposter.”

        “Tsukuyomi...wake up! Stop letting the black magic control you!”

        “You’re not my family! You’re the fake Amaterasu!”

        “No! Me and Susanoo are with you. As long as we three together——”

        “SHUT UP!”

        Tsukuyomi reached Amaterasu, trying to pull a hair off from her. At this moment, Amaterasu shouted.

        “Explode!”

        Amaterasu broke free again by detonating the small fulu hidden in her hair accessory.

        The explosion forced Tsukuyomi to step back, whose face was scratched by the chippings. Wiping the blood away, she screamed, “give me back the real Amaterasu!”

        Acting in hysteria, Tsukuyomi launched fierce yet messy attacks at Amaterasu, who resolved them with two folding fans.

        As all the attacks went in vain, Tsukuyomi surged her spiritual energy for a new trick. All of a sudden, Kagutsuchi, who was lacking focuses in his eyes, pointed his sword at Amaterasu.

        “K-Kagutsuchi? What happened to you?” Amaterasu was anxious.

        “The thought suddenly hits me...I think you’d rather play with Kagutsuchi than me.”

        As Tsukuyomi moved her fingers, Kagutsuchi began to move agilely, charging at Amaterasu with his sword.

        The shock had Amaterasu reacting slower than usual, who was too late to dodge a kick after a sword hit. Kicked by Kagutsuchi, Amaterasu was smashed onto the wall of an abandoned house. Injured by the momentum, she coughed blood while lying on the ground immobilized.

        “I can finally free you, Amaterasu.”

        Tsukuyomi moved her fingers again and puppeteered Kagutsuchi to stab Amaterasu! At that critical moment, someone descended from above and fended off the deadly hit for Amaterasu——

        “Ugh. Are you two sisters fighting again?”
STORY_2496:
Gods & Demons - Ch.1

        Since the sinking of primordial dragons into the land of origin, the universe had become still. Afterwards, elements started flowing from the land to the furthest sides of the space; its power somehow vitalized the remnants of the primordial dragons, which brought the land back to life following ages of withering and death.

        The ample nature added vibrancy to the lonely world. At the very far end, new species were born from elements. After eliminations and evolutions, they broke away from the low-level instincts to explore the origin of consciousness and souls. They called themselves Eldus, explorers of the origin.

        The Eldus stepped on the odyssey journey of seeking truth and their origin. During the exploration, they also utilized their advanced civilization and technology to assist the evolution of other planets as responsibilities and obligations.

        Manungal the Eldus showed little care about the responsibilities and obligations, but she was very fond of history and origin, which explained why she had joined the expedition.

        Descending trippingly from the sky, Manungal revealed her rare reaction to astonish—limpid water covered the entire globe; iridescent coral interlaced with luxuriant seagrasses, connecting to a rainbow stretched over the whole world, dyeing the ethereal beauty on this land.

        “This is the place where the luminfly was born...No wonder the grandmasters sent me to investigate once they found out about the regression of this place.” Manungal walked lightly on the lake, sending ripples over the water, as if she had a warm welcome with a waterway. Gazing afar, Manungal was appreciating such a magnificent view.

        However, the great mood was soon disturbed by the corpses of butterflies in the water. The odor generated from lipid decomposition had lingered in the air, which caught her attention with a frown.

        “They...seem to be drained to death...What happened here?” Manungal looked into the corpses, found the cause of death, and analyzed.

        “Not enough information… Em? Something is flashing...” Manungal carefully bypassed the coral to the center of the lake. A palm-sized cocoon clung to a rainbow, emitting faint but colorful lights as if it were calling for survival.

        “That's the cocoon of luminfly...It's fading...A grandmaster once taught me how to adjust one’s life sequence to alter its vital nature...” Closing her eyes, Manungal drew a spell beside the cocoon and condensed mana to change its life sequence.

        “I did it...” Manungal mumbled with exhaustion, looking at the glittering cocoon with a satisfied smile. But she put it away as soon as she saw the rapid growth of the cocoon.

        The palm-size cocoon was now even bigger than Manungal, with some weird noises sounding inside; that sharp noise was like chewing open a shell.

        Crack! The cocoon cracked. Three pairs of transparent butterflies flew in the air. Their wings reflected the iridescence, but the ominous darkness contained in their compound eyes made them sinister.

        Manungal, who was not good at combat, could not react. To be exact, her head was simply occupied by this magnificent creature, a craving to study them. The curiosity drove Manungal to keep gazing instead of dodging their attacks—

        Slash! A piercing sound brought her back to reality. Stepping backwards, Manungal saw someone's arm was stung by the mutated antenna of the luminfly. 

        “Saint!”

        “Stay back, Manungal.” Saint, the Eldus, was hurt in the left arm, bleeding. Despite his gentle tone, it also carried irresistible weight.

        Manungal stepped back at once.

        Saint closed his lucid eyes; then everything in the perimeter was dimmed and bleak. As he let out a divine chant, golden mana covered his body.

        Shielded by mana, Saint pulled out the antenna and gave the luminfly a cross kick. Such an attack sent it to hit the coral reef hard with a huge noise.

        “Saint!” A lady was calling nervously— it was Ishtar, an Eldus, who hurried over after sensing something off. She held his bleeding left arm anxiously and triggered a healing spell in no time.

        “Wait, Ishtar.” Saint looked over to the sky on full alert. The luminfly was preparing to dive into him from the mid air.

        However, no attack was made. The luminfly let out a scream of pain, with its body shrinking to wither, as if it was drained by something. As a result, it fell down.

        “What is it...Is it because of Saint's attack...No, something’s wrong. I'm gonna check it!”

        Manungal, ignoring the injured Saint, ran towards the corpse of the luminfly to investigate by hands. Finally, she found a wriggling creature in the luminfly's heart.

        “Is this...an embryo?”

        Spotted, the embryo tried to escape, but was trapped by an enchanted container tossed by Manungal. Despite its effort to ram the bottle, the creature was eventually suppressed by the spell.

        “Could it be...” Manungal went towards the other corpses to analyze their life sequences. The result was completely different from that luminfly. 

        “I have to tell Saint!” When she finished studying, Saint was long gone, already on the way back to the home planet of the Eldus.

        Manungal set off immediately to space. 

        As Saint was injured, Ishtar slowed down intentionally for him. Soon, Manungal caught up, raising her container with much excitement.

        “The life sequence of this creature is totally different from those luminflies. Perhaps they all died because of it!” 

        “Enough!” Ishtar smacked Manungal's hand, causing the container to drift to the zero-gravity universe. She did not care much, but glared at Manungal. “You can't even protect yourself. You left the team without authorization. You made Saint hurt. And now you're still talking about your study! Manungal, what are you thinking exactly?”

        Questioned by Ishtar, Manungal did not say a word but was desperate to find the lost container instead, which made her even angrier. When she was going to blame her again, Saint held her fury.

        “Don’t blame her. She’s still fresh.” Saint said lightly, and Ishtar could not help but shut up. Turning to Manungal, Saint wore a smile, “Manungal, let’s go back.”

        “But...” Manungal bit her lips to show unwillingness. However, as soon as she met Saint's sincere gaze, she obeyed and followed them back with a sigh.

        Such a decision they made, somehow, had shaken the fate of the whole world...
STORY_2497:
Gods & Demons - Ch.7

        Childhood memories of Ishtar the Eldus were nothing but blood, tears, and lingering fear.

        Ishtar was not born on the planet of the Eldus, but on an extreme planet—poor resources, extreme weather, a variety of threatening species. Every day, their kind was struggling for survival in the harsh environment. Their life expectancy was mostly only 30 years.

        In order to continue the lifeblood of the kind, all were bound to accept rigorous combat training when children knew how to walk. Many died in the practice. Ishtar, having been on the edge of death a few times, was no better. But with luck, what didn't kill her made her stronger.

        Such ugly and humble living made Ishtar think it was the nature of life, but she proved herself wrong that day she saw the Eldus descending from the sky. 

        It turns out that life could be so beautiful and noble.

        “My fellow of the universe, fear not. We’re the Eldus of the Akkad planet. Your planet will soon be wrecked to extinction by meteorites. We serve to protect the life of species, therefore we are willing to help you move into a safe and livable planet.” The Eldus announced in a friendly manner.

        When the excited Ishtar was about to go forward, her chief and the adults raised their weapons to roar ferociously. “You evil creatures, stop the lies! Get out of here now, or we show you no mercy!”

        The Eldus did not waver because of their hostility. “If you change your mind, find us on the hill. We will be staying until tomorrow morning.”

        The Eldus then triggered a spell to fly towards the mountain in a flash. Showing no interest, the chief and the adults all went back to continue their lives. However, Ishtar was the only exception. Despite her utter disappointment, she was unable to act against the will of the clan, leaving her no choice but to return to the slum.

        But something happened at night. Saint the young Eldus brought some fruit and tools, saying these were meant to be given to the clan as a gesture of sincerity. But it turns out he was rejected and attacked by stones. Saint could not help but put them on the ground and leave.

        “His head is bleeding!” Hiding in the corner, Ishtar was worried about Saint's injury. So she sneaked into the chief's room to steal some precious remedies and ran to find Saint, who was cleaning the dirt by the lake.

        Ishtar took a deep breath to pluck up her courage and come to him. “For, for you— Ouch!” She closed her eyes to hand over the medicine.

        Too nervous, she bit her tongue accidentally, with tears in pain. At the moment, a breath of warmth was sent. When she opened her eyes, she saw Saint use a spell to cover her with gentle light. Miraculously, the pain had totally gone.

        “You're good now.” Saint looked at Ishtar gently, who did not know the wound on his forehead had already recovered until now. “What was that?” Ishtar asked curiously.

        “A recovery spell.”

        “Spell? That glowy thingy?”

        “Right. It has many purposes in addition to healing. Look.” Saint drew a spell and activated; a dazzling beam was unleashed to crush a big stone on the other side of the lake.

        Stunned, Ishtar spoke after a moment of silence. “...Why didn't you fight back at that time? You should be able to defend our attacks.”

        “Yes, but that would add fuel to the tension, wouldn't it?” The eyes of Saint were filled with love and benevolence. Under his watch, Ishtar felt salvation.

        “If it can make you feel at ease, I’m willing to suffer; if I can protect you all, I'm willing to exchange it with my own blood.” Saint used his gentle voice to express tolerance and forgiveness.

        For Ishtar, who only struggled for survival, Saint's words were like a cold spring in the scorching fire, an oasis in the desert, which subverted all her cognitions. Gazing at him, she was eager to listen more, but it was interrupted by a shout nearby.

        “Ishtar! Show yourself! I know you're here! How dare you steal the precious medicine! Do you have any idea how furious the chief is! Come out now, and I’ll plead for leniency.”

 “It’s mother… No, I don’t wanna go back to that ugly and suffering life… I hate it!” Ishtar curled up with fear; a thought then flashed in her mind.

         She grabbed Saint’s arm tightly with determination. “Please, take me...out of here.”

        Saint held back her shaky hands to answer determinedly, “Fear not. We, Eldus, take the responsibility of preaching the truth of the universe. Your wish is heard.”

        Then, Saint brought Ishtar back to the hill, waiting together till dawn. As a result, none of her clan came; the Eldus set off with heavy moods.

        With the spell of protection, Ishtar left safely and witnessed how the meteorites destroyed her homeland. The brilliance of the explosion had been imprinted in her mind, magnificent enough to make her tear.

        As Ishtar was alone, the Eldus did not move her to the other planet, but kept her as one of them. She was assigned to study in an institution where Saint was. Ishtar had been putting in lots of effort to study and catch up, which was proven worthy in her excellent result.

        Every Eldus of the same age had also been nice to Ishtar as a newcomer. Yet for the survival instinct she learnt from the home planet, Ishtar knew their kindness was more apparent than real. The truth behind their smiles was merely an unseen estrangement. Only when she was with Saint could she feel the genuineness in everyone’s eyes.

        “If Saint were not here, I would be nothing. Everyone treats me as a family simply because of Saint.” Somehow, this thought had been deeply implanted in her mind, and all she did was solely for Saint.

        This twisted value made her an excellent Eldus. The outstanding Saint was also regarded as the leader of the younger generation. Both were chosen by the elder to handle alien invasions on other planets. Under Saint’s leadership, the first fight was a victory, successfully banishing the aliens.

        But the issue was not settled yet. The aliens were back again. In order to defend the planet, Saint was assigned to the mission. At the observatory, he took the staff that Ishtar handed over and put his hand on her shoulder.

        “During my absence, I’m counting on you to protect everyone here, Ishtar.”

        “Sure. Consider it done.”

        Ishtar and the young Eldus watched Saint leave. As his figure was gone and she turned to speak to the young ones, she found none of them was looking at her, as if she was nothing. This embarrassing feeling made Ishtar give up the talk and go back to her room.

        “Without Saint, I’m not even one of the Eldus...” Ishtar fell asleep slowly after pondering painfully in bed, but woke up when she heard noises outside.

        “Battle!” 

        The experienced Ishtar knew it was a battle, so she took her weapon to go out and found a bunch of Eldus surrounding a grinning alien male.

        When she was trying to help, two heavily-injured Eldus were falling down with speed, moaning in pain. The alien then wore a taunting smile at her.

        “This guy...is horrible...I can feel it...the experience of death...” Ishtar was occupied with fear, unable to stop trembling.

        “No...Run...I gotta run...” This reminded her of the painful past, running away to the indoor just as then.

        “What can I do? Do I have to fight that guy… No… I can’t win...There is only death for me...But this also means I’m breaking my promise with Saint...Darn it!”

         “Poor thing, maybe I can help you.” A man's voice sounded behind, and Ishtar immediately turned around to guard—the vital aura and the despair in the eyes of the male alien crept her out.

         “Don’t be nervous. I mean no harm...Well, not exactly true, though. It’s me who brings Laplace...Oh, that guy outside, into your planet.” The alien Vorvadoss talked relaxedly, as if he were chit-chatting with Ishtar.

        “Alright then. Let me help you take down that guy, sounds good?” 

        “...Why? Isn’t he your fellow?”

        “It’s because I want to be his number one.” Vorvadoss smiled, “Same like you wanna be one of the Eldus.”

        “You! What are you talking about!” His words made Ishtar mad to retort, with a tight grip on her weapon.

        “Correct? You know better than me. And you have no choice. Accept the defeat or bet on my words.”

        Ishtar bit her lips. Vorvadoss was right. She had no choice.

        “...Tell me what to do.”

        Everything was for her to continue to be Eldus, the identity she had always longed for...
STORY_2498:
Gods & Demons - Ch.8

        When the origin of all things was destroyed by an ancient creature, the source of power was torn apart. A portion of which was turned into darkness, fused with the crushed flesh of the ancient creature, which gave birth to a new form, an embryo. It was North.

        The darkness contained nothing but merely a minimal energy as to the source of power. Despite that, North was unable to take it. The embryo was repeatedly squeezed while regenerating at the same time, reshaping into an incomprehensible form.

        Afterwards, North and the others of its kind were repelled by the power of creation. They came to the other side of the universe, countless light-years away, and entered a state of hypersleep for self-recovery on deserted planets.

        The great power residing in North made it wake up earlier than the other same kind. Crawling out, it performed a mimicry of a jellyfish out of instinct. However, the dark energy inside caused it to transform into a deformed body.

        North did not give up. It experienced the life cycle as a jellyfish, extracted a superior life sequence, and did the same practice of mimicry when it moved into the next planet. Though the result was the same—a deformed body.

        “Why...why do I look so hideous...” Gazing at the reflection of the lake, it had a craving for human form, but the freak look was a total despair.

        Saddened, North put away the imitation, drifting in the vast universe until an iridescent light caught its attention.

        “What is that...Such splendid and captivating...” 

        North was drawn to the iridescence. It turns out to be an embryo trapped in a strange container. 

        “This is...my...kind...my fellow...I need to get it out...” North used its broken hands in an attempt to destroy the container, but it was blocked by some sort of barrier.

        “Annoying...You disappear!” Beclouded with intense desire for destruction, North had a resonance with the power within, releasing the crushing darkness.

        Crack! The container was broken. North carefully held the embryo with both hands. Moving its body, the embryo began to lick the blackish-green skin of North, analyze its life sequence, and mimic.

        The embryo, growing at an amazing speed, emitted silky lights to wrap itself up into an oval pupa. Its pulse was accelerating until the limit was reached. The pupa cracked. 

        Beautifully shaped hands protruded from the gap, and delicate light shone through the fingers like distant stars, twinkling. Soon, a naked body jumped out as the gap was pulled open. He stretched his slender four limbs leisurely; the snowy white was dyed with his smooth and flawless skin; the shimmering veins reflected the dazzling light, constituting an exquisite flesh body.

        Eventually, his delicate face was revealed. The world seemed to stop flowing, and all the colors were concentrated on that unearthly face in an instant.

        “Thank you for saving me, brother.” The man Laplace put on an innocent smile.

        That pure face was able to shake everything in the galaxy. It was all because Laplace was the supreme species that perfectly combined the power of destruction and creation.

        North could not contain the tears; its heart fell into unprecedented tranquility, as if it found its majestic belief.

        “...Such a beautiful existence...It’s the dream I've been chasing...”

        North came to Laplace, kneeling with respect. Then it raised Laplace’s right foot and pressed its rough and uneven face on it. 

        “It’s my honor to serve you, ” said North reverently.

        This was the encounter between North and Laplace.

        Afterwards, they continued to wander the vast universe and met the same species led by Vorvadoss. A battle sparked off, but soon Vorvadoss had surrendered to Laplace after the showdown.

        Despite the same kind, North had proven itself not useful in the battle as it was unable to control its own power. Seeing that all other fellows could perform perfect mimicry, North was getting more and more impatient. One day, eventually, it proposed to leave for Laplace. 

        “Don’t leave, North.” Laplace embraced North, who was much bigger than himself. Even though the sharp surface of North might hurt his delicate skin, Laplace had no intention to let go.

        “I’m always that Laplace you saved. Weak, helpless, and foolish Laplace.”

        “Not true… Laplace is not weak...You’re much stronger than I.” North pushed Laplace away. Looking at the scars it did to him, North’s heart was sinking.

        Laplace shook his head and looked it in the eyes with wisdom.

        “I can evaluate everything but you in the entire universe, North. Your power is beyond my observation. Destroy, destroy and destroy… Even to destroy the nature of destruction itself…         You possess no possibility… But somehow, no possibility is the greatest possibility. So you're unpredictable.”

         Laplace reached out to touch its face. “So you're my only weakness.”

         “But I...can’t help you anything… I don’t deserve to be with you...”

        Angry, Laplace flicked North’s forehead. Then he puffed his cheek with arms akimbo like a child. “I don’t need your help. I just need you to be with me.”

        “...Only stay with you?”

        “Yes, or you don’t want to?”

        “How could I!” North retorted. Satisfied, Laplace nodded and buried his head into its chest. “Then don’t leave me.”

        For a moment of hesitation, North hugged him back, feeling his body warmth. Then its consciousness started fading into a world of darkness.

        “Only under your watch can I feel my existence and happiness.” North sank into the subconscious until a dazzling light hit the eyes.

        It opened its eyes and met the gaze of an unfamiliar face. That person felt relieved and stood back a bit as he knew North woke up.

        “I’m Saint, the Eldus.”

        “Eldus...” North remembered. While it was consuming the planet’s energy with other fellows, a group of aliens named Eldus came to stop them, resulting in a battle. North was used as a shield by its fellow and severely injured by Saint, who then took it to the home planet of the Eldus.

        “What do you want from me!”
 
        “Don’t move. We’ve given you proper treatment. But you still need rest due to your serious condition.” Saint advised in a low voice. “I won’t hurt you. I’m here to listen to your wishes.”

        At the beginning, North refused to talk. With Saint’s perseverance, it finally opened its heart to tell him about the purpose of their kind and its deep thought.

        “No, it’s not just about his effort, but also his true nature. Saint and Laplace are alike. Both possess the charisma to touch everyone’s heart, and I’m no exception.”

        Saint promised to find a way to help North transform into a human form. North was full of hope on that matter. Therefore, when Ishtar came to visit North, it was not wary of her at all.

        “North, your fellow has come to bring you back. Follow me,” Ishtar, the female Eldus, said.

        “Must be Laplace...” North pondered for a moment. “Only he will come to save me.”

        “...Where is Saint?”

        “Saint will be right after us.” Ishtar’s eyes flashed a strange intention, but the pure North was not aware of who followed Ishtar to the destination.

        Suddenly, she stopped to turn around. “Oh, right, Saint needs a part of your body to help stabilize your form.”

        “No problem.” North broke off a pointy part from its elbow and handed it to Ishtar. Gazing at the limb with turbid, green fluid, she took it with a frown. 

        “Let’s keep going, to the end of this staircase.”

        As North was so desperate to meet Laplace, it took the lead to reach the destination. It was a huge platform located at the top of the mountain, with a panoramic view of the surroundings.

        “North!” Laplace, in the midair, took a dive as he saw it. Because of North, Laplace also was unable to foresee what was coming next—

        Four razor-sharp swords were conjured from a spell and pierced through Lapalce’s hands and legs with precision. Temporarily, he lost his mobility, but it was not the end yet. A shadow leapt across North to charge at Laplace and pulled out the green limb—

        Slash! Alongside the soul-wrecking agony, Laplace finally saw that shadow clearly. Ishtar used that limb to stab into his heart precisely, which was the fatal spot of the ancient demons, the place where the embryo grew and lived on. Only their own kind would know their own weakness.

        How did this Eldus know?

        Ishtar tilted her head, whispering to Laplace’s ear before she backed off. 

        Utterly shocked, Laplace then burst into laughter, gazing at North, who was taken aback. That pair of eyes carried no light that North had been admiring for, but was filled with layers of despair. His pale-white face turned ashen in an instant.

        “You betray me because of your own desire...” Laplace’s voice had never been so fragile.

        “I didn’t!” North was at a loss. It was fearful of Laplace’s death while at the urge to vindicate itself, but the consternation in mind made it speechless for a moment. 

        “Don’t deny it. It’s not a fault. You made your own choice, and I won’t hate it nor judge it...” Laplace’s face became paler. “I was unable to observe you in the past. But from now on, I'll never observe you again...”

        “No! Listen to me! It’s not the truth!” North shouted madly. It could accept all the emotions and even the hatred of Laplace towards itself, but when Laplace decided not to observe North anymore, it meant Laplace no longer had any bonding with it. For North, the opposite of love was never hatred. Laplace’s indifference was enough to ruin it.

        North collapsed. It was too late for it to save the dying Laplace, who showed almost no vital signs. “Goodbye, North...” Laplace closed his eyes with a smile.

        “Please...don’t...Laplace...don’t leave me...”

        No matter what North said, silence was the only response.
