STORY_2444:
To Snowball the Maneki-neko, energy saving was the number one rule in her life.

Snowball preferred napping rather than working; She’d rather get fat than exercise; She preferred boredom rather than a motivated life; She’d rather dream than awake. Her creed had never changed even though the landlord had stolen her treasure Koban and trapped her in the Grand Villa.

“Meow～”

Letting out a big yawn, Snowball swayed her tail to get rid of the flies around her. It was the massage shop she was responsible for, yet she closed the shop every day unless the landlord came for inspection. She had been slacking off to a point that the shop sign was covered with spider webs.

Not long ago, the landlord had given the youkai minions a ultimatum, requesting a full house within a week. If they failed to meet the target, all of them would get barbecued. The landlord didn’t know that Snowball was the Maneki-neko if she had her Koban, and of course Snowball would never tell that. She’d rather figure something out on her own than giving the landlord a chance to torture her.

Next day, a new sign was posted in front of the shop, advertising “Massage Snowball the cat! $10 for 1 touch; $90 for 10 touches; $100 for 1 paw touch”. What kind of business was that? What kind of massage shop would ask the guests to massage the shop manager? However, this business mode actually worked——a bunch of youths crowded into the shop, where Snowball was lying at the center stretching.

“Master Snowball you’re the cutest creature I’ve ever seen! I can finally touch you after waiting for half a day!” A young girl expressed her admiration to Snowball.


“Meow～”

After an idle meow, Snowball the white cat slightly raised her paw, as if a queen was summoning her servants. Her gesture made the girl blush, who reached her trembling hand. The moment she touched the paw, she rejoiced like a melting ice-cream with a face full of delight.

“How...How lucky I am to touch Master Snowball’s paw...It’s soft and squishy like cotton candy…”

The comment from the girl heated up the atmosphere, making everyone fight for the next touch. At this moment, Snowball rolled over to reveal her tummy. This simple move drove everyone in the shop crazy. Some girls screamed and passed out from the overwhelming sensation; Some boys had a severe nosebleed that put them into a coma.

“It’s...It’s the legendary soft tummy of Master Snowball…!”

“AHH! I’m getting blinded! How wonderful this is!”

While the shop was crowded with people, an anguish gaze stared at the shop——Furry the Komainu, also a youkai minion of the Grand Villa. Threatened by the landlord’s ultimatum, Furry decided to bring down all the other youkais.

Furry used to believe that Snowball would not be a threat because of her laziness. If he hadn’t come over to double check, he wouldn’t have believed what he saw. Not only the shop was full of guests, but it was the easy money Snowball made that pissed Furry the most.

“Why would someone pay to massage that fat cat...What kind of world is this!?” The furious Furry took a short sprint to shoot an ice spike at Snowball. Luckily, Furry was too angry to make a precise shot. Still, it scratched Snowball’s tail.

“MEOW——!”

Just when Furry started feeling good, he sensed pairs of angry eyes targeting him. The resentment was so strong that it made Furry quiver. Looking closely, Furry realized that all of them were from the guests inside the massage shop…

“How dare you hurt Master Snowball…”

“I will break every bone of yours…”

“Die…!”

The enraged crowd stormed out of the shop to hunt the “criminal”, and none of them forgot to pay before leaving the shop. Meanwhile, Snowball licked her tail pitifully and fell asleep next second. 

“Woooooooof! You damned cat——! I will be back!” Running for life, Furry could only yell in his heart.
STORY_2445:
Inside the kimono rental store of “Grand Villa”, the hot spring tourist attraction, a gorgeous lady in a kimono was lying on the couch. Her loose clothes offered a fair display of shoulders and bosom, showing her curves perfectly. The faint mist inside the room made her even sexier and appealing.

        She was surrounded by a group of men of all ages. The one thing in common was that they were handsome. All of them were serving the only lady in the room, trying to impress her by fulfilling every request of hers, from serving her meals to preparing her bath. They were willing to give everything to the apple of their eyes.

        “Cough cough...My beautiful Hana-san.”

        Furry the komainu was choked by the smoke as soon as he entered the store, and he finally stated the purpose of his visit after a while of coughing, “You’re the most beautiful youkai I’ve ever seen. There’s no one who can be more charming than you…”

        “So? What do you want from me?” Hana the gorgeous youkai glanced at Furry.

        “I...I don’t wanna die. Hana-san, please help me in bringing more revenue to my shop!”

        The landlord, the owner of “Grand Villa”, ordered the youkais to make the business thrive within a week. The one with least revenue will be barbecued. And now all the youkais were doing everything they could to survive.

        Furry had tried to sabotage the others’ plans but all his attempts had failed, so he came to Hana this time with his only skills——flattery.

        “Oh, right,” said Hana.

        Furry was thrilled as he thought it was a yes from Hana, but his hope was shattered right away.

        “Not interested. What good does it do to me? What can you offer?”

        Hana giggled.

        “I’m doing good here. Although that useless landlord took my treasure away, my customers here give me money and I can buy the kimonos I love...I have enough income to sustain the store. The landlord is the only one who doesn’t know about it.”

        When Hana was done speaking, she went back to flirt with the men. Meanwhile, Furry was surprised by how she tamed the male creatures inside the room.

        Furry shook his head to clear his mind, and he asked, “Then what can I do to talk you into this?”

        “Ten men. Oh no.” Hana counted with her fingers and said, “bring me one thousand men for the greeting gift. Then ten thousand more. By then, we’ll talk.”

        “Are you messing with me…?”

        The impossible request provoked Furry, who still didn’t like to be played in spite of his brown-nose nature.

        “Aw, men are willing to be messed by me, aren’t they?”

        When Hana was done speaking, someone moaned under her.

        Furry didn’t notice a man under Hana until now. Despite being the human chair, the man was not in pain at all, as if this was the best treatment he could ever get from Hana. He looked so happy and blissful.

        “Darn it! You think I don’t know your weak spot!? Take this!” Furry was pissed after all the failures and embarrassments. He conjured a water stream, flushing towards Hana.

        It wasn’t a strong current but it accomplished what Furry wanted——exposing Hana’s lower body underneath the kimono. To the men’s surprise, it wasn’t a pair of long legs but a snake tail!

        Petrified at first, all the men fled as soon as they realised that Hana was a snake youkai.

        Only Furry and the soaking wet Hana were left in the store. While Furry was gloating over Hana’s misfortune, Hana was enraged by the messed-up store, the loss of her male pets and the dirts on her beloved kimonos…

        “How dare you mess up my kimonos…”

        The pupils of Hana narrowed, exuding the hostility of a snake.

        “...Unforgivable!”

        As Hana was done speaking, she shifted back to the snake form to attack Furry, who dodged the bite and counterattacked by shooting a spike at her. With a flip, Hana counteracted the attack.

        However, they were much weaker without their treasures. Although it sounded like a fierce battle, it was actually a fight between two petty youkais. Coincidentally, their actions broke the wooden floor underneath, which had cracks already. The two youkais then fell into a secret basement. 

        “Huh? What’s this?”

        Furry spotted a chest, and the angry Hana retorted, “It’s just an old box.”

        When Furry opened the chest, he shouted in surprise, “My fortune ball!”

        Hana came over as she was curious about Furry’s reaction. It was the youkais’ treasures that were stored inside the chest! Their slavery had only begun because the landlord had taken away their treasures, and the treasures had been under their feet all along!

        “What happened?”

        The other youkais in the villa came over as they heard the chaos, and this visit led them back to their treasures! Now all the youkais were freed from the slavery. What a piece of good news!

        “Right, before we leave...Furry, do you remember? You stole our lunchboxes before…” Hibiki scowled at Furry.

        “Daruma...Daruma!” (He framed me for breaking the landlord’s vase!)” Dadaru was rolling on the ground angrily.

        “Speaking of which, he made my kimono dirty…” Hana hissed at Furry with a fake smile.

        “Let’s take down the vermont here first!”

        The present youkais had Furry cornered, everyone approached him hostilely. 

        “Everyone calm down. I didn’t do them on purpose back then…” Furry panicked.

        “Everyone, GO!” As Hana commanded, all the youkais pounced on Furry together.

        “AHHHHHHH——!!” Furry fled the scene while screaming.

        To the other youkais, this was a lucky day that marked the end of their slavery; yet to Furry, this was the day when karma landed on him.
STORY_2543:
Having been through twists and turns, Jack and Elizabeth finally patched up their relationship. For them it was a beautiful thing of course, but for Ed, it was the beginning of a nightmare —— meaning that Ed would be forced to watch them coquet with each other every, single, day.

        One day, Ed had fed up with this couple. Coincidentally it was the joyful night, so he decided to go out early with the Pumpkin Trio in order to stay away from those two clingy love birds. 

        “Damn. Jack and Elizabeth never cared about my feelings! Agree?”

        Ed asked the Pumpkin Trio as he put both hands on the back of his head with a tut. The Pumpkins were supposed to say yes, but one asked a tricky question. “Is it because master you're still single? You feel uncomfortable to see them in pairs all the time?” 

        “Of course not! I only fancy killing, no more!!” Ed retorted. Today he came to this town seeking that pure pleasure, but something off had happened.

        “Sigh, the street should be bustling at this time.”

        Ed was disappointed at the empty street, but soon he put on a smile. “So be it. Humans are many anyway. Let me find another town after a rest,” he thought. Then Ed took the Pumpkin Trio into an abandoned house for a short break.

        As soon as they sat down, a shadow rushed in and bit one of the Pumpkins hard, who couldn't help screaming. Without a single word, Ed drew his rapier targeting at the enemy's head. However, it was a miss. The enemy was agile enough to take the damage with an arm. Although the arm was cut off, the enemy managed to flee the scene with such a heavy injury. 

        “Able to avoid my lethal strike. Interesting.” Ed was intrigued by the battle. “However my rapier is coated with anesthetic. There is no way you can hide from me.” He gazed at the weapon with a confident grin.

        Ed followed the blood trail to the woods and found the target——a girl. She was lying on the ground, trembling. Apparently the potency kicked in.

        Ed grabbed her head, preparing for the climax of the killing. Suddenly, he felt pain in his palm. The girl, unwilling to give up, was biting Ed hard with a last ditch effort. Despite the verge of death, she still resisted. Her perseverance had impressed Ed for the first time. 

        When he got close to her, the girl even tried to bite his nose. Luckily Ed was one step faster to avoid it.

        “Such a tenacious human.”

        Ed looked the girl in the eyes——Even though she was seriously injured and held hostage, she seemed to be going to fight with the last bit of strength. Her eyes were still bright, as if there was blazing flame swaying inside. Ed was deeply attracted by this incredible feeling.

        “What is this? I've never felt such a strong feeling...”

        “Very well! I'll take you back!”

        However, the lady could not hear his words anymore, for she had already passed out due to the anesthetic. At this moment, Ed picked the lady up and was about to return——

        “Put down the lady!”

        A loud shout stopped his action. Then a few ferocious demons revealed behind Ed. “This is the territory of our lord! No trespassing!”

        “Well well, who decided that?” Ed flashed a smile and then vanished into thin air in front of them. Next second, he held the demon heads in his hands. “Hoho, screw the lord.”

        As the demons were eliminated, Ed took the lady back and healed her wound.

        “Master, are you going out tonight?”

        “Master, we haven't had fun on a joyful night for a long time. I'm so bored!”

        cMaster, are you not feeling well?”

        Facing the squeaky questions of the Pumpkin Trio, Ed only gave a short answer. “Shut up.” Then he sat down under a tree for a break.

        Ever since bringing the girl back, Ed had stopped complaining about the flirtation between Jack and Elizabeth, nor did he take to the streets for his joyful night. Instead, Ed wandered around in the cemetery all day; otherwise he would sit under the tree and take a nap, which he hadn't found boring at all, for he now had a new entertainment.

        “Whoosh!” As soon as Ed heard the rustle in his sleep, he took a swift turn to evade a  coming arrow in the head.

        “Ha, what a pity. You failed again.” He threw a sarcasm with a smile.  “How many times have you tried today?” 

        The lady walked out from a tombstone with a long face and a crossbow in her hand. Although she only had one hand leftr, she could aim and shoot steadily. Still,  unfortunately it missed.

        “Three times. Never mind. Tomorrow you'll be dead.” After leaving the curse, the lady went into the house.

        Looking at her flying hair, Ed smiled. “Alright, keep it on.” 

        So Ed began to think about the beginning of this game.

        That day he brought this severely-injured lady back home for the cure. She woke up and found herself being kidnapped and even losing an arm. Since then, she had become dejected. No talking, no eating, until death.

        Jack and Elizabeth thought that Ed was going to torture her for fun when he brought this lady home. Yet Ed had no such intention at all.

        On the third day the lady woke up, he talked to her. “Let's play a game. Since I’m always the hunter, now I’ll let you be the hunter to hunt me down.” 

        Shocked, the lady finally opened her eyes to look at him.

        “When you recover, I’ll give you 3 chances a day to kill me. As long as you can do it, you can leave freely, and my men won't stand the way. I won't tie you up nor lock you down. If you dare to run away, I'll find you and kill you.” 

        “...” 

        “What do you think? Are you in?” 

        The lady remained silent, but the flames ignited again in her dim eyes.

        She quickly recovered to get out of bed and started the hunting game. Repeated failures would only make her fighting spirit higher and Ed's mood happier. 

        After the flashback, it was already sunset. When Ed was about to get up, he felt pain in the cheek. It seems that the arrow had stretched his face.

        “Oh, she's improving.” 

        The next morning, Ed walked out of the house, and another arrow immediately came right towards him. He moved agilely to dodge, but saw that the crossbow was automatically triggered by a mechanism fixed on the tree.

        What's coming next was a shadow striking from nowhere with a gleaming blade, which had caught Ed off guard, who blocked the attack instinctively with his arm; blood was splattered on the ground.

        The lady landed and spoke coldly, “This is the first time today.” Then she left without looking back.

※※

        “It's too dangerous. The wound was cut to bone.” Jack mumbled as he stitched. “Why would you play this game with her?” 

        “It's fun, much funnier than the joyful night.” Ed continued, “Until now I just realized it's that interesting to be a prey. I love this feeling.” 

        “Interesting where? Are you simply looking for excitement?” 

        “No.” 

        Not for excitement indeed. Ed just liked the look in the lady's eyes when she attacked him, like when she cut his arm in the morning.

        Her gaze was sharp and blazing.

        By seeing that pair of eyes, he could sense his own meaning of existence. That's the way to make him hot-blooded.

        Indulged in his own thought, Ed was hyper with a smile, which had given Jack a shock as he had never seen Ed like that.

        It was too dangerous for a killer to have such kind of emotion. Jack could not help but worry about him.

        “Ed, Ed!” Jack waved his hand to drag his attention back. “Better be careful. With her speed of improvement, you'll soon die in her hands!” 

        Then Ed put on a brighter smile. 

        “Isn't it good?” 

        “Huh?”

        “Finished right? Thanks bro!” 

        Jack heaved a sigh as he saw Ed leave.

        “Idiot. You aren't into the game. You’re into that lady!” 

※

        “Brave one. You want to have a face-off with me?” 

        Ed's arm had recovered, playing with his rapier. “Master is the best!” “Kill her!” The Pumpkin Trio jeered.

        “I've fed up with assassination. This time I want a fair fight.” The lady replied.

        “As you wish!” 

        So the fierce battle began. While the two were focusing on the fight, they were unaware that a malicious stare was targeting Ed.

        It was the lord of the demons. It came to revenge for his lost fellows as Ed invaded the territory.

        The lord concentrated its demonic power on the palm, targeting Ed from behind.

        “DIE!” 

        During the deathmatch, the lady glanced at a strong beam firing at Ed; without hesitation, she pounced to push him away and took the damage for him.

        Ed was helpless to watch her petite body penetrated by the beam and lie down. Without mercy, he sprinted towards the lord at high speed and hacked the demon to death instantly.

        Back to where he was, Ed picked up the lady.

        “Why did you save me?” 

        For the very first time, the lady smiled at him; in the meantime, blood started to come out from her mouth.

        “Of course...because I need to kill you myself...”

        The eyes that Ed once so cared about had closed for good.

        Since then, Ed had returned to the streets at night, looking for his joyful night's toys, and also looking for another pair of eyes similar to those of the lady.
STORY_2545:
“My hometown, I’m back.”

        After years of travel, Atlantis finally returned to his hometown. He became more weary than before he had left. Staring at the olive tree on the route to his home, Atlantis had a flashback of holding Athena into his arms under the tree. 

        For a moment, he missed them.

        “The past is in the past.”

        Despite the thought, Atlantis’ body acted against his mind, approaching the tree step by step. While he was reaching a tree branch, a slim pale arm cut in and grasped the branch before he did. Too late to react, Atlantis’ hand already landed on her tenderness.

        The shocked Atlantis traced the owner of the pale arm. What he saw was someone with shiny blond hair and a pair of emerald eyes. At that moment, he stopped breathing and his heart skipped a beat. Meanwhile, a word slipped out of his mouth.

        “Athena?”

        “Huh? Athena? Oh, you’re right. Everybody said that this tree is Goddess Athena’s favorite,” said the blond girl with a heart-warming smile, shifting her glance at their contacting hands.

        “I..I’m sorry.” Atlantis let go of the girl’s hand as he realized the inappropriateness. 

        Atlantis didn’t get to take a proper look at the girl until now. The girl was cute indeed, but she appeared to be different from Athena. Still, there was a moment when the girl had resembled Athena in his eyes. 

        “Ahaha, it’s okay. Right! Can you please pluck that branch for me?” The girl asked Atlantis sincerely for a favor as she pointed at a lush olive branch. Atlantis, who nodded, picked the branch with ease and handed it to her. 

        “Thanks. This branch is perfect. I gotta go back to work now, See you in a bit.”

        After farewelling Atlantis, the girl picked up the flowers on the ground and left in a hurry.

        “Atlantis, what’s wrong with you?”

        Atlantis shook his head to lose the stray thought. Then he continued his way back home. 

        He sensed something off as soon as he stepped into the house.

        When Atlantis rubbed the window ledge with his fingertip, not even a tiny dust could be found on his skin. How could his house stay clean after all these years he had left? Next second, he glimpsed at a bouquet on the dining table.

        “Oh! I forgot it here after the chores this morning. No wonder I couldn’t find it in my house!” Someone spoke while coming into the house——the girl Atlantis had run into just before!

        “Huh? You? Why are you here?” The girl spotted the presence of the confused Atlantis.

        “...Because this is my home.”

        “WHAT! Mr. House Owner, you’re finally home!” 

        The surprised voice of the girl echoed over the house, and she continued as if she had been waiting for a long time, “What a good timing for me to be here. Look, I’ve put all your belongings here.”

        She started making Atlantis’ bed before he said anything.

        It turned out that it was this girl who had been cleaning his house all these years. She had been having the thought that the owner must be pleased once he returned to this clean and neat house.

        “Thank you so much.” 

        A heart-moving warmth filled Atlantis as he had never expected that there was someone waiting for his return.

        “You’re welcome. I read your books without your permission too although I don’t quite get them. Haha,” said the girl.

        “Everyone has its own talent. See, you have a pair of crafting hands that can make beautiful bouquets. And that’s something I’m incapable of,” said Atlantis, handing the bouquet over to the girl.

        “Thank you,” the girl replied with a lovely bright smile, as if getting praised by Atlantis was the sweetest blessing in the world.

        “Although this is my job, I feel grateful to be a part of someone else’s joy when I make wedding bouquets.”

        “I get you. I used to work hard for the betterment of everyone’s life.”

        Yet the good old days were all gone.

        For a second, there was a hint of woe in Atlantis’ gaze, but he concealed the feeling right away and reached his right hand to the girl.

        “I’m Atlantis. Nice to meet you.” Atlantis gave a charming smile after inhaling deeply.

        “Alright. I’m Minerva.” Minerva held back his hand enthusiastically.

        Since then, Atlantis had regressed to a simple life. Living in the town, he often shared his knowledge acquired during the travel; Minerva would be his company from time to time.

        One day, Minerva barged into Atlantis’ place with a thrill. She gave him no chance in refusal and dragged him out of the house.

        “Come with me! The wedding I’ve been helping with is starting soon!” Minerva was super excited.

        When Atlantis arrived at the wedding venue by Minerva’s drag, a group of ladies were gathering for the bouquet toss. 

        “The wedding bouquet represents joyfulness. The lore told that a lady who can catch the bouquet will be blessed by the bride’s joy,” Minerva explained to Atlantis.

        The bouquet of blessing drew a perfect parabola in the air, landing on Atlantis’ hands who stood away from the crowd. Stunned at first, he then gave it to Minerva.

        “Will the blessing be doubled if the bouquet returns to the crafter?” Atlantis asked.

        Staring at the bouquet, Minerva blushed all over her face.

        “...That means a marriage proposal when a man gives the wedding bouquet to a lady.”

        “Huh? I...I’m sorry…” The blushing Atlantis scratched his cheek in awkwardness.

        “None taken. I know you didn’t mean that. You’ve been away for too long to know this tradition…” Minerva mumbled, burying her face into the bouquet.

        Just when Atlantis was worrying if Minerva would be out of breath, she lifted her head briskly, offering the bouquet back to Atlantis. 

        “But Atlantis, the days with you are the best time in my life...I...I’m in love with you!” 

        With her eyes closed, the shy Minerva spoke her thoughts out loud.

        It had always been Atlantis’ wish to fall for an ordinary girl. Meanwhile, Minerva’s genuine confession somehow reminded him of Athena.

        Minerva kept on as she saw the loving look on Atlantis, “I’ve been dreaming of you ever since we met...I dreamt of us working on blueprints, the image of you making essential oil, and the scene of us chatting under the olive tree...Things that never happened but they felt so real. I believe that they must be our future.”

        Atlantis quivered in shock.

        “Those are the things I’ve been through with Athena. How did she know? ...Is it just a coincidence? Or is fate setting me up with her so that I can forget Athena? Will the long-bleeding wound be healed if I accept her love?”

        While Atlantis was still processing a series of questions, words had already rushed out of his mouth.

        “I’m sorry, Minerva. I’m already in love with someone else.

        “I guess that’s why you were sad when you were looking at the olive tree…”

        The traumatic refusal drove the tears out of Minerva’s eyes. Even so, she managed to pick herself up and encourage Atlantis with an authentic smile.

        “It’s hard to fall for someone. If you love her, just confide your heart to her like I did.”

        Something inside Atlantis was finally answered when he heard Minerva’s words. It had always been her. For all these years, she was always lingering in his heart. His wound might have healed if he had accepted Minerva, but the scar that contained the memories of her would always be there. Always. 

        “Even though I know it hurts, she has always been on my mind. My heart still races for her…”

        As Atlantis had finally figured himself out, he farewelled Minerva, preparing to hit the road again. When he was passing by the olive tree, a shaky old man came over to talk.

        “Young man, since you stop for this tree every day, let me tell you a miracle.”

        “Athena the Goddess of Wisdom once lived in this town years ago, and she was separated from her lover because of the difference between a god and a human. When she lost her love, she cried under this tree before returning to the realm of gods. However, her tears gave birth to a baby girl. Everyone just treats her as another orphan and no one believes in me!”

        “Baby girl...Is she the one who sells bouquets…” Atlantis started questioning.

        “Yes, the girl you gave the bouquet to!” The old man rubbed his chin.

        Everything made sense to Atlantis now, which explained Minerva’s dreams about the memories between him and Athena.

        “Athena...She fell in love with me, an inferior human being, regardless of her divine status, and all I gave in return was pushing her away…”

        The realization had given a big hit to Atlantis’ soul, crushing him with immense heartache. He regretted, regretting not hearing Athena out; All he saw was nothing but an arrogant self in the past.

        “I won’t hide from my true feelings anymore. Even if it takes me to travel every corner of the realm, I will find Athena and confide myself to her!”
STORY_2546:
After Scrubia had awakened Beowulf, they went on a journey to find the cure for her nightmare. At last, they found Idun and learned the cause of Scrubia’s nightmare from her—the faint dragon soul in Scrubia was a part of Nidhogg.

        Idun wasn’t able to remove it, while Beowulf and Scrubia weren’t strong enough to climb up the Enochian Tower where Nidhogg was. So they looked around for the clues about the dragon soul instead.

        One day, they went into the woods after hearing about a relic of a primordial dragon there. By the time they arrived, it was already sundown so they stopped at a village nearby for the night.

        Sitting on the side of the bed, Beowulf watched Scrubia sleep—he had gotten used to it—so that she would have someone on her side when she woke up from the nightmare, the same nightmare that caused her suffering over the years.

        Under the slightly pale moonlight, Beowulf ran his fingers through Scrubia’s hair gently. The power of the dragon soul resonated through the ends of her hair, bringing him peace of mind as usual.

        However, that tranquillity was soon shattered—Beowulf felt a sudden commotion in his chest with a sense of searing heat sweeping over him!

        “I’ve found it! The one I’ve been looking for… is right outside! Right at my fingertips!”

        Beowulf had no idea what he was looking for but his body stood up involuntarily as if it was controlled by another mind. Then he walked out of the hotel and ran towards the woods, leaving Scrubia and the fallen chair behind.

        Following his instinct, he kept running forward against the cutting leaves and the spiky thorns, as if he was chasing a lost soul.

        As the sense of searing heat grew stronger, he knew that he was getting closer to what he desired. Eventually, he saw it—a slender and graceful figure in the moonlight standing among the ruins at the end of the woods.

        As white as the first snowfall, her long hair fluttered in the breeze with a touch of forlorn solitude that was yet thriving tenaciously in the crack amongst the debris of decay.

        Solely with her presence, that woman brought life to these dilapidated ruins which went beyond the description of beauty or hideousness.

        Beowulf’s chest rose and fell vigorously; scalding tears fell from his eyes uncontrollably, just like a returned prodigal son and a lost child that finally found his way home.

        However, he didn’t dare to make a sound nor move, worried that even his breath would break this moment so he could hold his breath strenuously.
　　
        Still, the woman found him. As she turned her face, her azure eyes slightly widened when she saw Beowulf. She seemed surprised, yet soon composed. All her emotions eventually turned into light words.

        ‘It’’s you…’

        ‘It’s me…’ With tears rolling down his face, Beowulf dropped to his knees and held his hand palm-up as though he was trying to grasp or embrace something. Then he murmured like a mad man, ‘I’ve found you… I’ve finally found you… My dearest—— No, that isn’t me… I… Who am I…’

        A flood of memories flashed across Beowulf’s mind——

        A golden figure flew across the boundless universe. With a swing of its tail, it left a trace on the cosmic canvas, followed by stardust gathering on it. Closing its eyes, it then raised its hands and shaped the stardust. In a flash, a flat planet was formed. As it stretched its body and circled the asteroid, greenery spurted on the planet.

        Beowulf was fascinated by that creature’s picturesque posture, yet soon someone broke his thought——

        ‘The corrupt warriors! Are you here for your judgment?’ Accompanied by Tyr’s interrogation, his long sword was shattered into pieces… That scene of Gods holding their swords against him because of the demonic blood jolted his hatred for them.

        However, another voice emerged and invaded his mind, with mounting anger that turned into a dragon growl—just like the one of Nidhogg—‘ROARRR——!’

        The crisscrossing memories bewildered Beowulf, nearly ripping his mind into shreds.

        “His body and mind are too fragile and weak that he still can’t beat such a transcendent existence even though that is just one piece in a million…” At long last, the woman stretched her hand to Beowulf after a while of ponderation——
STORY_2547:
Ever since Thetis was tethered to Achilles’s body, her mind had been gradually contaminated by Achilles’s resentment and became the warlord on the battlefield. Whenever there was a battlefield, that crimson figure would be there, wiping out everything in his sight. Until one day, Thetis’s memory slowly slid into his heart.

        He then recalled that he was just a tool created by Gods.

        The clash of divine power and demonic power inside Achilles’s body made his mind drift between sanity and madness. However, there was not a moment when Achilles had ever forgotten his hatred for Gods.

        He was born of divine power;
He died in compliance with the plan of Gods;
He was then resurrected under the will of Gods.
Yet, his mother, who gave birth to him, told him he was wrong and wanted to take back his life.

        Like a plotted show, Achilles’s fate—from his birth to his death—was never held on his own hands, not even a second. Slaughter was the only moment when he felt like himself instead of a pawn of Gods. He loathed all Gods; yet the one to whom he held the deepest hatred was the creator of his flesh—his mother, Thetis.

        ‘Die!’ Following a swing of Achilles’s weapon, a soldier's head flew through the air.

        At this moment, he was leading an army of Demons to invade a town that worshiped the God of the Sun, Apollo, who saw all humans as his servants; who killed Achilles and let him watch as his companions die.

        Achilles broke through the town gate easily. As he swung his sword and slain everyone before him, he could feel the commotion of the demonic blood inside his heart. Seeing the human disciples who were still shouting Apollo’s name until their last breath, he let out a scornful laugh loudly.

        “Gods save the people? No, they only see us as livestock and their tools!”

        What lay behind Achilles was an ocean of blood and carcasses. With a riotous laugh, he slashed and beheaded the bronze statue of Apollo.

        Buildings were on fire; Demons were looting everywhere while screams of humans were echoing through the town. All of these gave Achilles pleasure. Just then, a hail of light arrows descended from the sky and shot all the Demons in the town accurately.

        Achilles raised the shield of Thetis to block the attack, only to find a God with white hair was looking down on him in the air. Then, troops of God soldiers came in all directions and beleaguered him.

        ‘Demon, I won’t let you take another innocent life!’ said Bael, firmly and righteously.

        Yet, the siege of the soldiers was nothing to Achilles. The only thing he saw was that God looking down on everything from high above. At that very moment, monstrous hatred flared up inside him.

        With all his strength, Achilles threw the shield of Theis into the air and leaped at the same time, disregarding the light arrows hitting him. Still, he failed to reach that God high above even with his best jump.

        In mid-air, Achilles stepped on the shield that he had tossed, kicked hard, and made another leap—his hands grasped Bael’s wings tightly…

‘I’VE GOT YOU!’

        With a swirl of sand, the God and Demon spun in the air and eventually fell to the ground hard, leaving a big hole.
　　
        Soon, the sand scattered, revealing the scene behind where Achilles held down Bael. Just the moment when Achilles was about to finish Bael off, a blast of blinding blue light hit him. That blow was so powerful that knocked him unconscious. 

        Then, a blue-haired goddess in eastern clothing slowly descended into the battlefield.

        As the Goddess of Order, Giemsa felt a strange and distorted divine power so she sent her avatar to the realm of humans for inspection and happened to see the scene when Achilles was going to kill Bael.

        ‘Goddess Giemsa…’

        ‘I can feel the presence of god in this demon. This is unusual. Let me take him back to the realm of gods and take a look.’ Leaving these words, Giemsa then manipulated her avatar to bring Achilles back to the realm of gods…
STORY_2548:
Ever since that night, glimmers of blacklight turned into the strongest warrior and the green figure with two lances returned to the battlefield. Indulged in the pleasure of slaughter, he only simmered down under the starry sky…

        One night, Diarmuid walking in the jungle. Suddenly, he caught a glimpse of a faint light floating across the woods. Then a maiden’s figure in his memory resurfaced, stirring his heart.

        ‘Master, are you missing her?’ asked Amor, one of the lance spirits.

        Just as Diarmuid was going to answer her, he was astounded by the growing number of floating lights and convinced that he had come to that corner in his memory again—the garden of fireflies, a secret place that he and Isabel went to when they eloped.

        Memories came flooding back…

        ‘I will always love you and stay loyal to you no matter what, until eternity.’

        Looking Diarmuid in the eye, Isabel made her wedding vow under the moonlight and the eye of the two lances. The two had a secret wedding that no one knew during their run. Isabel then danced on a dilapidated stone platform. It was a dance that Diarmuid would never forget.

        Just then, some light glimmers followed as she swung her hands. With a spin, Isabel held the glimmers on her palms curiously.

        ‘Are they elves? Sea elves? Flower elves?’ Isabel followed the flowing light in excitement. As she waved her hands in the woods, Diarmuid immediately walked over. Countless stars were floating under the dark shadow of the trees—they were not elves but fireflies. Landing on Isabel, they embellished her beauty with extra grace…

        ‘I remember that you were also looking for the elves when we first met,’ said Diarmuid.

        ‘When I was small, my family brushed me aside, but I was never lonely because the elves in the garden always chatted with me. And now I’m not alone anymore, because I have you by my side.’

        Hearing Isabel’s words, Diarmuid couldn’t help but draw her into his arms. The latter also wrapped her arms around his waist and asked him to dance with her. Following their rhythm, the fireflies danced in the woods.

        At that moment, the two left their fate of being pursued behind their mind. Under the milky way, the two love birds pranced freely with one accord, weaving their own future…

        ‘This is our secret garden.’ Diarmuid was lost in memory lane.

        He only came back to his senses when he caught an unpleasant smell and found the burning jungle in front of him…
STORY_2549:
Yoshitsune’s power was greatly amplified after he got the two swords, Imanotsurugi and Usumidori. To test his true power, he started wandering around the Tarones, looking for the best battlefield for him. One day, he found a troop of God soldiers patrolling, so he drew his swords and charged at them.

        Wielding the pairs of dark swords, Yoshitsune stabbed a God soldier with such an incredible speed that the soldier collapsed before he could even pull out his weapon. However, Imanotsurugi and Usumidori were still disgruntled; their voices kept whispering in Yoshitsune’s head.

        “Too weak,” said Imanotsurugi.
        “Too slow,” said Usumidori.
        “How can you defeat Lü Bu if that’s all you got?” Together they sounded like two haunting ghosts.

        The name of Lü Bu ignited a dark flame in Yoshitsune’s heart. Despite the fact that he was resurrected by the demonic blood of Lü Bu, he also fell in the palm of the latter’s hand because of it and became his lackey.

        Resentful, Yoshitsune broke free from the demonic blood and found the dark swords of Impulsion. Still, he couldn’t defeat Lü Bu, who didn’t even regard him as an evenly matched enemy.

        “Then, what am I…”

        ‘Lü-Bu! Ahhh!’ In Yoshitsune’s eyes, the soldiers before him all took on the appearance of Lü Bu. With a mounting killing intent, an inexhaustible flow of evil pneuma came from his body. Each swing of his swords was twice as fast as before.

        Growling in a low voice, Yoshitsune fended off a soldier’s long spear with the long sword in his left hand while the short sword in his right hand abruptly moved and gashed another soldier’s face. Like a warrior that had gone off the deep end, he knocked down the remaining soldiers one after one.

        Yoshitsune’s slaughter only came to an end when all the soldiers dropped. As he looked at his bloodstained hands, a gleam of madness rose in his eyes.

        “I’m almost there… I just need to be a little bit stronger. Then I shall be able to take down Lü Bu.”

        Yoshitsune’s desire to defeat Lü Bu gradually became a dreadful obsession. He could always hear Lü Bu’s mockery of him, even though he was never around him. When he returned to the White Queen’s castle, he looked accursed, pondering on something with a stream of evil pneuma hovering around him.

        ‘Yoshitsune!’

        ‘Snowdrop… What is it?’

        ‘Yoshitsune… I’ve called you many times but you didn’t respond to me. I’m deeply worried about you.’

        ‘I… I’m just a bit tired… I’m fine.’

        Intending to wash his face, Yoshitsune then walked to the bathroom in the castle only to see the pale reflection of himself in the mirror.

        Shortly after, the reflection of him in the mirror distorted and turned into Lü Bu.

        ‘Lü…Bu… AHHH!’

        “You’re too weak,” the voice of Lü Bu echoed in his head.

        The White Queen, who heard Yoshitsune’s roar, came to the bathroom only to find him hitting the mirror with his fists like mad.

        ‘Ahhhhhhhh!!’ As an overwhelming gust of evil pneuma surged from Yoshitsune’s body, all the glasses in the bathroom shattered in a split second.

        Not knowing what had happened, the White Queen could only take him in her arms and said, ‘Yoshitsune, I’m here.’

        The warm embrace brought Yoshitsune back to his senses. With his eyes regaining their clearness, Yoshitsune, who wanted to ease the White Queen’s worries, said, ‘I was just a bit annoyed, but I’m okay now.’

        Little did they know that the two dark swords, Imanotsurugi and Usumidori, were expressing their utter disdain for Yoshitsune outside the bathroom.

        ‘Is such a weak man worth to be called as our master?’ Imanotsurugi asked Usumidori.
        ‘No.’
        ‘Then, it only makes sense if we take his body for our own good, right?’
STORY_2550:
On the disorderly battlefield, a wounded soldier was getting up from the ground only to see a terrifying scene—several soldiers were knocked flying in the air, and falling in his direction! Bang! He was crushed beneath the pile of soldier bodies which could be seen everywhere in the field. Yet, what knocked them flying were no weapons or cannons but the blasts of wind caused by the war between the two people in the center!

        ‘Neigh——’ The skeletal horse reared up with a cry. On its back was the bedemoned Lü Bu, who held out his halberd. With his eyes filled with blood lust, he then rode forward.

        Celestial Supremacy, on the hand, took the horse stance with a spinning ball of green light in his palm, showing no intention to escape. He stared at the horse’s hoofs to read its movement, then he threw a punch in the ground, creating a depression that tripped the skeletal horse. The horse fell forward hard, so hard that made a mud track behind it.

        Yet, Lü Bu, who had foreseen that, jumped off before the skeletal horse fell, raised his halberd, and slashed at his opponent! Boom! As the blast of purple mist rocked the soil, Lü Bu found that his attack missed. Suddenly, a spin kick came at him from the side. He squatted to avoid it but failed to notice that abnormally powerful green light behind him——

        Cling! His halberd was knocked into the air and eventually plunged straight into the ground after several spins…

        Just then, a red electric spark buzz in the flying dust. Finding his opponent and himself both took a step back, Lü Bu discovered the thing standing between them was, astonishingly, a poker card!

        ‘Hearty! What are you doing here?!’ Lü Bu recognized that it was the power of the Queen of Hearts at the first glance.

        ‘It’s not the right time to chat.’ The Queen of Hearts emerged from the sand and dust with a pair of giant flaring claws facing their opponent, Celestial Supremacy.

        Ever since the Queen of Hearts found that Lü Lingshuang was back to Lü Bu, she knew she could not bring down his murderous desire no matter how so she no longer attempted to stop him with magic.

        However, the anxiety in her heart only grew since the birth of their child; she was afraid that the child’s father might die on the battlefield someday. So she tried to use their daughter as an excuse to keep Lü Bu around, hoping the days he spent with their daughter would make a change…

        When their daughter was born, Lü Bu was indeed a caring father and husband. However, his attention shifted to his daughter’s combat ability as she grew up. As a father, the first thought that came to Lü Bu’s mind was not caring but disappointment when his daughter accidentally burned herself with her magic power…

        Watching all of these, the Queen of Hearts knew that Lü Bu had never let go of his pursuit of war so she made up his mind, “since I can’t change your thirst for bloodshed, then let me accompany you to the battlefield whenever you fight!”

        While Lü Bu was asleep, the Queen of Hearts put a poker card on his armor so that she could sense his location and his murderous desire at any time. Every time Lü Bu boiled with desire, the poker card would heat and aggravate her anxiety. Only when the poker card cooled down could she find relief and stroke the face of her sleeping daughter gently.

        But the scorching heat on the poker card lasted long this time. Frantic with worry, the Queen of Hearts took the card and looked at it alone after entrusting her daughter to her subjects.

        The Queen of Hearts knew that Alice had let her be since her last ambush. ‘You are the one who says you’re staying. Haha, it’s none of my business. Let’s keep playing.’

        It would not be hard to go under Alice’s nose so the Queen of Hearts tried something that she had not done before—teleporting herself to where Lü Bu was through telepathy!

        ‘If I can’t even protect my woman, how can I, Lü Bu, live up to name as the one!’ Lü Bu walked to the front of the Queen of Hearts to protect her after retrieving his halberd.

        Meanwhile, Celestial Supremacy also took a stance with his right palm facing forward, waiting for his opponent’s move. He then said, ‘leave, woman. This is not where you should come.’

        Just as Lü Bu was conjuring the purple mist, the giant claws beside him suddenly blasted a burst of fierce fire, causing a fire whirl on the battlefield. A deck of poker cards was arrayed before Lü Bu with their edges pointing at Celestial Supremacy. As the embodiment of the fighting spirit of the Queen of Hearts, the heart suits on the cards were steaming. Showing no fear, she stepped forward and stood in line with Lü Bu.

        ‘I know I can’t stop you, so I’ll fight with you instead! Then we shall go home together.’

        ‘Hearty…’ Lü Bu was moved by the understanding of the Queen of Hearts. Feeling a warm commotion in his heart, he turned and stood by her side.

        However, that commotion also stirred up the overwhelming murderous desire inside him. With the unleashed blue light, his expression changed and revealed a craving for wanton slaughter…
STORY_2551:
After saying goodbye to Idun, Scrubia and Beowulf went on their journey again. They covered every corner of Tarones, but they still couldn’t find the cure to her nightmare. Yet, they kept on searching instead of giving up.

        One day, they went into the woods after hearing about a relic of a primordial dragon there. By the time they arrived, it was already sundown so they stopped at a village nearby for the night.

        As Scrubia lay on the bed, she soon fell asleep, sliding into a bizarre dream that she had experienced many times——

        In the woods, there were a bunch of children playing hide and seek. As much as Scrubia wanted to join them, she stopped for her fear of her powers getting out of control again and hurting them. Suddenly, the woods grew. As the plants grew taller, they even obscured the figures of the children. Lifting her arm, Scrubia wanted to stop it, yet she slowly put her arm down.

        When her suitors walked towards her, she cowered in fright of getting hurt again. The woods then spurted and pushed all the suitors away. Left alone in the dense forest, she buried her head between her knees to get use to that loneliness. Yet, someone approached her with a warm glow… It was Beowulf who extended a hand to her.

        ‘You’ve found me…’ All along, Beowulf was the one who could break the fence around her heart, allowing her to put down her disguise.

        Just when she wanted to reach out her hand, she felt a searing pulsation in her chest. The next moment, Beowulf melted into a pool of green muddy liquid before her. Seeping under her feet, the liquid dragged her down to a pond shrouded in green mist… Scrubia struggled desperately, trying to wake up from this familiar nightmare which had given her nothing but agonizing pain.

        Before her racing heartbeat could even slow down, another unbearably scorching heat rose from her chest. As Scrubia woke up from the dream, she became worried when she looked around the room only to find that familiar figure was nowhere to be found.

        “No, he won’t abandon me. Something must have happened!”

        Scrubia walked out of the hotel and headed to the woods under the guide of the dragon soul. The further she went, the more scorching the heat she felt in her chest.

        After a long while, she finally found Beowulf at a clear corner in the dense forest. Yet, she was then round-eyed with terror for the scene before her—Beowulf was kneeling in front of a strange woman while screaming in pain with his head in his hands.

        “Who is that woman? No, whoever she is, it’s unforgivable for her to hurt Beowulf!” Seeing that woman stretching her hand to Beowulf, Scrubia immediately conjured her powers and turned her hair into a pair of dragon wings to stop her!
 
        Astoundingly, a familiar weapon blocked her wings. Scrubia stepped back in shock with a deep wound on her wings. The one who stopped her was not that woman but Beowulf, whose eyes were shining with blue light…

        ‘Beowulf! Don’t you recognize me?’ Scrubia choked with sobs. Yet, it was also her impassioned call that slightly pulled Beowuld’s mind out of that chaotic memories.

        ‘Scrubia… I… Who am I… Arghhhhh——!’ Yet, it was only a fleeting second of sanity; Beowulf’s mind was soon crushed and torn nearly into pieces by the immense flow of information with tears of blood falling from his eyes.

        That terrifying picture petrified Scrubia that burning tears were brimming over her eyes. Clenching her hands, yet, she soon suppressed that fear which could not help her overcome the problem before her nor help Beowulf. 

        “You’ve saved me from those years of being forsaken and helpless. This time, let me be the one to save you.”
STORY_2552:
If you ask Thetis what is Achilles to her, her answer as the Savant of Rules would probably be her warrior or her spear but never her son. It wasn’t until Achilles died on the battlefield that she realized the motherly feeling she had for him.

        However, it was already too late by the time she came to the realm of humans. Achilles was long dead and turned into a Demon who only knew butchery.  To rectify her mistakes, Thetis decided to restore this flesh and divine power to her body. Little did she know that it would be nothing but a greater misstep.

        Unified with Achilles, her mind was then distorted. Together they became a manifestation of vengeance and madness. She had also become the one that Achilles abhorred the most from the bottom of his heart.

        To Achilles, she was his mother who yet denied him and wanted to obliterate him. Thetis could feel his animosity towards her sliding into her heart all the time.

        Her justice, her rules, and her divine power eventually led to such a tragedy. Suffering from the torture of self-blame, absurdity, and bemoaning, Thetis’s mind slowly fell into darkness.

        Until this moment, Giemsa, the Goddess of Order, pulled her out of Achilles’s body to the cold floor.

        “The Savant of Rules, Thetis.”

        It had been such a long long time since anyone had called her name, so Thetis looked at Giemsa in confusion, “Giemsa…”

        “Do you know what you’ve done?”

        Looking back on these days, the rules she had broken and all the lives taken by her and Achilles, Thetis hung his head and said, “...Yes, I know.”

        “Do you know what kind of punishment is awaiting you?”

        Thetis, who was the Savant of Rules, answered Giemsa’s question immediately without thinking, “Soul annihilation. My soul will be completely destroyed.”

        With a bitter smile, Thetis subconsciously looked at Achilles, who was still lying unconscious on the floor. The consternation on her face was nowhere to hide.

        “But this child is innocent! It’s all my fault! Goddess Giemsa, please spare Achilles! Please have mercy on my child!”

        “Now that without your divine power, the demonic blood has circulated through his whole body in an instant. He can never wake up again, and I don’t even have to do anything.”

        Thetis went pale after hearing her words. She then walked to Achilles and stroked his cheek gently. For Achilles’s unconsciousness, she couldn’t unify herself with him again.

        With her dagger, she gashed her wrist. As the warm divine blood wetted the corners of Achilles’s mouth, his body slowly absorbed the divine power, yet the amount of blood was far from enough to balance out the demonic blood inside him.

        “It doesn’t matter what happens to me. Let my soul be annihilated if it is the way it should be. I know I am the farthest from being called a good mother, not to mention all the sins I’ve committed. But I beg you… I will give you everything I have in the realm of gods! You can even take my soul and use it as you like… I just beg you to save my only son!”

        Giemsa closed her eyes. That split second felt like forever for Thetis. After a moment, Giemsa lifted her hands and rebuilt Achilles’s body with Thetis’s blood as a guide and her own power as his bones.

        Flashes of light covered Achilles’s body one after another.

        “Now, are you happy?” When the light faded, Giemsa asked the deathly pale Thetis, who had lost all her divine power, lying on the verge of bleeding out.

        “Yes, thank you.”

        “Then it’s time that you receive your punishment.”

        Under the emotionless adjudication of Giemsa, Theis closed her eyes and awaited her death with a peaceful smile on the bottom stair."

        “Yes, thank you.’

        “Then it’s time that you receive your punishment.”

        Under the emotionless adjudication of Giemsa, Theis closed her eyes and awaited her death with a peaceful smile on the bottom stair.
STORY_2553:
Since Diarmuid’s return, Amor and Celos thought that they could finally regain their long-waited lives in which the three of them lived and fought together. They were Diarmuid’s most loyal listeners. That night when their master was recounting his past in the woods, their minds were also taken back to those days…

        Watching Diarmuid and Isabel dance under the vault of fireflies, Amor smiled and told her little sister that she felt like the two were dancing in the stars. Unexpectedly, her words displeased Celos.

        ‘The starry sky is a memory shared only among Master and us. No one can take it away, not even if she is Master’s lover.’

        Looking at her little sister beside her, Amor pinched her face. ‘So you’re jealous now, huh? We should be happy for Master, for he has found his happiness.’ Celos, who buttoned her lips, just leaned her head against her sister’s shoulder. Together the sisters quietly watched the two figures under the milky way…

        Later, Diarmuid and Isabel rested in the shade of a tree. Leaning closely to each other, Diarmuid told her that he saw the two lances as both his listeners and his daughters.

        ‘It’s stupid, isn’t it? It’s just like I’m talking to myself.’

        ‘Of course not. Just as I can hear the elves talking, you must be able to hear them since they mean a lot to you.’

        After hearing her answer, Diarmuid flashed a smile of relief. Isabel was the only person that believed him. Even though Isabel could not see the sisters, she would still try to talk to them while polishing the lances, which made Amor and Celos realize that the woman before them was different.

        Yet, Isabel accidentally cut herself and left drops of blood on the tip of the lance. Seeing the distressed expression on Diarmuid’s face, Celos finally understood what Amor meant. She then gave her sister a nod to show her recognition for this woman in front of her. As the two sisters channeled their powers, the lances gleamed with two voices that Isabel could hear—

        ‘Since you’re the love of Master, then we shall do our utmost to protect you!’
STORY_2554:
Imanotsurugi and Usumidori, the spritis of the dark swords, were once humans. However, they were later sealed in their swords by Gods for the innumerable lives they had taken. Kept in the Enochian Tower, the two swore to serve whoever broke their seal. Belatedly, they met Minamoto no Yoshitsune.

        At first, Imanotsurugi and Usumidori did think of serving their master loyally; it was just that Yoshitsune had let them down again and again.

        Imanotsurugi and Usumidori believed that one must abandon everything and pursue power at all costs so as to succeed and become the strong. Although Yoshitsune had the heart of becoming the strong, he had the White Queen, who had been holding his back from becoming the toughest man of all.

        So Imanotsurugi and Usumidori plotted together to take over Yoshitsune’s body.

        They thereupon undermined Yoshitsune’s spirit step by step, inflicting hallucinatory torments upon him. Now, they were only one step away from completely crushing Yoshitsune’s will. To do that, there was a perfectly effective way, which was to kill the one he valued the most—the White Queen.

        Defeated by Lü Bu again, Yoshitsune fled back to the White Queen’s castle with wounds all over his body. He then slipped into a coma for some reason.

        Worriedly, the White Queen bandaged up the unconscious Yoshitsune and saw all the cuts and wounds on his body left from his fight with Lü Bu.

        ‘Why isn’t he waking up?’ Looking at Yoshitsune, who had been senseless for a long time, the White Queen burst into tears.

        ‘Master can’t wake up.’ A faint voice came from the two swords of Yoshitsune. ‘He is wounded to the core, which will keep him in slumber forever.’

        ‘Who are you?’ asked the White Queen callously, burying the vulnerability in her sobs just now.
        ‘I’m Imanotsurugi.’ 
        ‘I’m Usumidori. We’re the Master’s swords.’
        The swords said softly, ‘If you want to save Master… We need your help.’

        ‘What can I do?’ The familia evil pneuma on the swords let the White Queen’s guard down.

        ‘You just have to hold us in your hand. With your power and Master’s power stored in us, we can definitely bring Master back.’

        ‘I will do anything as long as it can help him!’ said the frail White Queen firmly, standing up straight. As she picked up the two swords, she could feel her powers being drawn out by them instantly. However, Yoshitsune’s face didn’t reddened but grew pallid.

        Sensing the anomaly, the White Queen wanted to get rid of the swords yet failed as though they had been glued to her hands.

        ‘What… do you want?’ The White Queen could feel that her body was weakening slowly, with her mind fading away.

        Just then, two male figures gradually materialized before her. They looked just like Imanotsurugi and Usumidori before they were turned into the spirits of the dark swords.

        ‘What do we want? Go ask Yoshitsune in hell!’ They each held a sword in their hands, then they approached the defenseless White Queen with a sinister smile…
STORY_2555:
In the White Queen’s castle in Wonderland, a figure bounded through the gate, racing directly to the center of the castle. Sitting on the throne, the White Queen was waiting with her chin resting on one hand. Then a dormouse, which disembarked from its mount, knelt before her and reported, ‘Your Majesty, I saw it with my own eyes. I swear it’s true! The Queen of Hearts’ belly was bulging. She must be pregnant! She will be defenseless if we attack her now!’

        As the White Queen waved her hand, her pawns immediately stood in formation; the dormouse also got back to its mount for the coming war. The army’s march caught the eye of a pneuma with blue light, which slowly turned into a grinning child and ran towards the Castle of Hearts…

        In the castle, Lü Bu quietly pushed open the door only to find the Queen of Hearts sleeping on her chair in exhaustion. As Lü Bu  patted her head gently, the Queen of Hearts opened her eyes and gave him a smile. Just as she was about to stand up, Lü Bu motioned her to sit down. He then squatted down and put his ears on her bulging belly, listening attentively to the heartbeats inside. Following her breath, her belly rose and fell; even the clothes couldn’t conceal the warmth beneath it…

        A new life is coming to this world…

        ‘Ba!’ Lü Lingshuang popped up before the window! The Queen of Hearts felt a nagging anxiety whenever she saw him for it meant that Lü Bu’s murderous desire would be ignited again. Lü Bu did spend more time in Wonderland than before ever since he had learnt that she was pregnant. However, every time this kid appeared, Lü Bu would surely go out to wage war… Yet, this time was different.

        With the pawns’ marching sound slowly approached, the White Queen’s sneak attack infuriated Lü Bu to another level. From his eyes, the Queen of Hearts could tell that he was more conscientious in protecting her and the child to be born instead of pursuing slaughter as usual. As Lü Bu looked back, she felt a sense of relief. However,  a throbbing pain came to her belly shortly after he left…

        By the time the White Queen arrived, Lü Bu was already waiting by the gate with a smile, letting a kid bathed in blue light swing his halberd! The White Queen was caught off guard; meanwhile countless pawns had been knocked down by the child…

        When Lü Bu repelled the White Queen, the castle had already slid into chaos, in which everyone was walking around hurriedly. The March Hare rushed to him and asked him to return to the Queen of Hearts as soon as he could. The moment he stepped into the room, he saw a bunch of servants surrounding the Queen of Hearts, who was screaming hysterically. When Lü Bu came to her side, she barely had the strength to looked at him. Yet her slender fingers clenched his hand tightly as she screamed.

        Lü Bu was also thrown into panic, which was a feeling that he never had before on the battlefield. At that moment, the feelings of anxiety, distress, and excitement intertwined in his heart…

        As a loud cry resounded through the room, finally, everyone breathed a sigh of relief. While the Queen of Hearts held that fragile life in her arms,  Lü Bu gave her a kiss on the forehead gently, supporting her weak body. That unbelievably light and fragile being preoccupied Lü Bu…Since then, the Queen of Heart hadn’t seen Lü Lingshuang for a while.

        Yet, she had known long ago that the peaceful days would come to an end someday. When Lü Bu found that her daughter’s blood could turn into fire during their combat lesson, he was thrilled by such a unique talent. Watching the interaction between the father and daughter, the Queen of Hearts felt a faint chill—that ball of blue light was back and gradually turning into a child, the being that caused her anxiety.

        Afterward, Lü Bu went out for wars time after time; the murderous desire that had ceased in his body for a long time was once again rekindled. Thinking of that, the Queen of Hearts couldn’t stop feeling worried. One day, she held her young daughter in silence while holding a searing poker card in her hand. As young and innocent as the daughter was, she could still tell her mother’s anxiety from her slight tremor.

        By then, Lü Bu had just returned. Unexpectedly, his undue murderous desire that had not receded turned against them with the halberd. The Queen of Hearts immediately dodged Lü Lingshuang’s attack with her daughter in her arms until he eventually  dispersed from Lü Bu’s body. It was only until Lü Bu, who had come back to his senses, saw the perturbed expression on her face that he realized he was at the risk of losing control… 

        Under the soothing music, the Queen of Hearts sat by the bed and looked at her daughter’s sleeping face quietly. Standing behind her, Lü Bu put a necklace on her. Surprised by the coldness on her chest, she looked down and found that it was a locket with their daughter’s portrait inside. The Queen of Hearts then lifted her head and looked at him only to hear Lü Bu saying with an unusual expression,

        ‘For the sake of our daughter, I promise you that I will never die on the battlefield. If I go out of control one day, please come and wake me.’

        ‘I hope that day will never come.’ Holding Lü Bu’s hand back, the Queen of Hearts quietly watched the lingering blue light evanesce…
STORY_2556:
Scrubia found Beowulf. When she saw him kneel in pain in front of a strange woman, she thought the woman was the one who caused his pain so she wanted to knock down the assailant first before any tragedy happened. Much to her surprise, Beowulf stood and protected the woman. Then his mind collapsed again with tears of blood falling from his eyes.

        Feeling his cracking soul, Scrubia rushed to hold him in her arms, regardless of the danger of being attacked. She conjured all her powers and channeled them into the trembling body of Beowulf like the tenderest flow of warmth.

        “Dragon soul, please protect the one I love.” The dragon soul released an indigo light and fell on the two like a soundless shower of rain as it felt Scrubia’s urge…

        Beowulf, whose soul was to be crushed by the overflow of information, felt a clear stream of power cascade through his body while lifting his battered soul and washing away the turmoil in his head. In a moment, all the peaceful and good memories flooded back and occupied his mind——

        During his journey, he crossed a river with someone’s hand in his, someone who snuggled up to him after waking up from a nightmare, and his fingers would run through her fine and smooth hair… Those were the memories between Scrubia and him. 

        Opening his eyes, Beowulf finally awakened from the unknown chaos. Feebly, he lifted his right and stroked Scrubia’s cheek, with loving tenderness that he had never shown before. Then, he whispered, ‘Now I remember… I’m Beowulf, the dragonslayer who once fought for glory… but now, I’m a warrior who fights to protect you…’

        ‘Yes, you’re my one and only hero.’ Scrubia smiled lightly with tears filling her eyes. At that moment, no words were needed for they already knew each other’s thoughts under the resonance of power. The affection that they had kept in their hearts through years of companionship was now brought to the light.

        ‘What a surprise that you made it through the breakdown.’ The woman’s voice burst the loving bubble between them. As the two came back to their minds, they both looked at the woman alarmingly and Beowulf asked, ‘Who…are you?’

        ‘It doesn’t matter who I am. You just have to know that my encounter with you is an inevitable result of fate.’ Closing her eyes, the woman raised her wand, then a magic circle sprung up in the air.

        Soon, Beowulf and Scrubia felt that the power of the dragon soul was drawn out from them. The light released from their bodies gathered into a ball of light in the magic circle. Powerless to stop that, the two eventually fell on their knees for the lack of strength.

        ‘You…Did you take away our dragon soul?’ With her hands clasping her hair, Scrubia tried to channel her powers yet she could not turn it into a pair of wings again. 

        ‘Yes, but more precisely, I took the remnant soul in his body. The power you had was just a part of it.’

        ‘...Why did you help us?’ Scrubia still couldn’t believe her eyes that the nightmare that had been haunting them for years was resolved so easily in a short time.

        ‘I didn’t help you. I just took something that didn’t belong to you. Now, you’re on your own with your fate.’ Leaving these words, the woman no longer stayed and walked into the woods with the ball of light and quick steps.

        After watching her figure disappear into the woods, Beowulf and Scrubia stood up and headed back to the village.

        For they finally got their wish after all these years of traveling, Beowulf was flummoxed that he didn’t know what they should do next; whereas Scrubia deliberately leaned against him and said, ‘I just want to keep creating new memories with you, no matter where our destination is.’
STORY_2557:
Thetis, who knew her venial sinfulness, closed her eyes and waited for Giemsa’s judgment. She had no unfinished business as soon as she learned that her son, Achilles, was fine.

        Even with her eyes closed, she could feel a fierce power flying towards her. Her soul would be shattered the moment the power hit her.

        In that brief moment, Thetis’s life flashed before her eyes.

        “It’s all my fault.”

        “My son, I’m sorry…”

        “If only I had noticed…all of these…sooner… If only I had been a good mother… Would it have made everything different?”

        Just as that power was about to hit Thetis, a figure came and blocked that vicious attack.

        When Thetis opened her eyes, she saw the back of Achilles, who for the first time in forever raised his shield to protect someone instead of killing.

        Under the harsh light, Achilles stood in front of the immense power, like a madman trying to fight a huge wave with his flesh. Then the raging wave of power swallowed him, leaving countless small scratch marks on his arms.

        ‘Achilles…Why…’

        ‘Is there a reason needed for a child to protect his mother?’

        Achilles looked back and gave her a forced smile. The compelling force before him pushed him back half a step. 

        He had never felt so clear-minded ever since the Demon blood in his body had been removed by the divine power put inside him.

        Seeing the decidedly weak Thetis, Achilles felt the blood of Gods flowing in his body and soon realized what was happening to him.

        Even if this was a meaningless life;
        Even if he had to bear sins that could never be palliated—

        “I just want to protect her!”

        ‘Goddess Giemsa, I was the one who slaughtered the civilians, the one who was tainted by Demon blood, and the one who attacked the Gods. It has nothing to do with my mother! Take my soul if you want!’

        Achilles didn’t cower a bit, even though the shield in his hand gradually melted under the strong light.

        ‘Achilles!’

        Watching the two, Giemsa let out a sigh. Then the two were deluged by a sea of elements. 

        ‘Thetis, you’ve created life with divine power and attempted to interfere in the realm of humans. You’ve also taken countless lives with Achilles. And Achilles, you’ve committed innumerable murders throughout your life, in which plenty of innocent lives died because of you… To pay for your sins, you shall lose all your powers and spend the rest of your lives in the prison of Gods until eternity.’
　　
        As the light faded, Achilles and Thetis, who had lost all their powers, fell on the ground with gratitude and disbelief in their eyes.

        As long as the mother and son got to stay together, it was a happy ending, even if it cost their freedom and all their powers.
STORY_2558:
In the night of a jungle, sparks flew for no reason, scaring off all the fireflies that scattered like beams of light. Moving against the flow of light, Diarmuid walked towards the source of fire alarmingly with his lances.

        He held up his lances, preparing for the enemies that could come at any time. For his undivided attention, however, he was unaware of the flashes of light floating around him, while Amor felt something familiar when the tip of her lance touched the light. As she looked around, she found that the flashes were gathering a spot unusually, forming a loose figure…

        The moment Amor wanted to notify her master, Diarmuid had already assumed the lance-throwing posture——swoosh!  As the lance of Amor hit the target, a Demon fell to the ground. Yet, a rustling sound came from the bushes as if something had fled while the fire also spread in that direction.

        After Diarmuid plucked out his lance, he walked over only to find that a bunch of Demons were setting fire wantonly in the forest while abducting some creatures…the spirits! Although he had heard about the spirits from Isabel several times, this was the first time he saw it with his own eyes. Spirits were something that his lover treasured. Now that the place of memory was being sabotaged and ruined, a murderous intent that made Diarmuid’s blood boil rose from the bottom of his heart…

        Diarmuid threw his lance right at a Demond leader the moment he saw him shouting to his subordinates—as the lance pierced through the Demon’s chest, he fell to the ground with a shrill scream of pain. Shocked and enraged, the Demons around immediately dashed towards Diarmuid with their weapons after they located him. Yet, this attack aroused the agitation inside Diarmuid’s heart again. The unstoppable killing lust exasperated him to the point of madness that he pushed away all the attacking Demons with a swing of his lances.

        ‘This place is full of the memories of me and Isabel. I won’t allow anyone to destroy it, not even a thought of destroying it!’

        Amor and Celos transformed to lances and fought with Diarmuid, who had slipped into the swirl of madness. As countless flashes of green light blazed with the flying lances, all the Demons were wiped out one by one.

        The stab didn’t stop even though the enemies had become a pulp of flesh. Amor, who calmed down, started to have a strange feeling… No, more exactly, she felt a chill in her heart. The anxiety that had been buried deep in her heart resurfaced.  Sensing her sister’s thoughts and the abnormality of her master, Celos yet didn’t have the heart to speak up.

        Back in the days when Diarmuid was bent on vengeance, they both spared no effort to help their master. Now, however, slaughter seemed to have become the only thing in his head…

        ‘Mas-Master, we have defeated all the Demons!’ yelled Amor worriedly when she saw Diarmuid point his lances to the elves that had just got away from the Demons. Conjuring her powers, she wanted to stop Diarmuid and so did Celos. Yet, their powers were still no match to their master’s that they could only fretfully watch as a cold smile tugged at the corner of his mouth.

        Then, a human figure formed by the flickers of white light flew towards Diarmuid with two beams of interlacing soft light, as though two arms were wrapping his neck from the back… Not did that gentle warmth gladden the hearts of Amor and Celos, but also solaced the one of Diarmuid, who stopped and looked up at that light.

        “It’s enough, my dear…” Diarmuid only recognized that it was the call of his loved one when a familiar female voice sounded in his heart.

        The moment the soft light slid through the burning bushes, the fire there went out. Looking at the fleeting dance of the flowing light, Diarmuid unknowingly shed a tear. With all those years passing by, it still seemed like yesterday that the girl had never left him.

        “I shall be always by your side as long as your love and jealousy never end.”

        Reaching out his hands, Diarmuid wanted to touch the light. Yet, it dissipated before him and turned into flickers of white light that slowly landed on Amor and Celos.

        That was when he finally realized what his loved one meant—his love and jealousy embodied the memories of Isabel. She would live in his heart as long as the Red Rose and the Yellow Rose kept blooming.

        “The three of us shall stay together forever and be the thriving roses on the battlefield!”
STORY_2559:
Imanotsurugi and Usumidori each held a sword in their hands and approached the helpless White Queen with a sinister smile. Just then, the severely injured Yoshitsune, who sensed the love of his life was on the brink of danger, came out of the coma and blocked the swords of Imanotsurugi and Usumidori with the long one hung on the wall, guarding the White Queen behind him.

        Looking at the assailants, Yoshitsune felt an inexplicable sense of familiarity. He soon recognized them when he saw the long and the short dark swords on their hands.

        ‘Imanotsurugi, Usumidori… Why are you…’

        ‘Yeah, why?’

        ‘Of course, it’s because you’re incompetent to be our master so we’ve decided to send you all to hell! Hahahaha!’ Together, Imanotsurugi and Usumidori let out a wild and derisive laugh. Meanwhile, the mounting strength on the two swords pressing against Yoshitsune almost brought him to his knees.

        ‘You’re too weak. I feel ashamed to even call you my master,’ Imanotsurugi said.
        ‘Do you know why you can never beat Lü Bu?’ asked Usumidori.
        ‘It’s because of the woman behind you,’ said Imanotsurugi. ‘You can never turn completely evil as long as she lives.’
        ‘How delusional are you to think that you can defeat him without mastering the evil pneuma? Bah!’ disdained Usumidori.

        “Am I really…wrong? Is abandoning Snowdrop the only way to get power?”

        As though the evil pneuma could sense Yoshitsune’s hesitation, it started to dim and weaken.

        ‘Ahahahaha, even the evil pneuma abandoned him!’ said Imanotsurugi.
