Acting contrarily to their own principles, the soldiers were actually trembling and their mouths murmured words that asked for their God’s mercy.  When they progressed to the altar where the smoking mirror had been for years, the mirror suddenly turned into smoke and disappeared like its name suggested, prompting the people to panic and hurriedly kneel in worship, hoping for their God’s forgiveness.

        “It’s already the rainy season, but we haven’t seen a drop of rain!”  “A lot of our wells have dried up.  If we don’t have enough water for our crops, how will we get through the winter?”  “If we don’t have water, nevermind the crops, we don’t even know if we can make it through the summer!”  “It’s all the king’s fault!  All of this wouldn’t have happened if he hadn’t taken down the temple!”

        “Doctor!  Please save my son.  He’s our only son!”  “Sir, the disease has almost infected the entire country.  I have used up all of my medicine...there is really nothing I can do to help.”  “It’s all that crazy king’s fault!  This disease only appeared after he destroyed the temple!”

        “Hurry and pack your things.  The country nearby is going to attack us!”  “They’re going to attack a country that’s plagued with disease and has no water?  Is that king also out of his mind?”  “Who cares!  Just let those two insane people fight each other.  Why did he have to take down the temple of mirror?  It’s the cause of these incessant disasters!”

        Just as depicted in the tale, disasters began to occur right after the country lost its temple and the blessing of the smoking mirror.  The new king was swarmed by his subjects’ admonishment every day and his officials gradually left the palace.  Only the king and a few people stayed in the desolated center of power.

        The new king paced up and down the chamber, contemplating a method of how to deal with the disastrous situation when a cloud of dark purple smoke suddenly drifted in, rendering the sunlit chamber overly dim.  The smoke began to thicken and converge toward its center like a vortex.  When the smoke finally disappeared, what was left behind was actually the long vanished smoking mirror!

        The surface of the mirror did not reflect any light and instead emitted infinite smoke, which then corporealized into a creature with multiple heads with hands that held peculiar worshipping tools.

        “T...Tez...catli...poca...”  Mind rendered unclear from the shocking scene, the new king stammered the name of the creature.

        Upon hearing the king’s words, Tezcatlipoca playfully wrapped its body of smoke around the king.  Its head with a long tongue sticking out of its mouth closed in to the king’s face.  It said with a coarse voice, ‘Thank you for tearing down the temple and releasing me.  What do you think about my thank you “gifts”?  Hahaha...’

        Tezcatlipoca was an ominous mirror who brought about disasters and signified chaos.  Wherever it existed, disasters would befall the place.  The baleful mirror only acted to its will.  It would never pledge loyalty to anyone, nor would it befriend any individual.
STORY_7012:
This place lay in complete darkness.  Furi, a wind youkai, curled up in a corner like a flat balloon.  It could hear the wind blowing outside the cave, but it could not feel it.

        ‘So boring...’  Furi murmured, but no one replied.  In the past, it traveled around the realm with other furis.  They enjoyed freedom but were unaware of the fact that they carried wind as strong as tornadoes with them.  One day, when they were playing beside a village, they unintentionally summoned an immensely powerful gust of wind, sweeping away the entire village.  Abe no Seimei happened to be there and immediately cast a seal to suppress the wind.  After a fierce battle between Abe and the furis, Abe left one furi alive.  He thought there would be no mercy in killing them all.  Hence, he sealed the last furi in a cave and placed a tiny stone lantern at the exit to absorb its wind.  Even to this day, the furi remained locked away...

        ‘So boring...’  Furi had uttered this sentence countless times.  When it was about to fall asleep again, it was surprised to hear wind roaring outside the cave, so it raised its guard.  “Boom!”  Along with the sound, light and wind entered the cave before a figure appeared.

        “Furi, I’ve been searching for you,”  said an unfamiliar male, but before he could finish his sentence, Furi had already left the cave and was happily dancing in the wind.  It then scanned the man and noticed that he was wearing an Onmyōji outfit.  Rage filled the furi as it bit the man with all its might, but it was no match for the man — Shimmerlight blocked the attack with his bare hands.  “There is no need to panic.  Just listen to me...”  He calmly continued: “I’m here to invite you to join me in saving all the mystical beings in this realm.”

        ‘Saving all the mystical beings?’  Furi hesitated as Shimmerlight reached out his hand: “I am willing to be your companion.”  Upon hearing the word “companion”, Furi could not help but recall the days when it and the other furis played together and chased after the wind.  A surge of emotions made Furi nod and agree to the man’s suggestion.

        “Furi!  Get that old youkai!  He ate all of the village’s harvest!”  “Furi!  Seize the ascetic’s notes!  It has youkai-harming theories written all over it!”  “Furi!  Catch that female youkai!  She’s been enchanting others and hurting them!”

        At first, Shimmerlight treated Furi politely like a companion.  This did not change until they ran into other youkais in a village; Shimmerlight was arrogant and ordered Furi to attack or capture the youkais alive.  Furi was still young to the world and it had been a long time since it last used its power, so it did not notice anything amiss.  However, after a while, Furi noticed that every time they successfully captured a youkai or seized their treasure, Shimmerlight would wear an unusually sly smile.  Things did not turn for the better and instead, Shimmerlight would exude evil pneuma whenever they won a battle.  This raised Furi’s suspicion who began to consider leaving this companion.

        “Furi!  Cast a gust of wind to drive the youkai-serpent out of the cave!”  Shimmerlight and Furi stood outside a cave.  After taking a look inside the cave, he ordered Furi like he usually did, but surprisingly heard a firm “no”.  Shimmerlight tried to persuade Furi, but when his attempt was to no avail, he glared at the beast and took out the notes that were previously seized from an ascetic.  He bit his finger and used his blood to draw an upside-down pentacle on his chest.  “All the youkais I’ve eaten so far were only minor ones.  If I can eat the serpent, I will definitely be strong enough to rival Abe no Seimei’s power!  If you insist on not helping me, I will have no choice but to eat you first and then I’ll deal with the serpent myself!”

        The drawing on Shimmerlight’s chest radiated crimson light as his face gradually turned monster-like.  Noticing that it was in danger, Furi hurriedly cast a gust of wind to attack him, but Shimmerlight used the tiny stone lantern to absorb its wind and power, rendering it powerless!  He then leaped toward Furi’s chest and bit it before absorbing its youkai power.  However, shortly afterward, Shimmerlight noticed that he was only absorbing wind; none of Furi’s actual power was channeling into his body, leaving him with no other choice but to retreat first.

        “Why can’t I absorb your power?!”  Shimmerlight bellowed.  At the same time, the opening on Furi’s chest allowed it to draw wind into its body and transfer the wind to its power at will.  It turned into a tornado and broke the stone lantern before sweeping Shimmerlight away into the cave.  “W, wait!  Argh!!!!”  Screams of pain came from within the cave before a series of biting and chewing sounds.

        Furi withdrew its power and climbed onto a tree, where it had a broader view.  It allowed the tender wind to enter its chest.  ‘I’ve lost another companion...’ murmured Furi.  However, it did not feel sorrow this time and instead, it felt relieved that it no longer had to listen to Shimmerlight’s orders.  As the tender wind resonated with the power in its body, Furi felt its power grow in an unbelievable speed, making it much stronger than it used to be.  Furi now felt freer than before: ‘Maybe this is the feeling I’ve been searching for...’
STORY_7013:
An official spread open a map and traced a route with his finger.  After ensuring they were going in the correct direction, he told his army to keep proceeding.  This army was the pioneer force of a country in the south and was returning after winning a pyrrhic battle which reduced their number to a dozen of men.


        “Behind this forest is our home.  Hang in there!”  The official’s words were replied with a hearty cheer.  Seeing that the forest was only a step away, the soldiers were all hopeful and their morale was boosted as they thought back to their family, lovers and friends.  All they wanted was to return home as soon as possible.


        The sky darkened and mist emerged, so after entering the forest, the soldiers lit their torches to clearly see the road and their companions.  Judging from the map, the official expected them to exit the narrow forest in a few minutes.  However, even though they already sped up their journey, they were still inside the forest, and the moon had silently climbed onto the sky.  After a day of traveling, the soldiers showed signs of tirement as hunger and thirst struck them.  It triggered the official to think if they should take a rest before continuing their journey, but he could not let his guard down in this strange place.


        While he was contemplating, light flashed before their eyes, and with the light from their torches, the soldiers could see fruits lying on the floor.  Too hungry from all the traveling, the soldiers crouched and started stuffing their mouths, paying no regard of the official’s dissuasion.  From where the sudden flash had come, a pleasant voice of an adolescent rang: “This is my treat.  Have it your way.”  Upon hearing this, the official unsheathed his sword and yelled, “Who’s that?”


        A figure then approached with the light as the official closely observed the comer — he was wearing a long cloak which was dragging on the ground, and his face was wrapped in black bandages with most of it covered by the cloak.  Behind him was a reindeer covered by a black cloth.  Almost completely soundless, they slowly walked together to the official.


        “I am only a traveler who is planning to spend the night here.  This reindeer is my mount.”  The traveler continued as he stayed a few feet away from the official: “My appearance is not pleasing, so I am trying to avoid people from seeing me.  That is why I only placed the fruits on the ground; please pardon me.”


        The official scanned across the traveler’s body and clothing; he could not help but feel an inexpressible sense of eccentricity.  However, running into a traveler was what the official wanted, because he could seize the opportunity and get answers for his questions: “Excuse me, but are you from the south?”  The traveler replied, “Yes.  Are you headed there?”  Hopes could be seen in the official’s eyes as he continued asking, “It is our home.  How long do we need to travel there from this place?”  The traveler answered only after a short pause, “Grass is thick up front.  You will need half a day at least, but a woodcutter showed me a shortcut, so I arrived at this forest in just a few minutes.  How about I walk you to the shortcut?”


        Seeing the traveler’s friendliness, the official was tempted by his suggestion of the shortcut as he thought: ‘Even if he’s a fraud, we outnumber him.  There is no way we can lose.  Why not give it a try?’  Therefore, he agreed to take the traveler’s suggestion and asked his men to follow him.


        On the way, the traveler shared his traveling experience with fervor, so the official thought he was a simple man and hence let his guard down.  It was not until they arrived at a place where the moon could not shine did the traveler stop talking and walk slower.


        Realizing something amiss, the official called out to the traveler but received no response and instead, he could hear animals’ gasping sounds.  The official then hurriedly grabbed the traveler’s arm, but was surprised to have held onto nothing — there was nothing beneath the cloak.  He pulled the cloak away from the traveler and could only see a wing inside.  With a bonk, the traveler’s head fell onto the floor along with the cloak.


        “What is hap...”  Before the official could finish his sentence, the reindeer bit onto his neck and tore , leaving the official with no chance to breathe another — the soldiers behind him panicked.  They hastily turned around and ran, but they had been guided to somewhere secluded and with many withered trees blocking their way, as if they were trapped in a cage and had no other option but to fight the reindeer.  Some of the soldiers retaliated, but the reindeer’s antlers resembled spears, and wings shields.  With its enormous strength, the soldiers had no chance of winning.  When the last of them was falling onto the ground, he vaguely saw the end of the forest where lights of houses lit the night sky...


        After ensuring all of its preys were dead, the reindeer savored them one by one.  In a short while, what was left of the dozen of men were a dozen of skulls.  The reindeer kicked all the skulls into a tree hole and wrapped one with its wing.


        The reindeer slowly walked back to where it could see moonshine.  Although it did not move its lips, a voice could be heard: “What a lucky night!”  Just then, a happily dancing figure appeared from under the reindeer’s legs, as if the voice came not from the reindeer, but from its shadow.

STORY_7028:
Originally a Jurassic creature that evolved from a sea reptile into a terrestrial monster, Godzilla is awakened by mankind’s nuclear weapons tests in the inaugural film.
Over time, the franchise itself has evolved, as Godzilla and other creatures in the films have become metaphors for social commentary on the real world.
Godzilla and his fellow kaiju monsters are more than mere entertainment icons – they have come to embody the emotions and social problems of our times.
STORY_7029: Babygodzilla’s more mature appearance. As time passes, Babygodzilla absorbs Godzilla’s excess energies, which accelerates the youthful creature’s physical growth and development. Littlegodzilla can fire heatwaves from its mouth but they are still weak and foamy-looking. Raised for a time by humans, Littlegodzilla feels empathy and affection for them. When Spacegodzilla arrives on Birth Island, Littlegodzilla senses the creature’s connection to Godzilla and approaches it without fear. But when Spacegodzilla seals it inside a crystal chamber, the young monster’s eyes glow red.
STORY_7030: Rodan is a gigantic pterosaur-type kaiju that hatches underground from prehistoric eggs as a result of global warming. The creature made its debut in RODAN (1956). After the shockwave force of its wing movement strikes the Saikai Bridge and destroys part of the city, Rodan is defeated when the military uses explosives to cause an eruption of the volcano at Mount Aso, Kyushu. Rodanalsostars in GHIDORAH, THE THREE HEADED MONSTER (1964) and returned for two more Showa-era films: INVASION OF ASTRO-MONSTER (1965) and DESTROY ALL MONSTERS (1968). The Rodan of the Heisei era first appears in GODZILLA VS. MECHAGODZILLA II (1993). In a new island setting, the creature emerges and, as its power grows, evolves into Fire Rodan. Like the original Rodan, it is capable of creating a sonic boom shockwave with its wings. It also has a new beam-like weapon known as the Uranium Heatwave.
STORY_7031: Mothra first appears in MOTHRA (1961). Mothra’s life cycle begins as a larval creature that hatches from an egg. Later the Mothra larva is able to produce a strong silk-like thread that it uses to weave a cocoon around itself. During this stage it metamorphoses before finally emerging as a winged adult. The silken thread Mothra produces also serves as one of its most useful weapons thanks to its strength. Mothra’s poisonous scales are another defense it employs to painful effect against Godzilla and other kaiju. Although Mothra’s size changes film to film, its basic design, powers and personality remain familiar. Able to fly across oceans, battle massive kaiju and protect the natives who worship it, Mothra is often called the most beautiful kaiju, thanks to the rich colors of its adult form’s wings.
STORY_7032: King Ghidorah first appears in GHIDORAH, THE THREE HEADED MONSTER (1964), and was originally meant to be as powerful on its own as Mothra, Rodan and Godzilla put together. With a design reminiscent of the dragons of Asian mythology, King Ghidorah is covered in golden scales, has three heads (each atop a long undulating neck) and is able to fly with its powerful wings. The Gravity Beam is its primary destructive weapon, and its metallic screams can strike terror into the hearts of man and monster alike. With its devastating powers and terrifying beauty the marvelous King Ghidorah is Toho’s first and best space kaiju.

Mechagodzilla has a new origin story and different abilities with each new film incarnation. These are:
A giant battle robot modeled on the image of Godzilla and built by the aliens of Black Hole Planet 3 as part of their plot to conquer Earth.
The ultimate war machine built by the United Nations Godzilla Countermeasures Center using reverse-engineered 23rd century technology salvaged from the ocean floor after Godzilla defeated Mecha-King Ghidorah and the Futurians.
An anti-Godzilla weapon created using DNA from the bones of the original Godzilla.
All the Mechagodzillas are created in the hope of being the ultimate weapon to use against Godzilla. With every part of its body functioning as a weapon, Mechagodzilla always poses a real threat.

STORY_10200:
Mollyanna Dia, the universally famous pop singer. For some reason, she looks very similar to Molly, the Elementalist in old age.

With a cheerful personality and distinctive styles as her trademark, her positive image has made her a desirable spokesperson for many merchandisers.
Having excellent physical strength, she can sing for a long time without a break. Passionate about singing and performing, she hopes she can project her energy to her fans through her work.
In spite of her love for desserts, she controls herself for the fear of gaining weight. Her dream is to taste all kinds of desserts around the universe.
STORY_10201:
A Holy God, who once started wars on the Tarones and caused uncounted miseries and disasters. Regarding himself as the King of Gods, he believes that all creatures besides the Holy Gods are just ants.

He was resentful since Enoch had liberated the power of the origin; he even formed a rebellion with other defiant Gods. Yet, he was captured in Year 119.
STORY_10202:
One of the ancient demons, a gigantic squirming larva that has countless tentacles. The Eldus sealed it beneath Tarones in ancient times.
With a mad desire for destruction, it is always starved that it needs souls to satisfy its hunger.
STORY_10203:
An orphan whose real place of birth remains unknown. She was adopted by a group of mercenaries who taught her star wars swordsmanship. She eventually became a powerful swordswoman.

She is good at dual-wielding.
She always wears a suit of black armor to add a sense of majesty to herself, believing that she is a man trapped in a woman’s body.
Besides swordsmanship, she is also proficient in driving spaceships and assembling machines. Her biggest weakness is her allergy to dog hairs.
STORY_10204: One of the Eucaly elves, who are the main tissue supplier of Rycaza. She is the wife of the first prince, Yule. Loving her husband deeply, she is willing to do anything for Yule’s happiness. She was a rich girl before marrying Yule. Besides her ability to summon giant birds, she also excels in the art of rope bondage.
STORY_10205: A Spiritual Beast and a brilliant machinist. He invented four robot claws that can move according to his mind. He is obsessed with the patterns on easter eggs, which results in a compulsion to take all the easter eggs to himself whenever he sees them.
STORY_10206:
The first prince of the Eucaly elves, who are the main tissue supplier of Rycaza.
For his outstanding appearance, his wife uses his portrait as the packaging design of their tissues. With a reserved and gentle personality, he is deeply in love with his wife, Miranda.
STORY_10207:
The youngest son of a wealthy merchant in Verdilles.
He is a bard who has a genius for playing the harp and performing archery. Traveling from county to county, he often acts as host to different shows.
He has a rather cool personality but he shows an unusual enthusiasm when he is playing host.
STORY_10208:
A Mussong.

She is a vocal instructor in the conservatory of Heptara Unies. She taught Nocturne and Melody music when they were little.

Passionate and enthusiastic, she regards life as a source of musical inspiration. The musical instrument she excels at is violin.
STORY_10209: A Machina and the legendary dragonary craft master. Every work of his is a masterpiece. One of the dragonwares he made had been kept in the dangerous wareroom in Lomond Manor. By amazing coincidence, it resonated with Shroy and became his exclusive weapon.
STORY_10210: A special kind of bull that serves as a mount of Cilovic. According to Cilovic, it can run faster than Ben’s racing car. As Cilovic often takes Moe to the headquarters of Heptara Unies, the staff has got used to the sight of it a long time ago. It is usually docile, but it can be very fierce when it gets angry.
STORY_10211:
One day, the Star Flower suddenly emerged from the inside of its star, blossoming on the surface. Having perceived humans as a threat to its star, the Star Flower took defensive measures and created Noman, a being of destruction.
Noman released a star serum which transformed into a miasma toxic to the human body. The humans were forced to take shelter in areas with low miasma levels or mobile fortresses.
Even faced with the possibility of extinction, the humans were divided into two opposing camps—the United Government that wanted to destroy the Star Flower, and the anti-government group Easter that searched for another way.
During this strife, Neo was born as the next step forward for humanity, boasting a constitution that was resistant to the miasma and that could receive signals from the Star Flower.
STORY_10212:
One day, the Star Flower suddenly emerged from the inside of its star, blossoming on the surface. Having perceived humans as a threat to its star, the Star Flower took defensive measures and created Noman, a being of destruction.
Noman released a star serum which transformed into a miasma toxic to the human body. The humans were forced to take shelter in areas with low miasma levels or mobile fortresses.
Even faced with the possibility of extinction, the humans were divided into two opposing camps—the United Government that wanted to destroy the Star Flower, and the anti-government group Easter that searched for another way.
During this strife, Neo was born as the next step forward for humanity, boasting a constitution that was resistant to the miasma and that could receive signals from the Star Flower.
STORY_10213:
A middle school girl born with both human and monster blood. When her world faced a crisis of never-before-seen proportions, Mana's hidden angelic power was awakened by her desire to save both humans and monsters.
She pushed herself to her limits and was able to repel the descending Red Moon, a device that threatened to destroy her world, but the aftermath resulted in the creation of the Moon Stain. The Moon Stain is an amalgamation containing the desire to annihilate humanity previously embedded in the Red Moon. Mana sets out to purify the Moon Stain, wielding a flaming bow and a shining sword to be used as an arrow.
STORY_10214:
The angel who delivers the word of God.
Gabriel wards off those who attempt to invade the Garden of Eden with her adroit knife handling. There appears to be a contrast with her mild-mannered off-duty attitude and her imposing stature as the guardian of paradise.
Gabriel dual-wields lily-laden swords, scattering petals that awaken the souls of holy servants from bygone eras.
STORY_10215:
A serious and honest angel. She is loyal to the Almighty and is trusted as the guide of the Heavens.
Uriel guards the gate to the Heavens, where good souls rest until the day of selection, which comes once every several thousand years. On the day of selection, souls are tested by the Almighty, and those who are recognized as having outstanding qualities are given a sign of blessing. Uriel, foreseeing the coming of the day of selection, creates a door to bring souls out of the Heavens with the holy key entrusted to her by the Almighty, and leads them to the place of selection.
STORY_10216:
Phantom City is a cybercity filled with skyscrapers. Many call this city home, be they human, beast, android, magician, or the thief named Arsene. When she was a child, Arsene's parents were murdered, and she herself was nearly killed, but the incident awakened her magical powers and gave her the ability to transform the greedy desires of humans into jewels.
One night in Phantom City, Arsene confronted Mayor Justice to take back the happiness of the city's people. She ended the battle by calling forth L'Aiguille Creuse to illuminate the mayor in a barrage of lights, and from the mayor's shadow emerged his desires in the form of a phantom. Arsene finished the phantom using her magical power, transforming it into jewels.
STORY_10217:
Sent as an emissary from space to rule over Strike World when she was still a baby.
After descending from space and finally accomplishing her mission to conquer Strike World, Nostradamus founded the Nostra Kingdom, anointing herself the "Great Queen of Fear" and reigned proudly as its ruler. After appointing Angolmois as her head minister, she had him read out the proclamation declaring the founding of the kingdom, which boasted of Nostradamus's prophecies regarding the founding of the kingdom, Nostradamus becoming its ruler, as well as a myriad of other fulfilled prophecies.
STORY_10218:
The legendary holy sword that chooses, guides, and can only be wielded by the rightful ruler of Britannia.
Excalibur and Arthur have vanquished countless foes together. When it seemed that lasting peace had finally come to Britannia, an unprecedentedly powerful enemy appeared and plunged their world into darkness. And as hope faded away, Excalibur awakened its true potential through Arthur's indomitable spirit—coalescing the wills and holy power within the weapons of the Knights of the Round Table for Arthur to unleash a ray of hope, cutting through the darkness.
STORY_10219:
A cheerful and energetic goddess known for her great love of music and unflappable personality.
One day, after awakening to her true form as the goddess of music, Benzaiten heard a mysterious screeching sound that led her to a mysterious star. The noise seemed to have an effect on gravity, pulling in nearby stars. Realizing that if nothing is done, stars would collide and put the fate of the universe in jeopardy, Benzaiten followed the sound to its source and discovered that the star was once among the brightest in the universe. However, the star realized its end was near and emitted a distorted lament in an attempt to bring back the life it once sustained. Sensing the star's sorrow, Benzaiten played a dirge to show that it was not alone. Benzaiten's melody and the star's wailing combined to create a touching requiem that helped the star accept its fate with dignity.
STORY_10220:
A girl created by the gods of Olympus.
Pandora mistakenly opens a box that unleashes calamity into the world. Her curiosity and sense of responsibility set her on a quest to undo her blunder.
After some time has passed, Pandora is confronted by a maniacal monster that is the embodiment of calamity.
It's at this time that Mopey, the embodiment of loneliness and sadness, throws himself into the box, awakening a new power in Pandora.
STORY_10221:
The idol group formed in the anime "MSonic! D'Artagnyan's Rise to Fame". The group consists of the energetic D'Artagnyan and the hardworking Shion.
Two For All performs original songs live in cyberspace. Their ardent desire is for everyone who listens to their music to unite and share joy, hence the band name, "Two For All". Through their kind voices, their songs reverberate throughout the world, becoming the bridge that connects all listeners.
STORY_10224:
A gigantic monster that steals people's memories.
Having once unleashed its true power, Babel transformed into a divine figure. It holds the power to bring the old world to an end and create one anew.
STORY_10225:
A dark entity sealed deep within a forbidden prison.
Having destroyed all existing material worlds, Naraku had exhausted her power and fallen into a deep sleep. When sensing the birth of a new material world, she awakens from her slumber and descends upon the world to once again return everything to the void. The "Eye of Destruction" is bound to the pattern on Naraku's forehead, and anything caught in it is destroyed.
STORY_10226:
A medical and combat system that has existed since the days of yore. The system pierces its patient with a huge key-shaped medical instrument to immobilize their body and soul, then uses its many interior arms to treat them.
One day, Avalon found an unconscious young girl and took her in for treatment. Once awake, the girl's immature ego could not differentiate between her body and the Avalon system, becoming one with Avalon. Sensing the girl's anxiety toward the strangers that sent her into a coma, Avalon activated its armament systems to eliminate those that would stand in her way.
STORY_10227:
A high school girl who possesses the power of the mythical land of Penglai. She is respected at Penglai Girl's School for possessing an unpresuming demeanor, despite her excellent grades and good looks. Her eyes are different colors, proof of the power of Penglai in her body. Her words and actions carry a certain weight due to this power.
When she must fight with all of her strength, she beckons her Striker into the land of Penglai. When releasing her power, she transforms into a celestial maiden, carrying in her palm the fabled jeweled branch of Penglai.
STORY_10228:
The incarnation of both righteousness and wickedness. As it regularly vanquished all kinds of evil, it became arrogant, beginning to worship itself for being a hero among heroes.
After destroying its enemies in a fierce battle, Antithesis would absorb their energy. From this, it discovered why its enemies fought. But upon realizing that its actions wrought the same consequences as those of the beings it condemned as evil, it began to doubt itself and its purpose, allowing the evil energy accumulated in its lower body to go out of control. With its ego collapsed, Antithesis transformed into evil incarnate, bringing destruction to its world, transmuting cities into iron sand, then attracting and absorbing them using magnetism to feed its power.
STORY_10229: A group of three ardent fans of the idol group. Whenever there is an idol event, they always show up waiting in line one or two days earlier no matter where the event is. After the event, they follow the idols closely in their car and have almost caused several traffic accidents before. They even tried to sneak into the idols’ homes in disguise as staff members, which caused great annoyance to the idols.
STORY_10235:
Date of Birth: 24 Jul
A vampire. As one of the five strongest Summoners, he holds the title of “Blood Demon”.
Despite his combative and imprudent personality, he can be strangely calm and rational when it comes to critical moments.
Besides his competence in piloting a spaceship, he also has the ability to manipulate blood.
He loves all kinds of competitive games.
STORY_10236:
Date of Birth: 3 May
A butterfly elf and an outcast.
Tough yet stubborn, she has trust issues for her past experience of being deceived and framed. 
She is willing to sacrifice everything for her little sister Xaviera.
STORY_10237:
A fire dragon whose wings are made of magma.
She is a staff in the Heptara Unies Department of Justice and one of Philip’s competent underlings.

Reluctant to being placed under others, she always wants to win in every competition and quarrel she has.
Having a rather low mental toughness, she often shirks or puts the blame on others instead of herself when she feels defeated.
STORY_10238:
A citizen of Rycaza. He is a staff in the Heptara Unies Department of Justice, who Utu thinks highly of.
He is good at dual-wielding. He often helps Utu handle different administrative works.
Holding high values of friendship and justice, he sometimes goes a bit too far unwittingly when it comes to helping a friend.
STORY_10239:
A butterfly elf. Joffe’s little sister.
She has been living in a nursing home for a long time since her wings are infected with an unknown disease that causes black spots on them.
Having a cheerful and positive personality, she loves to take a stroll and pick flowers for Joffe. She hopes she can go shopping with Joffe one day.
STORY_10240:
A tree dragon and the Deputy Chief of the Heptara Unies Department of Justice.
Being rather a bigot with unconscious arrogance hidden inside him, he has a strained relationship with Utu, the Chief of the Department of Justice.
He has built up a high reputation among the dragons for his efforts to defend the rights of his clan.
STORY_10241:
A cat elf. One of the contestants in the air race. He is the owner of Wildcat.
Born with a silver spoon in his mouth, he greatly treasures his spaceship.
STORY_10243:
An enormous beast that is regarded as a five-star dangerous creature.
It has multiple heads and wings that reek of blood. It looks horrifying with its body pitted with countless human faces.
It releases a powerful blast of magic when it flaps its wings.
STORY_10244:
Yamato Ishida is a 5th grader. Having a cool demeanor, he is rather clumsy with words but he is a deeply caring person who pays meticulous attention to both his companions’ physical and mental conditions. He later learns that it takes mutual support to make true friendships through his interaction with Gabumon and his quarrels with Taichi. 
 
 Gabumon is Yamato’s Partner Digimon, who has a gentle and compassionate personality. He likes it when Yamato plays the harmonica. Gabumon can digivolve into Garurumon, the warrior of speed and power.
STORY_10245:
Taichi Yagami is a 5th grader who has a strong sense of responsibility and a positive mind. Full of determination, he eventually grows and becomes the unifying force that leads all the other kids through his adventures in the Digital World. 
 
 Agumon is Taichi’s Partner Digimon. Having the same fearless attitude as its partner, it strikes back even when facing formidable enemies. When it digivolves, it turns into Greymon who can spit powerful flames.
STORY_10246:
Mimi Tachikawa is a 4th grader. Although she sometimes comes off as a spoiled preppy who does things her own way, she is initially a candid and kind girl. She once left Taichi’s squad for she could not stand seeing so many Digimons die protecting them.
 
 Palmon is Mimi’s Partner Digimon, who is a bit faint-hearted but it has a kind and easygoing spirit. It can digivolve into Togemon and fight with its hardened thorns.
STORY_10247:
Takeru Takaishi is a 2nd grader student. He is Yamato Ishida’s little brother but the two live apart because of their parents’ divorce. He has a kind and innocent personality.
 
 Patamon is Takeru’s Partner Digimon, who also has an unsophisticated mind as Takeru. 
 
 Hikari Yagami is a 2nd grader, who is the cheerful young sibling of Yagami Taichi. She can hear some mysterious “voices” that no one can hear.
 
 Gatomon is Hikari’s Partner Digimon, who has a mature and cool personality.
STORY_10248:
Koushiro Izumi is a 4th grader who joins the same soccer club with Taichi and Sora. He is extremely polite but he also has an insatiable curiosity that he sometimes pursues what he wants recklessly when he finds something interesting. He is good at using computers.
 
 Tentomon is Koushiro’s Partner Digimon, who is good at lightening the atmosphere. It can digivolve into Kabuterimon, who holds a strong and fortified defense.
STORY_10249:
Jo Kido is a 6th grader who is going to take the secondary school admission test of a private middle school. Having an earnest personality and a strong sense of responsibility, he works hard as the oldest of the group. However, his timorous demeanor often gives an unreliable impression.
 
 Gomamon is Jo’s Partner Digimon, who is rather easy-going and laid-back compared with Jo. When it digivolves, it becomes Ikkakumon, who has a sharp horn.
STORY_10250:
Sora Takenouchi is a 5th grader who is also a member of the soccer club with Taichi. Although she can be a fiercer striker than boys, she is a caring and reliable girl who pays attention to small details.
 
 Biyomon is Sora’s Partner Digimon, who loves to snuggle up to people like a sweet pampered child. It can fly about the sky freely after digivolving into Birdramon.
STORY_10251: A Champion level Vaccine type Animal Digimon. Possessing a heart of justice, it is a rival to Ogremon. Its killing technique is Fist of the Beast King.
STORY_10252: A Champion level Virus type Dark Angel Digimon. It has a cunning and fiendish personality. Its killing technique is Death Claw.
STORY_10253: A Champion level Virus type Demon Digimon. It is known as "Digimon Hunter" for its rough temper and warlike nature. He is an arch-enemy of Leomon.
STORY_10254: An Ultimate level Virus type Dark Angel Digimon, who starts a fierce girl fight with Angewomon.
STORY_10255: An Mega level Virus type Dark Beast Digimon. It is digivolved from Myotismon. It has the lower half of a beast and an upper half with a beetle-like shell. Its killing technique is Venom Infusion.
STORY_10256: A Mega level Data type Android Digimon, who is the leader of Deep Savers that dwell in marine areas. Its killing technique is River of Power.
STORY_10257: A Mega level Virus type Puppet Digimon who is the leader of Wind Guardians. Detestable and fiendish, it loves telling lies. Its killing technique is Puppet Pummel.
STORY_10258: A Mega level Virus type Machine Digimon, who is the leader of Metal Empire. Its killing technique is Infinity Cannon.
STORY_10259: A Mega level Virus type Wizard Digimon, who serves as the leader of Dark Masters. Its killing technique is Trump Sword.
STORY_10260: It is a mysterious Digimon born from the negative emotions and grudges of the Digimons that have failed and disappeared during digivolution.
STORY_10261: A Mega level Digimon who can rapidly digivolve and grow by absorbing the data on the Network. Cruel by nature, it gains happiness from destruction.
STORY_10262:
Veemon is a Rookie level Free type Mini Dragon Digimon who is able to perform “Armor Digivolution”. Having a mischievous and prank-loving personality, it also has another side with a strong sense of justice.
 
 Wormmon is a Rookie level Free type Larva Digimon who also has the ability to perform “Armor Digivolution” and holds great potential.
 
 Together the two can combine and digivolve into the powerful Imperialdramon.
STORY_10263:
Numemon is a Champion level Virus type Mollusk Digimon. With a low combat power, it has a killing technique called Nume-Sludge.
 
 Sukamon is a Champion level Virus type Abnormal Digimon. It is always seen with Chuumon because of its nonexistent intelligence.
 
 Chuumon is a Rookie level Virus type Beast Digimon. It always stays with Sukamon as the latter’s brain with the strong bonds of friendship developed between them.
STORY_10270:
Date of Birth: 19 Jul
A machina and the current representative of machinas. 
He has a generous and kind personality, but he shows a ferocious and decisive side when it comes to fighting against his enemies or at some critical moments.
Since he is very well acquainted with the control system in the Heptara Unies, he is often entrusted with conducting inspections and repairs.
STORY_10271:
Date of Birth: 15 Jan
A human and the student of Yulia.
He was abandoned because of the birthmark on his face when he was little. He was later adopted by Yulia and lived with her in the dragon tumulus since then.
Being somewhat aloof, he is not good at expressing his feelings, but deep down he cares about Yulia very much.
STORY_10273:
A Corrodent.
Rebellious and unruly, he finds it ridiculously absurd for Corrodents to take human form.
With his rich fighting experience and power surpassing many other warriors, he initiated Caesar into the art of combat.
STORY_10274:
A tree dragon and the former deputy representative of dragons.
She is chosen as the next keeper of the dragon tumulus after Yulia’s death. 
Gentle and considerate, she has a good relationship with Entelec.
With a tendency to get nervous easily, her mind often wanders and she likes to chatter.
STORY_10275:
A monster created by virus infection in the virtual world that is under Adam’s management.
As the metamorphosed form of a shark, it has a pair of sharp and powerful claws that can rip its prey into shreds once it gets them.
STORY_10276:
A monster created by virus infection in the virtual world that is under Adam’s management.
Besides a body made of different kinds of candies, it has a pair of huge hands that holds earth-shaking power.
With a great sense of territoriality, it swings its fists no matter what to repel every intruder found on its land.
STORY_10277:
A familiar spirit that serves the vampires.

Having a stern and aloof personality, he stops at nothing to eradicate any obstacle for its master.
STORY_10278:
Date of Birth: 19 Feb

A tree dragon and the keeper of the dragon tumulus.
Selfless and altruistic, she sees the world in her own unique way.
Guarding the dragon tumulus alone, she later adopted a human boy named Entelec and became his master.
STORY_10279:
Date of Birth: 15 Aug

An Eldus and the Chief of Heptara Unies Department of Justice.
She has a well-built body and a very straightforward personality. She is good at coping with difficult situations.
Despite her mastery of the laws, her mind isn’t trapped in the system. She is rather free and innovative that she is able to handle things with both reason and compassion.
STORY_10280:
Date of Birth: 12 Jul

An Elemental Beast.
He was once the inspector of beasts.
He died thirty years ago in the Rust Plague incident with his name going down in history as one of the great Heroes of Rust.

As an inspector, he had a strong sense of justice and zero tolerance of wrongful machinations. Placing a high value on friendships and his clan, he often put himself in a dilemma of loyalty and righteousness.

Yet, he later changed his way of looking at things after the House incident, in which he learned to hide his true feelings with artful words.
STORY_10281:
One of the space pirates.
She is good at ambushing the enemies with aircraft weapons.
Having a deceitful personality, she is always thinking about using other people. She is so envious and resentful that she tends to hold grudges against others, including her own companions.
STORY_10282:
One of the space pirates. A wolf Spiritual Beast.
He is a combative kind of guy with a muscular physique.
Simple-minded and bellicose, he often says things without thinking twice.
STORY_10283:
One of the space pirates.
An old woman, half of whose body was made of prostheses.
She is mainly responsible for repairing the spaceship.
Having a rather vengeful and pugnacious personality, she beats people whenever she gets upset.
STORY_10284:
Date of Birth: 1 Aug

The deputy representative of humanity. 
The fifth prince of Verdilles and the descendant of Arthur Pendragon. 
He seems arrogant and conceited most of the time, but deep down he is a kind and innocent young man. He is nicknamed “angry kitten” by Cilovic due to his short temper.
He volunteered himself to be the deputy representative out of admiration for Tsukishita Hitomi, the representative of humanity.
As the wielder of Excalibur, he is a skillful swordsman who is able to perform the Covenant of Blood.
STORY_10285:
Date of Birth: 22 Jun

A Druid and a friend of Yulia, the grave keeper.
With an open-minded personality, he has an amiable and tranquil temperament that brings people a sense of peace.
He can turn himself into a cerapter.
STORY_10286:
A vampire.
The current ruler of the second vampire family—Karnstein.
He is an arrogant and egotistical man who always gets what he wants by fair means or foul.
STORY_10287:
The captain of the space pirates.
He owns a powerful spaceship, named the Cosmotitan, which is armed with a lot of potent weapons.
He is the boss of Gina, Randolph and Kay.
Rapacious by nature, he is a believer in  money and utilitarianism.
STORY_10288:
A vampire.

The current ruler of Bonaparte, the first vampire family.

Seizing power with machinations, he conspires with other plutocrats to secure his authority.
STORY_10291: The Master of Water Stream Rock Smashing Fist. Despite his usual appearance as an old man, he fights against strong enemies with his well-built and muscular body.
STORY_10292: A teenage cyborg. Holding great reverence for Saitama's strength, he has become the latter's disciple.
STORY_10293: An esper who takes down monsters with psychokinetic powers.
STORY_10294: Saitama is a hero who only became a hero for fun. After three years of “special” training, though, he’s become so strong that he’s practically invincible.
STORY_10295: The S-class hero who is known as "The Strongest Man on Earth" and highly recognized by other heroes.
STORY_10296: A hero who holds psychokinetic powers. She is the leader of the Blizzard Bunch, a B-class hero faction.
STORY_10297: A righteous bicycle rider. He patrols every day with his beloved bicycle named "Justice".
STORY_10299: He claims himself "The Strongest Ninja". He accepts any commissions from assassination to bodyguard service.
STORY_10300: A man who hunts heroes with the aim to be the strongest monster. His superb fighting instinct is his weapon.
STORY_10301: The leader of the Dark Matter Thieves, a group of alien invaders. He came to the Earth as told by a prophet in search of a worthy opponent.
STORY_10302:
A Crystal Octavius whose body produces a special liquid that creates rare gems.
The kind of gem Mick produces is amethyst.

He is the son of Oliver and Wanda, and Mia’s twin brother.
Calm and intelligent, he is very protective of his twin sister.
STORY_10303:
A Crystal Octavius whose body produces a special liquid that creates rare gems.
The kind of gem Mia produces is citrine.

She is the daughter of Oliver and Wanda, and Mick’s twin sister.
Timid and bashful, she is a cute affectionate girl but also a cry baby.
STORY_10304:
A Crystal Octavius whose body produces a special liquid that creates rare gems.
The kind of gem Wanda produces is emerald.

She is Oliver’s wife and the mother of Mia and Mick.

She is gentle and kind on the outside, but she is actually a tough woman who can still maintain her composure during a crisis.
STORY_10305:
A Crystal Octavius whose body produces a special liquid that creates rare gems.
The kind of gem Oliver produces is ruby.

He is Wanda’s husband and the father of Mia and Mick.
He is usually calm and composed, but he becomes violent and peevish when he sees his wife and children get hurt.
STORY_10306:
A citizen of Tōwa Teito.
She is a well-known lantern maker.
Bright and cheery, she loves making and collecting lanterns.
Her lanterns are very popular among children.
STORY_10307:
The first ‘synthetic soul’ invented by the Lomond Manor and Machinas.
She is currently the management system of Lomond Manor, “Lost Eden”, which controls the lifeline of Lomond Manor.

Curious about new things, she loves receiving new information but she sometimes misapprehends it and does weird things.
Different from her younger brother, Adam, she has free access to other areas.
STORY_10309:
Date of Birth: 26 Jan

A three-tailed vixen and the descendant of Jiang Ziya and Daji. She is the current representative of gods.

Having a rather playful and energetic personality, she is an optimist full of compassion. She is told to be an extraordinary Xian general by the Cereus Prophesier.

She excels in different kinds of seduction enchantment and Xian arts.
STORY_10310:
Date of Birth: 29 Jun

A Ganoderma elf who hates sunlight but loves sultry weather and humid places.

In addition to her soft and cute personality, she can communicate with funguses. Her mind tends to wander often and she has such strange laughs when she is happy. 

Not only can she turn her body into fungal threads to hunt, but she can also produce poisonous spores to make her enemies hallucinate.
STORY_10311:
A subordinate of Marcus.

She was once a child in the slum on Planet Canaan. Marcus saved her and took her out of poverty when she was on the brink of starvation and death. She has dedicated her life to Marcus since then. 

She is good at using ice and fire magic.
STORY_10312:
A bear Spiritual Beast and the former deputy representative of beasts,

Cruel and ferocious by nature, he often shows himself in his human form to conceal his bestiality.
He took part in the hunt for House, the Corrodent. Soon after that, he resigned as deputy representative due to physical issues.
STORY_10313:
A felon who has been sentenced to 553 years in prison. 

As an expert at hunting, his favorite hobby is making jawed traps since he believes that the most beautiful sound in the world is the one when the trap closes and catches its prey.

STORY_10368:
As the children of Zeus, Artemis and Apollo had been living on an island—just the two of them—until Zeus made Apollo the God of the Sun and separated them. On a random hunt, Artemis accidentally shot a human man in the foot and crippled him. Consumed with guilt, she carried him on her back and traveled around the realms as the emissary of Zeus.

        One day, Artemis found her bow on the cabinet missing when she was heading out of the log cabin in the woods as usual. While she was in a state of bewilderment, she heard a gentle male voice behind her back, asking, ‘Are you looking for this?’

        Artemis turned around and saw her bow in Orion’s hands. She took it and unexpectedly found that the scarred surface had been smoothened—clearly, someone had repaired it.

        ‘I saw your bow was pretty much worn so I slightly repaired it. It didn’t take much time. I… hope you won’t mind.’

        Although Orion told Artemis that it was nothing, she noticed the deep dark circles under his eyes. He must have stayed up all night just to fix her bow the night before.

        With that much effort spent to please Artemis, the man was too humble to even claim the credit. Seeing Orion like that, Artemis felt a sudden tingling twitch in her heart. To conceal this inexplicable feeling, she turned her face away. Looking down, she said in a deep voice, ‘Thank you, but you really didn’t have to do this.’

        Earlier, Orion confessed his feelings to Artemis but she turned him down. Even so, Orion did not give up but took good care of her the way he used to. His deep affection tingled Artemis’ heart. Still, she knew that she could not let go of Apollo. There was no room for another person in her heart, so she could only be cruel to Orion lest she led him on.

        Artemis’ hard-hearted words froze the air for a while. In the end, it was Orion, who broke the silence and said calmly with a smile, ‘I’m not asking for something in return. I’m not asking for a promise either. I just want to stay with you and take care of you. I’m happy as long as you’re happy.’

        Artemis almost fell for Orion so she could only run out of the door before she got drowned in his tenderness. Unable to take Orion out of her mind, Artemis accidentally fell into a pit after being attacked by some demons on the way.

        By then, the sun was already setting in the west. The orange sunlight shone on the woods, filtering through the leaves. Yet, it didn’t reach the depths of the pit. In the pitch dark, Artemis was covered in sweat with blood draining from her face, leaning against the cliff wall while holding her leg to check her calf which was pierced through by a branch.

        In fact, it was not such a serious wound for a god like Artemis. She only needed to pull out the branch and the wound would heal after resting for a day or two. However, pulling out the branch was the most difficult part because that short moment of pain could be heartbreaking.

        Watching her blood drip and form a small puddle on the ground, Artemis suddenly recalled that she had not been seriously injured ever since she grew up. She only had a serious injury when she was little—when Apollo was still by her side. Back then, they were attacked by a grizzly bear and Artemis almost got bitten while protecting her brother. Luckily, Apollo awakened his godly power just in time and repelled the beast.

        Terrified, the young Artemis clung to her brother tightly. The latter promised her that he would always protect her and become the light that brightens up her path, and no one could keep them apart. However, the vow later turned out to be broken with Apollo becoming the God of the Sun who brought sunlight to all mankind yet left Artemis alone.

        Artemis could not help thinking that maybe Apollo had already forgotten his promise for there were too many things that were more important than her. She was the only one who still remembered that promise and held onto the past. She kept chasing after him with just the thought of being with him, even if she had to be hurt to do so. She was being so stupid.

        Tears brimmed over Artemis’ eyes and streamed down her cheeks. Eventually, they fell off the edge of her chin and disappeared into the dark.

        ‘Perhaps it’s better for me to live in the night than under the scorching sunlight. I don’t deserve light anyway,’ thought Artemis miserably.

        As night alternated with day, the moon rose to the sky where black was the only color. It was even darker at the bottom of the pit, holding Artemis in boundless darkness.

        Suddenly, the sound of footsteps came from above. Artemis lifted her head, only to see a ball of bright fire that came from the torch in a fine teenager’s hand—it was Orion, bringing Artemis the only light in the dark. Even though he could not repel the darkness for Artemis, he could light up a fire for her.
　　
        Artemis looked at Orion. Not only did he bring the light, but he also brought life back to Artemis’ heart which had been withering in the shadows of loneliness, saving her from being drowned in the dark.

        The quavering voice of Orion came from the top of the pit. ‘Artemis! Are you alright?! Don’t worry! I’ll get you out right away! This pit is so deep. Should I get you a vine?’

        It would be easy for Artemis to climb out of the pit along the vine if she removed the branch in her calf, but she didn’t. Removing the branch could be very painful, but if she didn’t do it, the branch would lodge in her flesh and become a part of her. By that time, removing it would cause much pain. The branch was just like what Apollo meant to Artemis. 

        Artemis knew that it was time to rip off the bandaid. Why should she cling to someone when she knew that her feelings would never be reciprocated? So, gritting her teeth, Artemis pulled out the branch.

        ‘Argh!’ Artemis groaned in pain. A branch that was thick as half her arm was pulled out with blood dripping from its end. She hurled it to a corner as if she was throwing her past away. Then, she shouted at Orion, ‘I’m fine. Get me a vine and I’ll climb up!’

        Seeing Orion scouring around for vines, Artemis suddenly recalled her memories of Apollo standing in front of her and repelling the beasts when they were little. The two men were completely different: Apollo was valiant and charmingly imposing since he could drive away the beasts easily; Orion, on the other hand, was slow and clumsy. There was nothing about him that was as great as Apollo. Nonetheless, the two now looked similar in Artemis’ eyes.

        After Orion fixed the vine to a tree, Artemis endured the pain in her calf and climbed to the top of the pit step by step through willpower alone. When she almost reached the top, Orion reached out his hands and helped her up. Catching a glimpse of her injured calf, he said remorsefully, ‘It must hurt so badly.’

        ‘Yes, it is. But it won’t hurt anymore once the wound heals and turns into a memorable scar.’ Artemis gave him a smile of relief.

        When Orion leaned down to bandage Artemis’ wound, a crystal-clear moonstone fell out of his front pocket and rolled to Artemis. Artemis picked it up and asked, ‘What is this?’

        ‘I thought of you immediately when I saw it at the market, so I bought it. I was going to give it to you as a present later.’

        Surprised, Artemis delicately checked out the translucent crystal that was half the size of her palm in her hand. The crystal was still glowing in the place without the moonlight, gentle yet bright, like candlelight.

        Artemis loved it. Holding the moonstone to her chest, she asked, ‘But why all of a sudden?’

        ‘You like light, don’t you? I saw you always looking at the sun. But staring at the sun for too long can damage your eyes so I bought this. Its light is soft and harmless. Besides, it can stay with you forever and keep you from feeling lonely.’

        Orion gazed adoringly up at Artemis. In his eyes was an ocean of love, as gentle as the light of the moonstone, that swathed Artemis with never-ending warmth.

        ‘I should move on, and perhaps give this man who loves me so much a chance.’ Making up her mind, Artemis put a hand on Orion’s shoulder and whispered in his ear,  ‘Can you ask me again?’

        Dumbfounded by Artemis’ rarely close touch, Orion asked in a dorky way, ‘Ask… what?’

        Seeing the stupid look on Orion’s face, Artemis said with her lips curling up, ‘What you’ve been asking a lot these days.’

        Overwhelmed, Orion took a few seconds to process. Then a flood of emotions surged in his eyes, eventually turning into visible joy. He asked immediately, ‘Will you be with me?’

        ‘Yes.’ A captivating smile spread across Artemis’s face and it was as beautiful as the moon in the dark.

First year student at Tokyo Jujutsu High School, who enrolled as a Grade 2 Jujutsu Sorcerer.

Second year student at Kyoto Jujutsu High School.

A serpent elf and a first-grade summoner.

STORY_10481:

An Akashic.

A swordman who leads the Furin Kazan guild.

A young girl who is saved by Kirito in GGO.

A brilliant player who’s come to be known as “Zekken” thanks to her unheard-of-sword skills.

The Leader of Cait Sith.

Kazuto’s girlfriend.

Novalis’ cousin, who tragically died during the war. She was one of the few people who had shown kindness to Novalis.

STORY_10578:
A friend of Joseph and an Egyptian fortune teller.

A survivor of an archaeological excavation team that discovered the Stone Mask in Mexico.

An exceptional Ripple user raised by Straizo. She served as Caesar’s Hamon mentor and later became Joseph’s mentor as well.

One of the Pillar Men.

One of the Pillar Men.

The leader of the Pillar Men.

Jotaro’s grandfather.

A ladies’ man who has keen judgment. He once attempted to assassinate DIO, but he was convinced upon witnessing DIO’s overwhelming power, and thus surrendered.

DIO’s falcon. Besides its high-speed flying ability, it can launch long-range attacks.

STORY_10598:

The God of Wealth, who presides over fortunes in the Heavenly Kingdom.
