STORY_11262:
Seto Kaiba is Yugi’s eternal rival and president of KaibaCorp—a leading conglomerate. Extremely proud and confident, Kaiba will stop at nothing to become the greatest Duelist in history.
His signature monster is the legendary and ferocious rare card, “Blue-Eyes White Dragon.”
STORY_11263:
Joey Wheeler is a Duelist who isn’t afraid to face danger to help his friends, especially his best bud, Yugi. 
Always ready to take a chance, his cards often rely on luck. However, his go-to monster is the reliable “Red-Eyes B. Dragon.”
STORY_11264:
Mai Valentine is a beautiful Duelist who travels the world, taking down all challengers along the way while working as a casino dealer. Though she may seem bossy and tough, she also has a soft and caring side, like a big sister that you can count on.
In Duels, she corners her opponents with the dazzling dance of her “Harpie Lady Sisters”.
STORY_11265:
Yugi Muto was a quiet, game-loving high school student leading an ordinary life... until he solved the Millennium Puzzle. Now destiny has opened the path to an unimaginable journey! 
His signature card is the mighty “Gandora the Dragon of Destruction” that has the power to wipe out everyone.
STORY_11266:
Yami Yugi is an ancient spirit that indwelled Yugi Muto when he solved the Millennium Puzzle. An expert Duelist wielding unmatched skills and cards, Yami Yugi is ready to face any challenge in order to regain his lost memories.  
His most trusted monster is “Dark Magician.”
STORY_11267: Ishizu Ishtar is a descendant of the Gravekeeper family, who were the guardians of the Millennium Items. She is determined to rescue her younger brother, Marik, from the darkness that has overtaken him. The power of her Millennium Necklace allows her to see the future.
STORY_11268:
Yami Bakura is an evil spirit inside the Millennium Ring that possesses Yugi’s classmate, Bakura, transforming him into Yami Bakura. He is merciless and will stop at nothing to achieve his goal. 
His Occult Deck focuses on Fiend and Zombie-Type cards, like “Dark Necrofear.”
STORY_11269: “Blue-Eyes Ultimate Dragon” is Seto Kaiba’s ultimate trump card that can be summoned by fusing three “Blue-Eyes White Dragons.”
STORY_11270:
Yugi Muto was a quiet, game-loving high school student leading an ordinary life... until he solved the Millennium Puzzle. Now destiny has opened the path to an unimaginable journey! 
His signature card is “Silent Magician LV8”, a powerful monster that can remain unaffected by an opponent’s Spell effects.
STORY_11271:
Yami Yugi is an ancient spirit that indwelled Yugi Muto when he solved the Millennium Puzzle. An expert Duelist wielding unmatched skills and cards, Yami Yugi is ready to face any challenge in order to regain his lost memories.
"Slifer the Sky Dragon" serves as a powerful ace monster cherished by Yami Yugi as one of the legendary "Egyptian Gods".
STORY_11272:
Seto Kaiba is Yugi’s eternal rival and president of KaibaCorp—a leading conglomerate. Extremely proud and confident, Kaiba will stop at nothing to become the greatest Duelist in history. 
“Obelisk the Tormentor,” one of the three Egyptian God Cards, is one of his ultimate trump cards, standing alongside his prized “Blue-Eyes White Dragon.”
STORY_11273:
Joey Wheeler is a Duelist who isn’t afraid to face danger to help his friends, especially his best bud Yugi. 
He uses the powerful Warrior monster, “Gilford the Lightning”, which can destroy all monsters on the opponent controls.
STORY_11274:
Yami Yugi is an ancient spirit that indwelled Yugi Muto when he solved the Millennium Puzzle. An expert Duelist wielding unmatched skills and cards, Yami Yugi is ready to face any challenge in order to regain his lost memories.
The Egyptian Gods refer to “Obelisk the Tormentor”, “Slifer the Sky Dragon”, and “The Winged Dragon of Ra.” Also known as the God Cards, these three legendary cards are the focus of many fierce Duels.
STORY_11275:
Téa Gardner is Yugi’s childhood friend and a high school student who dreams of becoming a professional dancer. Having a competitive spirit, she never backs down from a Duel.
She uses a Spellcaster Deck that features the ace monster “Dark Magician Girl.”
STORY_11276:
Bandit Keith is an intercontinental champion who has no qualms about using underhanded tactics to steal the win. 
His signature monster, “Barrel Dragon,” has an effect that enables it to destroy his opponent’s card.
STORY_11277:
“Exodia the Forbidden One” is a legendary card that holds a unique effect.
When a Duelist has all five pieces of Exodia in their hand, they win the Duel instantly, regardless of their opponent’s remaining Life Points.
STORY_11278:
Maximillion Pegasus is the president of Industrial Illusions and the genius game designer who created Duel Monsters. Using the power of his Millennium Eye, he can read his opponents’ minds and see the cards in their hands.
His Deck focuses on Toon Monsters that can bewilder his opponents, along with “Relinquished,” which can absorb opposing monsters. His ultimate ace monster is “Thousand-Eyes Restrict.”
STORY_11279:
Weevil Underwood is a regional champion who loves to buzz to victory with his Insect Deck. Nothing will stop Weevil from getting a win, even if it means throwing Yugi’s cards into the ocean or messing with Joey’s Deck. 
One of his favorite techniques is an Insect Combo using “Great Moth” and “Insect Queen.”
STORY_11280:
Mako Tsunami participates in many tournaments so that he can use the prize money to buy a fishing boat and sail the mighty waves. He masterfully used his Sea Deck to give Yugi and Joey some of the toughest Duels ever. 
His signature monster, “The Legendary Fisherman”, unleashes its true strength when it swims out into his “Umi” field.
STORY_11281:
Espa Roba is a Duelist feared as a psychic who can channel the energies of the universe to read his opponent’s hand during a Duel—or so he claims. Unfortunately, Joey debunked his cosmic powers as a hoax during Battle City. 
But what isn’t fake are his Dueling skills. He once cornered Joey with his powerful ace monster, “Jinzo.”
STORY_11282:
Arkana is one of the Ghouls’ nefarious Rare Card Hunters.
He has no qualms about harming his own cards—as long as it guarantees him a victory. During Battle City, He faced Yami Yugi in a clash of Dark Magicians—where one mistake could lead to an eternity in the Shadow Realm.
His unique style earns him the title of the Master of Magicians.
STORY_11283:
Lumis and Umbra are members of a Rare Hunter tag team sent by Ghouls to steal the Egyptian God Cards. Since Yugi and Kaiba each had one, Lumis and Umbra challenged them to a tag match where the losers were sent plummeting into the Shadow Realm. Lumis is the smaller of the two, while Umbra is the taller one.
Their ace monster, “Masked Beast Des Gardius,” possesses a devastating effect that lets it take control of one of the opponent’s monsters.
STORY_11284:
Odion is the servant of the Ishtar family. Honest and upright, he duels fair and square. He has sworn absolute loyalty to Marik, who places great trust in him.
His Deck is built around Trap-Type Monsters such as “Embodiment of Apophis,” ensnaring his opponents in a web of traps. His ace monster is “Mystical Beast of Serket.”
STORY_11285:
Yami Marik is Marik Ishtar’s dark side born from the suffering he endured as a Gravekeeper. Cruel and vicious, he enjoys watching his opponents suffer. His appetite for destruction is incomprehensible. 
“The Winged Dragon of Ra,” which he possessed, has a powerful effect that destroys one monster on the field.
STORY_11286: Atem is the young Pharaoh of ancient Egypt and the true identity of Yugi Muto’s other self, Yami Yugi.
STORY_SUMMONER_20001:
Beside a lake surrounded by an idyllic scenery stood a magnificent building with its red-bricked spire staggering in the shape of a star. This architecture was the general branch of the magic academy under an organization named “Starmage”.

        This day, all students of the academy were assembling in a splendid and elegant hall. The principal was on stage giving a speech. “...Since ancient times, the wars in the continent of Tarones have never ceased. Disputes between gods and demons destroyed the lands of the residents, and we humans took the brunt. Countless innocent people were stricken by warfare...Many died...while the others displaced...”

        The principal paused to look around the hall; some students who had been napping soon awoke and pretended to listen, except for a student in the center of the front row. He kept turning his head to look back towards the hall entrance, with anxiety written on his face.

        “Still hasn't shown up...is she gonna graduate or not!” Enoch could not help but sigh. “I was planning to drag her up in the morning. But god knows that these lazy folk even got up earlier than me and sneaked out.”

        Suddenly, Enoch felt someone knock his elbow lightly. As he turned around, the classmate beside him gave a wink and whispered, “Hey, our magic history teacher, the old toad, is glaring at you.”

        Enoch looked to the right and immediately met the direct gaze of an old man with protruding eyes, wide and big enough as if to intimidate Enoch, who was so freaked out and behaved himself properly.

        “Tut! That old freak is always hard on us...Oh!” Enoch wore a wicked grin suddenly, almost scaring off his classmate, but he was not aware, as all his mind was occupied by a flash idea.

        “Since I’ve graduated, why not take this chance to take revenge on that old man?” Quietly taking out a wand, Enoch closed his eyes to chant a spell. Next second, numerous toads started jumping out from the old man, who ran away in embarrassment. This awkward moment had made all the students burst into laughter.

        “AHEM!” The principal silenced the students while maintaining a gaze at Enoch. Clearly, he knew it was his trick. Facing the virtuous principal, Enoch stopped the mischief to pay attention to the speech respectfully.

        “...The demons invaded the Enochian Tower to seize its powerful energy. Back then, the heroes of humans stepped forward. Molly, the grand sage, and Sean, the swordsman, took the lead to seal the power with their fellows. Only then did the war cease and bring peace back to the world. We humans took this opportunity to gather forces, forge alliances between major powers, establish a number of specialized organizations, and study ways to fight against the demons…”

        The principal raised the staff to point at a silver plate with engraved stars and magic circles above. “We, Starmage, are one of those organizations. Tawil the sorceress was our pioneer to expand the organization from Lomond Manor and establish magic academies to nurture talents.” 

        “Tawil...Mother is truly amazing…” Enoch exclaimed in his heart. 

        “In front of me are all young talents who’ve been through rigorous training for these 5 years. You have the knowledge of elements and everything. Today is the day you’ll truly become a member of Starmage, the next-gen mage to help the weak and the realm with magic.” The inspiring speech received a tempest of applause from the students.

        After a moment of clapping, the principal wore a smile. “The graduates this year are remarkable. The most outstanding student has achieved full scores in all subjects. Now let’s invite him to the stage. The 58th valedictorian of the academy, Enoch!”

        “WHHHAT! What’s going on? No one ever told me to give a speech!” Nervous, Enoch could not help but brace up for the talk in the eyes of the audience.

        “I...er...I…” 

        Luckily a savior appeared during this awkward moment—a shadow broke through a stained window into the hall, sweeping across the students at high speed; some timid students were startled to scream.

        That shadow ran straight to the stage, targeting Enoch.

        Bang! Enoch crashed down on the floor out of the blue. Then he sat upright slowly while touching the swell on the back of his head.

        “Ouch...What the—sis-sister! Why are you here—Ah NOO! Why are you so late! Today is our graduation ceremony!” Enoch, looking at the young girl sitting on top of him, grabbed her shoulders to question.

        “Screw the ceremony!” The girl shouted as she squeezed Enoch’s cheeks anxiously. “Brother! Something bad happened!”

        “Bread how!” (Bad how?) Enoch could not pronounce properly for the moment.

         “Mother...is missing!”

        “...Huh? Whose mother?” Enoch was blank.

        “Are you nuts! How many mothers do you have!” The girl slapped his head to make another swell.

        Rubbing his head, Enoch was still unable to believe what his sister just said, for their mother had no reason for doing this crazy thing.

        However, more unforeseen things would happen in the near future, which would change the fate of the entire world and even the universe...
STORY_SUMMONER_20002: His parents died in an accident during his childhood. Helpless, he was later placed in the "Blue Bird Orphanage". With an innocent face, Shroy has a much different personality from his appearance, crafty and sensitive. He is kind in nature, even though he is reluctant in words but he will still lend a helping hand when he sees someone in need.
STORY_11288:
Firenze is the Witch of the Continuum, one of the thirteen witches foretold in the prophecy.
She is a gentle and graceful witch with a fascination for magic and the mysteries that surround it. Perceptive and caring by nature, she never hesitates to help those around her. 
Even in the midst of a crisis, she rarely loses her composure. Her calm judgment has guided her companions through difficult situations more than once.
STORY_11289:
Alps is the Witch of Hallowed Shield, one of the thirteen witches foretold in the prophecy.
Bold and cheerful, she is always the first to put herself between danger and her companions. A formidable close-range fighter with a natural gift for leadership, she has earned the trust and admiration of many.
STORY_11290: Moonclaw is Firenze’s familiar, a lively and quick-witted member of the Kairas clan. Playful and openly affectionate, she shares a deep bond with Firenze and is almost always at her side.No matter how frightening the situation becomes, she never abandons Ibel and stays faithfully by her side through every hardship.
STORY_11291:
Ibel is a young witch with a sensitive and delicate heart. Though timid by nature, she refuses to let fear define her. She is determined to grow stronger and prove that she is someone others can rely on—especially when the people she cares about are in danger.
Much of that determination comes from Alps. Strong, dependable, and everything Ibel hopes to become, Alps is someone she deeply admires and holds especially dear.
STORY_11292:
Aurelio is Alps’s familiar, a proud and confident golden eagle. 
Sharp-eyed and battle-hardened, he stays at her side, lending his experience and level-headed judgment whenever she needs it.
STORY_11293:
Woolly is Ibel’s familiar, timid by nature but fiercely loyal. 
No matter how frightening the situation becomes, she never abandons Ibel and stays faithfully by her side through every hardship.
STORY_11296: Dreadmares are dangerous creatures that roam the land, far stronger than ordinary beasts. Some possess strange abilities, making them one of the most common threats witches are called upon to face.
STORY_11297:
Adrian is a master craftsman based in Witchhaven, known for repairing everything from magical artifacts to specialized equipment.
His rugged appearance can be deceiving, but beneath it, he is warmhearted and dependable, always ready to lend a hand.
STORY_11298:
Alwin is a black witch considered a serious threat by the Witches’ Guild. He has a knack for reading people and knows exactly what to say to get under their skin.
